e: 由「這男人是我的叔叔／舅舅，這是他的女兒。」，可推知 B 說 A 的「表╱堂姐妹」很漂亮。

q:

B：Yes, that’s right.

2. 問「誰」須用疑問詞 Who。

q:

B：Ken.

1. man 為第三人稱單數主詞，be 動詞用 is，置於句首須大寫。

q:

q:

q:

q:

e: 我的祖父母 76 歲，但是他們仍然「充滿活力」。

e: 「老虎」身上有黃黑色的條紋。牠是貓科動物。

e: 動物園裡有許多「動物」，而我最喜歡的是老虎。
q: There are a lot of（有許多的）a＿＿＿ls in the zoo, and I like tigers the best（最）.

e: 由 B 說 pony 可知，A 看到一隻小「馬」。
q:
A：Mom, look at that small h＿＿＿e. It’s short and cute.

e: 這個四歲女孩很「聰明」。她會讀書、畫畫跟跳舞。
q: The four-year-old girl is s＿＿＿t. She can（會）read, draw, and dance.

e: Meg：這部「電影」是關於什麼？ Fred：是關於一個男孩跟他的動物朋友。
q:
Meg：What’s the m______e about?
Fred：It’s about a boy and his animal friends.

e: Ken：去那間新的「電影院」看《蜘蛛人》如何？ Joe：好。它的銀幕很大。

e: 「綿羊」是農場動物。牠們吃草。

e: 在「中國」除夕夜，家家戶戶團聚吃豐盛的晚餐。

e: 「獅子」看起來很可怕。和豹一樣，牠們也是貓科動物的一員。
q: L＿＿＿ns look scary（可怕的）. Like leopards（像是豹）, they are from the cat family.

e: Ann：你的動物「生肖」是什麼？ Ben：我屬雞。那你呢？ Ann：我也屬雞。
q:
Ann：What’s your animal s＿＿＿n?

e: Tom：貓會抓「大老鼠」嗎？ Ivy：是的，牠們會。
q:
Tom：Can（會）cats catch（抓）r＿＿＿ts?

e: Liz：在這張「照片」裡的人是誰？他們看起來很年輕。 Leo：他們是我的學生。
q:
Liz：Who are those people in this p＿＿＿e? They look young.
Leo：They’re my students.

e: 牠們是「公牛」，不是母牛。
q: They’re o＿＿＿n, not cows（母牛）.

e: 那是一隻北極「熊」。牠又大又白。
q: That is a polar（北極的）b＿＿＿r. It’s big and white.

e: 我的寵物是「兔子」。牠很小隻且是白色。
q: My pet is a r＿＿＿t. It’s small and white.

e: Gina：媽，「龍」是虛構的動物。那是真的嗎？ 媽媽：沒錯。牠們不是真實的。
q:
Gina：Mom, d＿＿＿ns are imaginary（虛構的）animals. Is that true?
Mom：That’s right. They’re not real（真實的）.

e: Andy：那些「人」是老師嗎？ Kate：不，他們是醫生。
q:
Andy：Are those p＿＿＿e teachers?
Kate：No, they are doctors.

e: 那條「蛇」好長。牠正在吞食一顆蛋。
q: The s＿＿＿e is long. It is swallowing（吞食）an egg.

e: 「山羊」奶對孩子很好。我兒子每天早上喝它。
q: G＿＿＿t’s milk is good for children. My son drinks it every（每一）morning.

e: Nancy：嘿！那是一隻「公雞」嗎？ Kenny：不，牠是一隻母雞。牠正在下蛋。
q:
Nancy：Hey! Is that a r＿＿＿r?
Kenny：No, it’s a hen（母雞）. See? It’s laying eggs（下蛋）.

e: 喔，不！有一隻死「老鼠」在廚房。難怪很臭。
q: Oh, no! A dead（死的）m＿＿＿e is in the kitchen（廚房）. No wonder it’s smelly（臭的）.

e: 你們的音樂老師是一位歌手。那是「真的」嗎？
q: Your music（音樂）teacher is a singer（歌手）. Is that t______e?

q:
Pete：Tony’s pet rabbit is dead（死的）.

e: Emma：這些鞋子對我來說太小了。 David：你鞋子「尺寸」是幾號？ Emma：20 號。
q:
Emma：These shoes are too small for me.
David：What’s your shoe s______e?

e: Cindy 既美麗又聰明，但她在她班上不是一個人緣好的「人」。
q: Cindy is beautiful and smart, but she isn’t a people p______n in her class.

e: 那隻「猴子」正在樹裡跳來跳去。牠很可愛。

A：＿＿＿ Tony and Steve’s mother young?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿.

e: 問句主詞是 Eason 的妻子跟 Gary 的妻子兩個人；且用 No 回答，可知要用 short 的相對字 tall。
q:
A：＿＿＿ Eason’s and Gary’s wives short?
B：No, ＿＿＿.

e: 由複數 be 動詞 are 可知，主詞是複數形，所以用個別所有格。
q: ＿＿＿ schools are new and big.

e: 主詞是 Lucy 的先生跟 Eva 的先生兩個人，且too 出現在肯定句的句尾，故選肯定的複數 be 動詞 are。
q:
A：Mr. Smith is tall.
B：Lucy’s and Eva’s husbands ＿＿＿ tall, too.

e: 由 their 可知須用複數主詞，且為第三人稱，須搭配複數 be 動詞 are 與指示詞 these。
q:
A：＿＿＿ your favorite（最喜愛的） ＿＿＿?
B：Yes, their feathers（羽毛）are beautiful.

e: 由複數 be 動詞 are可知須用複數主詞，故選 (C)。
q: These ＿＿＿ from the UK are Mary’s friends from high school.

e: yes / no 問句是以「助動詞」開頭的疑問句，其句型組成方式為調換直述句「助動詞」與「主詞」的順序。A的問句轉成直述句為 The dogs’ legs are long，故其yes / no 問句應為 Are the dogs’ legs long?。又，從答句 No 可知，不可選 (D)。
q: A：Are the ＿＿＿? B：No, their legs are short.

e: 用 that 或 he 指人。因為後句有說明是指誰，man 的前面須用 the 限定。
q:
A：Is ＿＿＿ Thomas?
B：Which one（哪一個）?
A：＿＿＿ man in a red T-shirt.

e: 由 be 動詞複數 are 及第二句 they are my pets可知應為複數型指示代名詞；而 mouse 的複數型為 mice。
q: ＿＿＿ two ＿＿＿ are Lucky and Mumu. They are my pets.

e: 主詞為複數「Rachel 的媽媽和 Sam 的媽媽（兩個人）」，因此 (B) 及 (C) 皆為不正確的選項， (A) 選項不符合語意。
q: Rachel’s and Sam’s mothers ＿＿＿.

e: 肯定簡答中，主詞與 be 動詞不可縮寫，肯定詳答應與問句相符並注意主詞轉換。
q:
A：Are ＿＿＿ your books?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿.

e: 由 these 可知第一格要用複數 robots；第二格則用複數人稱代名詞 They 指 robots。
q: Look at these ＿＿＿ from Jason. ＿＿＿ cool.

e: 問句中空格後並無出現動詞，可知此格要用 What is 的縮寫 What’s；由 They 可知第二格可填入複數名詞 mice、sheep 或 rabbits。
q:
A: ＿＿＿ your favorite（最喜愛的）animal?
B: I like ＿＿＿. They are cute.

e: 由 His 可知 brother 是單數，故第一格用 brother’s 表示我「弟弟的」書；由 these 可知主詞為複數，故第二格為 they’re。
q:
A: Are these my ＿＿＿ books?
B: No, ＿＿＿ not. His books are on that desk.

e: 根據語意應選「害群之馬（the black sheep）」。
q: Joe and Tim are the black ＿＿＿ of the family. They always（總是）do bad things（事情）.

e: 名詞前搭配所有格。
q:
A：Are those ＿＿＿ shoes? They’re so（如此）big.
B：No, they’re ＿＿＿ brother’s shoes.

e: 複數名詞搭配 be 動詞 are且名詞前可搭配所有格，可推知 Gina 和 Lily 是「我們的」朋友。
q: Gina and Lily ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ friends. We’re junior high school students.

e: 說話者與 Kevin 為夫妻，且第二句話缺少主詞，故選 (B)。
q: Kevin is my husband. ＿＿＿ have two children.

e: 由 B 回答 Yes, we are.，可推知 A 問「你們是英文老師嗎？」，且用複數。
q:
A：Are you ＿＿＿? Your English is good.
B：Yes, we are. Our students’ English is good, too.

e: sheep 單複數同形，而在此專指某農場的綿羊，須用定冠詞 the 表示。
q: ＿＿＿ on the farm（農場）are cute. Look! They are eating grass（草）now.

e: women 為複數名詞，須搭配複數 be 動詞 are，後方也須使用複數「她們的」表示。
q:
A：The women ＿＿＿ beautiful. ＿＿＿ smiles（笑容）are beautiful. Who are they?
B：That is Cindy, and that is Rita. They’re sisters.

e: A 向 B 介紹身邊的兩位朋友，須用 these 表示。
q:
A：Ian, ＿＿＿ are my friends, Vicky and Tina.
B：Nice to meet you. I’m Ian.

e: 由 B 的回答可推知，A 是問「你父母的名字是什麼？」，須用複數 be 動詞 are 以及複數名詞 names。
q:
A：What ＿＿＿ your parents’ ＿＿＿?
B：Peter and Stella.

e: those 為複數指示形容詞，故回答用複數代名詞 they，且由回答 Yes 可知為肯定，be 動詞用 are。
q:
A：Aren’t those pictures beautiful?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿.

e: those 是複數指示形容詞，表示「那些男孩的」用 boys’。
q:
A：Who is those ＿＿＿ math teacher?
B：Ms. Chang.

e: 由問句可知是複數，答句用複數名詞。
q:
A：What are those?
B：They are ＿＿＿.

e: 定冠詞 a 用在後面接的名詞其發音為子音開頭；而 an 則用在後面接的名詞其發音為母音開頭。
q:
A：Is Mr. Chen ＿＿＿ PE teacher?
B：No, he isn’t. He’s ＿＿＿ English teacher.

e: 主詞 those red apples 為複數，be 動詞用 are。
q:
A：Those red apples on the table ＿＿＿ for（給）you.
B：Thank you. I like apples.

e: 由 these are… 可知，後句應為複數名詞。而 (C) 不可選，因為一句話只能有一個動詞。
q: These are pens, ＿＿＿.

e: 肯定簡答須用代名詞 they。
q:
A：Are those your pictures?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿.

e: Linda and Peter 為第三人稱複數主詞，be 動詞用 are，所有格用 their。
q: Linda and Peter ＿＿＿ students. ＿＿＿ uniforms（制服）are blue.

e: people（人們）是複數，應搭配複數指示形容詞 those，此處因後面接名詞 people，故不可用代名詞的主格 they 或 所有格 their。
q:
A：Are ＿＿＿ people your family?
B：Yes. They’re my mom, dad, and brother.

e: It is 縮寫為 It’s；而「牠的」為Its。
q: ＿＿＿ their dog. ＿＿＿ name is Max.

e: 由 B 回答「它們是我的新鞋子。」可知，A 在問「那些是什麼？」，疑問詞用 What。
q:
A：＿＿＿ are those?
B：They are my new shoes.

e: girls 的所有格為 girls’。
q:
A：What are these?
B：They are the two ＿＿＿ dolls.

e: pet rabbits 是動物，代名詞用 they，由 Yes 可知為肯定回答。
q:
A：Are those your pet rabbits?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿.

e: Yes / No 問句，用複數指示代名詞問，簡答時，要用第三人稱複數代名詞 they 回答。
q:
A：Are these the girls’ bags?
B：No, ＿＿＿. This is my bag, and that is Ken’s bag.

e: 由代名詞 they 跟否定回答可知，用複數名詞，根據語意，應填入 oxen。
q:
A：Are those oxen?
B：No, they aren’t. They are not ＿＿＿.

e: 介紹某人時，可用 this / that is…；若介紹的人或事物為複數，則用 these / those are…。
q:
A：This is my brother, Jack. And ＿＿＿ is my sister, Ariel.
B：Nice to meet you, Jack and Ariel.

e: 問句用複數指示代名詞 these 詢問，答句須用代名詞 They 回答。
q:
A：What are these?
B：＿＿＿ my old bags.

e: those 為複數指示形容詞，後面須接複數名詞，代名詞用 They。
q:
A：Look at those ＿＿＿.
B：Wow! ＿＿＿ old but cool.

e: friends 為複數，應搭配複數指示代名詞 these，且簡答只可用代名詞 they。
q:
A：Are ＿＿＿ your friends?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿ are.

e: 由 sons 可知主詞為複數 they；由前後句語意相反可知，連接詞用 but。
q:
A：Are ＿＿＿ Mrs. Smith’s sons?
B：No. Jack is Mrs. Smith’s son, ＿＿＿ Andy isn’t.

e: 由前後句語意相反可知，連接詞用 but。
q: Ivy and Sue are sisters. Ivy is tall, ＿＿＿ Sue is short.

e: and 表「和；而且」，為對等連接詞，前後連接對等的詞性。
q: I can（可以）draw pictures ＿＿＿ dance.

e: 問句內已有指示代名詞 that，表「這個」，故不需要定冠詞 a / an；而答句說明這是一個橘色的包包，而 a/an 表「一個」。
q:
A：Is that ＿＿＿ bag yellow?
B：No, it’s ＿＿＿ orange bag.

e: 詢問名字的疑問詞用 What，由 students可知不只一人，be 動詞用 are。
q:
A：＿＿＿ those students’ names?
B：The girl is Rita. The tall boy is Hank, and the short boy is Tom.

e: 詢問東西的疑問詞用 What；主詞 They 為複數代名詞，空格內的名詞也要用複數。
q:
A：＿＿＿ are those?
B：They’re my cousin’s ＿＿＿.

e: new T-shirts 前方應放所有格，且由 No 可知，空格不應填 my。
q:
A：Are those your new T-shirts? They are cool!
B：No, they aren’t. They are ＿＿＿ new T-shirts.

e: shoes 為複數名詞，應搭配複數指示代名詞 those；但簡答時須用代名詞 they。
q:
A：Are ＿＿＿ your shoes?
B：No, ＿＿＿ aren’t. My shoes are here.

e: 問句用複數 those，答句須用複數名詞，sheep 為單複數同形，複數所有格用 their。
q:
A：Look! What are those?
B：They are ＿＿＿. Where is ＿＿＿ owner（飼主）?

e: 動物的代名詞要用 it，且簡答的開頭是 No，可推知是否定，要有 not。
q:
A：Is that your pet?
B：No, ＿＿＿. That’s Grace’s rabbit.

e: mothers 是複數，此處須搭配複數名詞 women 跟複數指示形容詞 these。
q:
A：Who are ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿?
B：They’re the students’ mothers.

e: 回答用代名詞 they 推知，問句須用複數名詞。
q:
A：Are ＿＿＿ popular（受歡迎的）at the zoo?
B：Yes, they are.

e: the mice 為複數，且句尾用 too 表示肯定，故 be 動詞用 are。
q: The monkey is smart. The mice ＿＿＿ smart, too.

e: B 回答「它們是我的照片。」，可知 A 問「那是什麼？」，疑問詞用 What。
q:
A：＿＿＿ are those?
B：They’re my pictures.

e: books 為複數，代名詞用 They。they 可代替不知距離遠近的複數名詞，因此比 these 跟 those 都更適合。
q: The books are from Peter. ＿＿＿ are great.

e: boys 的所有格寫法為 boys’。選項 (A) 要改成 the boy’s。
q: These are ＿＿＿ pictures.

e: those 是複數指示代名詞，be 動詞用 are。
q: Those ＿＿＿ Terry’s toys.

e: 由 B 回答 It’s a dog.，可知他先糾正 A 說牠不是一隻狐狸。
q:
A：Look! There is（有）a fox in the park.
B：＿＿＿ It’s a dog.

e: 由 A 問「這是什麼？」，後句又說「牠的眼睛是紅色的。牠也有長耳朵。」，可知指動物，且為單數。
q:
A：What’s this?
B：＿＿＿
A：Wow! Its eyes are red. It has（有）long ears, too.

e: 由 A 回答「我的父親也是護理師。」，可知前句應提到兩人或是其中一人的職業是護理師。
q:
A：Are you and Sam’s mom cooks?
B：＿＿＿
A：My dad is a nurse, too.
o: Yes, she and I are nurses.

e: 由 B 回答「2016。他屬猴。」，可知 A 是問出生年。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：2016. He’s a monkey.

e: Ricky 的生肖是羊。「難怪他是一個好人。」。
q: Ricky’s animal sign is the goat. ＿＿＿
o: Is his wife a snake, too?
Goats and sheep are the same.
He is like（像）a goat to his friends.
No wonder he’s a nice person.

e: Frank 對每個人都很好又溫暖。在他班上，「他是一個人緣好的人。」。
q: Frank is nice and warm to everyone（每個人）. ＿＿＿ in his class.
o: His animal sign is the goat

e: A：你妹妹的生肖是什麼？ B：「她屬蛇。」。
q:
A：What’s your sister’s animal sign?
B：＿＿＿
o: Yes, she is my good friend.

e: and 是連接兩個語意延續的字詞或句子，前半句提到「這些是我的舊照片，且……」，後面應接「那些是我的新照片」。
q: These are my old pictures, and ______.

e: 由 B 說「它們（那些鞋）更大。」，可推知 A 問「那些鞋子怎麼樣？」。
q:
A：These shoes are too（太）small for my son. ______
B：They are bigger（較大的）.

e: 由 B 回答「牠們是斑馬。」，可推知 A 問「那些是什麼？」。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：They’re zebras.
o: Are zebras the Chinese zodiac animal signs?

e: 由 B 回答出生年份跟生肖，可推知 A 問與出生年相關的資訊。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：His birth year is 1981. He’s a rooster.

e: 由 B 回答「猜猜看。」，可推知 A 問「牠們是什麼？」。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：Make a guess（猜猜看）.
A：They’re small and their ears are long. Are they rabbits?

e: 由「不，他們是老師。」，可推知 A 應問「那三個人是廚師嗎？」最符合文意。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：No, they’re teachers. They teach（教）English.

e: 問句中的主詞 actresses 為第三人稱複數，回答時須用代名詞 they。
q:
A：Those women are beautiful. Are they actresses（女演員）?
B：＿＿＿
o: Yes, she is a beautiful actress.
No, she isn’t a beautiful woman.

e: 由 B 回答「不。牠們對我而言很可怕。」，可推知 A 問「牠們難道不可愛嗎？」。
q:
A：Oh, no! Snakes!
B：Hey! They’re my pet snakes, and they’re my good friends, too. ＿＿＿
A：No. They’re scary（可怕的）to me.

e: 由 A 問「牠們體型不大嗎？」，可推知 B 回答「不，牠們體型不大。」才符合文意。
q:
A：Those are Jane’s dogs. Aren’t they big?
B：＿＿＿

e: 由 A 問「那是你最喜愛的動物嗎？」，可推知「是的，那是一隻可愛的兔子。」最符合文意。
q:
A：Isn’t that your favorite（最喜愛的）animal? It’s sleeping.
B：＿＿＿
o: Yes, that is your favorite animal.

e: Yes / No 問句，簡答時 these 須用代名詞 they。
q:
A：Are these your cakes? They smell（聞起來）good.
B：＿＿＿

e: 由 A 問「他們是誰？」可知應回答名字或關係，故回答「他們是 Robinson 先生的孩子。」。
q:
A：Who are they?
B：＿＿＿

e: George 的出生年是 2003。「他屬羊。」難怪他人好又溫暖。
q: George’s birth year is 2003. ＿＿＿ No wonder he’s nice and warm.

e: 由 A 問「這些是你的學校照片嗎？」，可推知為 Yes / No 問句，選項中最符合文意的是「是的，它們是我的學校照片。」。
q:
A：Are these your school pictures?
B：＿＿＿
o: Yes, it is my school picture.
No, it isn’t my school picture.
Yes, they are my school pictures.

e: 由 B 回答「它們是我媽媽的鞋子。」，可推知 A 問「那些是什麼？」。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：They are my mother’s shoes.

e: 由 A 問「這些是什麼？」，可推知最符合文意的回答為「牠們是猴子。牠們不可愛嗎？」。
q:
A：What are these?
B：＿＿＿
o: They are monkeys. Aren’t they cute?

e:
1. 空格後為複數名詞，並在指稱照片裡的人物，故用複數代名詞與複數 be 動詞。
2. 空格後面沒有其他名詞，可判斷此處不能用所有格，另外由主詞 men 可以知道不只一人。
3. 承接上句，介紹這對雙胞胎兄弟的職業，因為前句已說兩人不是老師，故選 They are cooks.。
4. 由主詞是單數，搭配的補語也為單數，另外因為前面已有冠詞 a，不能與所有格 my 連用。
5. 由 small 與 cute 可先判斷出不是在說明 Ashley 喜歡大狗或介紹她的電影，文中也未提到其他的女生或女演員，故 those are Ashley’s dogs 最符合語意。
p:
Hi, my name is Rebecca. I’m a teacher. Look at this picture. ＿1.＿ my friends. These tall men are ＿2.＿. They are twin brothers. They look alike. They are not teachers. ＿3.＿ And the short boy is George. He is a ＿4.＿. He is a school nurse. The young woman is Ashley. She is an actress. She is beautiful. Her movies are great. And ＿5.＿. They are small and cute, right?
twin孿生的 look alike 看起來相似的 actress 女演員

e:
1. 視訊內容介紹父母、姐姐與寵物，可知是指我的家人們。
2. 由後句介紹的人是姐姐，The tall girl 最符合文意。
3. 在餐廳工作的應該是廚師。
4. 此句仍是在向 Jason 介紹自己家的寵物，故選 our pets。
5. 依前後文，可知寵物很可愛，因此 (D) 最符合文意。
p:
(On a video call)
Hi, Jason! Can you see me? OK. This is my home. I’m in the living room. ＿1.＿ This is my mom. Her name is Karen. She is a teacher. That is my dad, Chris. He is a doctor. ＿2.＿ is my sister. Her name is Jane. She is a ＿3.＿ in a nice restaurant. And those are ＿4.＿. ＿5.＿ They’re cute and like to play with people. Welcome to my home someday.
video call 視訊通話 can 能 living room 客廳 restaurant 餐廳 with 與……一起 someday 某一天

o: My mom and dad are not at home.
These men are my school teachers.
Who are those people at your home?
They’re big and scary. scary 可怕的
Their names are Peggy and Nikki.

e:
1. 根據空格前句表示「藏禮物」，而後句說明所藏位置，可知此題應是詢問「禮物在哪裡？」。
2. 由於前句提到弟弟們所藏的禮物是兩個機器人，而空格後的名詞 toys 為複數，可知在此是指前述的機器人禮物，要用複數人稱代名詞 they 當主詞，並搭配 be 動詞 are。
3. 由於前句表示「Annie 擁有那支手機將會很高興」，可知此題無需再問「這禮物是給Annie的嗎？」，而是說明手機是來自於父母（送的）。
4. 根據後文表示有一個大蛋糕，可推知廚師是要 Annie 打開「一個盒子」，此處要搭配不定冠詞 a。
p:
Today is Annie’s birthday. Her family are preparing a birthday party for her. They are now at a restaurant. e:
1. family 字尾為「子音 + y」，複數形先去 y 再加 ies；person 的複數形直接在字尾加 s 或用 people。
2. bus 字尾為 s，加 es 形成複數形；car 直接在字尾加 s 形成複數形。
3. woman 的複數形為 women；wife 字尾為 fe，先去 fe 再加 ves 形成複數形。
q:
填入正確的名詞複數形：
1. Those three ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (family) are from Taiwan. They are good ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (person).
2. A：Are these ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (bus)?
B：No, they are ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (car).
3. The two ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (woman) are John’s and Eric’s ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (wife).

e:
1. 由 a monkey 可知是問「什麼」，故第一格要用 What；第二次提到 this 常用 it 代替，故第二格要用 It is 的縮寫 It’s。
2. 由 these 可知主詞為複數，故第一格要用複數 be 動詞 are；由問句可知 sheep 在此為複數，由於 these / those 與 are 不能縮寫，故第二格用 They’re。
3. 由 apple 可知是問「什麼」，故第一格要用 What is 的縮寫 What’s；apple 為單數且為母音開頭，故第二格要用 An。
q:
填入正確的字詞：
1. A：＿＿＿＿＿＿ is this?
B：＿＿＿＿＿＿ a monkey.
2. A：What ＿＿＿＿＿＿ these?
B：＿＿＿＿＿＿ sheep.
3. A：＿＿＿＿＿＿ that? B：＿＿＿＿＿＿ apple.

e:
1. 由 their 可知不只一個女孩，故用 girls’ 表示「女孩們的」。
2. 由 those 可知不只一個男士，而男士的複數形為 men，故用 men’s 表示「男士們的」。
3. 人名 Jones 字尾為 s，可用 Jones’ 或 Jones’s 表示「Jones 的」；Mike 則用 Mike’s 表示「Mike 的」。
q:
填入正確的所有格：
1. Mary is the ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (girl) mother, and I’m their teacher.
2. A：Are you those ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (man) friend?
B：Yes, I am.
3. A：Is your brother at ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (Jones) home?
B：No, he’s at ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (Mike) home.

e:
1. 由 those 可知不只一位「女士」，故用 women’s 表示「女士們的」。
2. 由 Jack 可知男孩為單數，故用 boy’s 表示「男孩的」。
3. 人名 James 字尾為 s，第一格可用 James’ 或 James’s 表示「James 的」。
q:
填入正確的所有格：
1. Mr. Smith is those ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (woman) grandfather.
2. A: What’s the ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (boy) name?
B: Jack.
3. A: Are these ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (James) dogs?
B: No, they’re Jack’s dogs.

e:
1. 由 that 可知為單數，因 orange 為母音開頭，故填入 an orange。
2. 由 be 動詞 are 可知主詞為複數，brush字尾為 sh，加上 es 形成複數形，故填入 brushes。
3. 由 Mark 和 Peter 可知主詞為複數，故要填入 man 的複數形 men，為不規則變化。
q:
填入正確的名詞單複數，不限一字：
1. That’s ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (orange).
2. Our new ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (brush) are in this box.
3. Mark and Peter are nice ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (man).

e:
1. 由 junior high school students 可知為複數名詞，空格用 We 表示「我們」，表示 Leo 跟我。
2. 由 Joe 和 Ben 可知主詞為複數，空格用 they 表示「他們」兩人。
3. 由 Judy 與 I 可知問句是問「你們」兩人，空格要用 you。
q:
填入正確的人稱代名詞：
1. Leo and I are fourteen. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ are junior high school students.
2. A：Are Joe and Ben your sons?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ are.
3. A：Are ＿＿＿＿＿＿ doctors?
B：No, Judy is a nurse, and I’m a cook.

e:
1. mice 為 mouse 的複數形，可知空格要用 those 表示「那些」老鼠。
2. 由 What’s (= What is) 及 It’s (= It is) 可知，空格要用表示單數的 this（這）。
3. 由 dogs 可知主詞為複數，故空格要用複數人稱代名詞 they。
q:
填入 they、this 或 those：
1. Look! Are ＿＿＿＿＿＿ mice cute?
2. What’s ＿＿＿＿＿＿? It’s cool.
3. A：Are dogs your favorite（最喜愛的）animals?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ are.

e: A：Nina 在哪裡？ B：她正在她「臥室」裡睡覺。
q:
A：Where is Nina?
B：She is sleeping in her b＿＿＿m.

e: Robert 不在廚房裡。 他正在「浴室」裡淋浴。
q: Robert is not in the kitchen. He is taking a shower（淋浴）in the b＿＿＿m.

e: A：「請」為我開門。 B：沒問題。
q:
A：P＿＿＿e open the door for me.
B：No problem.

e: A：Cindy，我的狗在哪裡？ B：她正「在」門「前面」睡覺。
q:
A：Where’s my dog, Cindy?
B：She’s sleeping in f＿＿＿t of the door.

e: A：公園在哪裡？ B：「在」動物園和學校「之間」。
q:
A：Where is the park?
B：It’s b＿＿＿n the zoo and the school.

e: 看看那棟大「房子」。Ralph 和 Jane 住在裡面。
q: Look at the big h＿＿＿e. Ralph and Jane live（住）in it.

e: 我妹妹和我不一樣。她很「安靜」，但我很多話。
q: My sister and I are different. She is q＿＿＿t, but I am talkative（多話的）.

e: 你家的新「風格」很棒。我喜歡。
q: The new s＿＿＿e of your house is great. I like it.

e: 我學校不遠。它「在」這裡「附近」。
q: My school is not far（遠的）. It’s n＿＿＿r here.

e: 我有許多來自「世界」各地的娃娃。它們是我的收藏品。
q: I have a lot of（許多的）dolls from around the w______d. They are my collections（收藏品）.

e: 下一班到基隆的公車是十點十分。我們在這裡「等待」吧。
q: The next bus to Keelung（基隆）is at 10:10. Let’s w______t here.

e: A：我們來玩那個桌遊吧！ B：那是個好「點子」。
q:
A：Let’s play that board game（桌遊）!
B：That’s a good i______a.

e: 他們「圍繞」著公園走並享受景色。這是個美好的夜晚。
q: They are walking a______d the park and enjoying（享受）the view（景色）. It’s a beautiful night.

e: Zack 不在他的臥房。他正在「客廳」和他父母講話。
q: Zack isn’t in his bedroom. He is talking（講話）to his parents in the l______g room.

e: 這是「飯廳」。我在這裡吃早餐和午餐。
q: This is the d______g room. I eat breakfast（早餐）and lunch here.

e: 往後看。Jeff 正在你的「後面」。
q: Look back（向後）. Jeff is right b______d you.

e: 你可以從那個網站上「得到」一些好主意。
q: You can（可以）g______t some good ideas from the website（網站）.

e: 我有「一些」糖果，但不是太多。
q: I have s______e candies（糖果）, but not too many.

e: 我們用這個「工具」打開這個大箱子吧。
q: Let’s open the big box with this t______l.

e: 不要在教室裡使用你的智慧型手機。
q: Don’t use（使用）your s______e in the classroom.

e: A：「步驟」一，選擇一個主題。 B：接下來呢？
q:
A：S______p one, choose a theme.
B：What’s next?

e: 你可以在此「上傳」照片。
q: You can（可以）u______d photos here.

e: A：這張舊「照片」裡的人是誰？ B：那是我的祖父。
q:
A：Who is that in the old p______o?
B：That’s my grandfather.

e: A：Joe，過來「選」一個新玩具。 B：我可以要那個機器人嗎？
q:
A：Come here and c______e a new toy, Joe.
B：Can（可以）I have that robot?

e: A：這是什麼「種類」的狗？ B：是柯基犬。
q:
A：What t______e of dog is this?
B：It’s the corgi（柯基犬）.

e: A：這部電影的「主題」是什麼？ B：是家庭。
q:
A：What’s the t______e of the movie?
B：It’s family.

e: 我「和」我的父母和我妹妹住在一起。
q: I live（住）w______h my parents and my sister.

e: A：這個尺寸「對」你「來說」還可以嗎？ B：是的。它看起來很好。

q:

Sharon：Do you know（認識）that new student?

e: 由「正在煮菜」，可推知是在「廚房」。

e: 由「爸爸在我的右邊，媽媽在我的左邊」，可推知我在他們的「中間」。

e: 由「可以走路到那裡」，可推知公園在家「附近」。

e: 這些牡蠣殼很「硬」。你可以用刀打開它們。
q: The oyster shells（牡蠣殼）are ______. You can（可以）open them with a knife（刀）.

q: My grandparents live（住）in the mountains（山）. There are（有）trees ______ their house.

e: 由「她不喜歡說話」，可推知 Sue 是位「安靜的」女生。

e: 由後一句「它很酷」及「鞋子」，可推知是鞋子的「款式」。

e: 由「今天一起去動物園吧」，可推知對方會回覆那是個好「主意」。
q:
A：Let’s go to the zoo today.

e: 由「從那部電影中」及「許多好點子」可推知，可以從中「取得」許多好點子。
q: You can（可以）______ a lot of（許多的）great ideas from that movie.

e: 由「動物照片」，可推知Sharon 正在找「一些」照片。
q: Sharon is looking for（找）______ pictures of animals. She needs（需要）them in a report（報告）.

e: 由「麵包不硬」可推知，它是「軟的」。

q: This is not the right ______ to open the door. No wonder you can’t（無法）open it.

e: 由「它不是一隻貓」和「它是一隻小老虎」可知應選具有補充說明語氣的片語「事實上」。
q: It’s not a cat. ______, it is a little（小的）tiger.

e: 由「天氣冷」可推知，是要對方用這條「毛毯」蓋住身體。
q: It’s cold. Cover（蓋）your body（身體）with this ______.

e: 由「只有三……」和「第一……」可推知，在講「步驟」。
q:
A：It’s an easy（簡單的）game. There are（有）only three ______.

e: 由「照片」和「……到雲端」，可推知「上傳」照片到雲端。
q: Please ______ the photos to the cloud（雲端）.

e: 由「她看起來又年輕又美麗」可推知，應是詢問「照片」中的女人是誰。
q: Who is the woman in the ______? She looks（看起來）young and beautiful.

e: 由 B 詢問「那這個如何」可推知，A 請 B 一同「選擇」一個遊戲玩。
q:

e: 由「這是一頂鴨舌帽」可推知，A 詢問 B 這是什麼「種類」的帽子。
q:

B：It’s a cap.

e: 這部電影的「主題」是家庭。這是一部悲傷的電影。
q: The ＿＿＿ of（……的）this movie is family. It’s a sad movie.

e: 由「我無法跑太快」可推知，應是請對方「等等」我。
q: Hey, ______ for me. I can’t（無法）run too fast（快地）.

e: 我媽媽坐在我的老師「旁邊」。他們正在談論我。
q: My mom is sitting（坐）＿＿＿ my teacher. They are talking（談論）about me.

e: 我兒子們正在吃午餐。他們「在」飯廳「裡面」。
q: My sons are having lunch. They are ______ the dining room.

e: 今天很熱。我想要一些「冰塊」在我的果汁裡。
q: It’s hot today. I want some ＿＿＿ in my juice.

e: A：這鞋子「對」你「來說」可以嗎？它們是否太大？ B：它們很棒。
q:
A：Are you OK ＿＿＿ the shoes? Are they too big?
B：They are great.

e: 我有一些「問題」想問你。現在你有空回答它們嗎？
q: I have some ＿＿＿ for you. Are you free（有空的）to answer（回答）them now?

e: 由 B 反問「她不在廚房嗎？」，可推知 A 問 Amanda「在哪裡」，疑問詞用 Where。
q:
A：＿＿＿ is Amanda?
B：Isn’t she in the kitchen?
A：No. She’s not there.

e: 選項中適當的介系詞只有 on 或 under，由答句可知玩具在桌子下面，故用 on。

A：Is my toy ＿＿＿ the table?

e: 由 B 回答「在椅子後面」，可推知 A 問「在哪裡」，疑問詞用 Where；mice 為複數名詞，應搭配複數 be 動詞 are。
q: A：＿＿＿ the mice? B：Behind the chair.

e: 選項中能填入空格的介系詞有 near 和 in，由前句可知「鳥不在籠子裡面」，故介系詞用 near。
q: The bird is not in the cage（籠子）. It’s ＿＿＿ the cage.

e: 表「在 A 與 B 中間」用「between A and B」。
q: Sam is standing（站）＿＿＿ John ＿＿＿ Daniel. They are good friends.

e: 由 B 回答 Yes. 可知，我家前面有一個公園，也就是公園在我家「後面」。
q:
A：Is there（有）a park in front of your house?
B：Yes. My house is ＿＿＿ the park.

e: 由後句「停車。」可知，前句為「一隻熊在我們車子的前面」。
q: Look! A bear is ＿＿＿ our car. Stop（停下）the car.

e: 由後句 they 可知，sheep 為複數；問「在哪裡」，疑問詞用 Where，且空格後無動詞，故用 Where are。

q:
A：Where are the ＿＿＿?

q: The bus stop（站牌）is ＿＿＿ of the park. Look! A bus is coming.

q: The bathroom is next to the living room, and the living room is ＿＿＿ the dining room. So（所以）, the living room is between the bathroom ＿＿＿ the dining room.

A：Where’s the park? Is it ＿＿＿ your home?
B：Yes, it’s three blocks（街區）from my home.

e: wait here 表「在此等候」；quiet 為形容詞，前面要搭配 be 動詞的原形 be。
q: Students, please wait ＿＿＿ here and ＿＿＿ quiet. Thank you.

e: 不要站「在」門口，介系詞用 at。
q: Come on in, Peter. Don’t stand（站）＿＿＿ the door.

e: 由回答「地點」，可知第一格問「在哪裡」，疑問詞用 Where；由回答「人名」，可知第二格問「誰」，疑問詞用 Who。
q:
A：＿＿＿ are the teachers?
B：They are in the meeting room（會議室）. ＿＿＿ are you looking for（找）?
A：Mrs. Lin.

e: 「Jeff 和他的朋友」為複數，故用複數 be 動詞 are；表「在戲院裡面」用 In。
q:
A：Where ＿＿＿ Jeff and his friend?
B：＿＿＿ the theater.

e: 由「我的原子筆在鉛筆盒裡。鉛筆盒在我的袋子裡。」可知，原子筆「在我的袋子裡」。
q: My pen is in the pencil box. And the pencil box is in my bag. So（所以）, my pen is ＿＿＿ my bag.

e: 由「正在修理電視」，可推測他們「在電視後面」，用介系詞 behind。
q:
A：Where are Ms. Wang and Judy?
B：They are ＿＿＿ the TV. They’re fixing（修理）it.

e: 在床「下方」，用介系詞 under。
q:
A：Where is your dog?
B：It’s ＿＿＿ the bed. Look! It’s sleeping there.

e: it 為單數名詞，須用單數 be 動詞 Is 或 Isn’t；在包包裡，用介系詞 in。
q:
A：Where is my smartphone?
B：＿＿＿ it ＿＿＿ your bag?
A：Oops. Thank you.

e: 由 B 回答兩個地點，可推知家「在」學校和公園的「中間」，故用 between。
q:
A：Where is your home?
B：It is ＿＿＿ my school and the park.

e: 由 Yes 可知，Billy 的座位在 Fred 的座位前面，所以 Fred 的座位在 Billy 的座位「後面」。
q:
Gina：Where is your seat（座位）? Isn’t Billy’s seat in front of your seat?
Fred：Yes, my seat is ＿＿＿ Billy’s seat.

e: 問東西「在哪裡」，疑問詞用 Where；on 表「在……上面」。
q:
Mrs. Lee：＿＿＿ are my books?
Mr. Lee：Aren’t they ＿＿＿ your desk?

e: 包包在書的上面，所以書「在」包包的「下面」。
q: Lily’s bag is on her book. So（所以）, her book is ＿＿＿ her bag.

e: 公園在電影院和學校的中間，所以學校「在」公園的「旁邊」。
q: The park is between a movie theater and a school. When（當）you see the school, you can（可以）see the park ＿＿＿ it.

e: in 表「在……裡面」；on 表「在……上面」。
q:
A：I can’t find（找不到）my key. It’s not ＿＿＿ my bag.
B：Look! It’s ＿＿＿ the floor（地板）.
A：Oh, it’s under the chair.

e: 在臥室和浴室「中間」，介系詞要用 between。
q:
Amy：Isn’t the living room next to the kitchen?
Ben：No, it’s ＿＿＿ the bedroom and the bathroom.

e: please 的否定句型有「人名, please＋don’t＋原形動詞...」、「Please＋don’t＋原形動詞…, 人名.」或「人名, don’t＋原形動詞..., please.」。
q: ＿＿＿ on the bus. It’s dangerous（危險的）.

e: 由「我的臥室在房子的後方」，可以推知房間是在廚房的「後面」。
q: My bedroom is ＿＿＿ the kitchen. It’s in the back（後面）of the house.

e: 由人名後加逗點可知，本句為祈使句，要用原形動詞；而 and 連接兩個相同的動詞形式。
q: Joseph, ＿＿＿ a good student and ＿＿＿ nice to your friends.

e: (B) 須改為 between my sons；(C) 須改為 next to the door；(D) 須改為 at the door，只有 behind you「在你的後面」正確。
q:
A：Where’s your daughter?
B：She’s ＿＿＿.

e: 由「我們可以走路到那裡」可推知，公園在住家「附近」，故選 near；(D) 須改為 next to。
q: Happy Park is ＿＿＿ my home. We can（可以）walk there.

e: good 為形容詞，前面要搭配 be 動詞的原形 be；後句表勿在圖書館奔跑「或」玩樂，故用對等連接詞 or。
q: Girls, please ＿＿＿ good. Don’t run ＿＿＿ play in the library（圖書館）.

e: please 可置於句首或句尾，置於句尾時 please 前須加逗號；稱呼語也可放句首或句尾，但皆須加逗點與句子隔開。
q: ＿＿＿ write your names on the cards ＿＿＿.

e: let’s 引導的否定祈使句句型為「Let’s＋not＋原形動詞...」；or 為對等連接詞，連接兩個相同的動詞形式。
q: Let’s ＿＿＿ talk（說話）or ＿＿＿ in class. It’s not nice.

e: 祈使句以原形動詞開頭，而後句為說話對象不照做的結果，故用 or 表「否則」。
q: Brenda, ＿＿＿ to the dining table now, ＿＿＿ your lunch will（將會）get cold.

e: please 放在祈使句句尾的句型為「Be＋形容詞..., please.」。
q: Shh, Leo, we’re in the museum（博物館）. Be quiet, ＿＿＿.

e: 由省略主詞 you 可知是祈使句，且句中已有原形動詞，因此在句首加 please。
q: Good morning, Sam. ＿＿＿ have a seat（座位）.

e: please 放在否定祈使句句首的句型為「Please don’t＋原形動詞...」；後句句中沒有動詞，故用 That is 的縮寫 That’s。
q:
A：＿＿＿ draw on the desk. ＿＿＿ not nice.
B：Sorry.

e: let’s 引導的否定句型為「Let’s＋not＋原形動詞...」；第二格的後面接形容詞，故句型為「Let’s be＋形容詞.」。
q: ＿＿＿ talk（說話）in class. ＿＿＿ quiet.

e: 由人名後面用逗點可知，此句為祈使句，而句中已有原形動詞，故在動詞前加 please。
q: Linda, ＿＿＿ read the story（故事）. Thank you.

e: 否定祈使句的句型為「Don’t＋原形動詞...」。
q: ＿＿＿ drink iced water（冰水）in the morning. It’s not good for you.

e: let’s 引導的否定句型為「Let’s＋not＋原形動詞...」。
q: ＿＿＿ open the book. Let’s listen（聽）to the CD first（首先）.

e: 「等候某人／物」為 wait for sb / sth；否定祈使句的句型為「Don’t＋原形動詞...」。
q: Wait ＿＿＿ your teacher and ＿＿＿ run around, students.

e: 否定祈使句的句型為「Don’t＋原形動詞...」。
q: ＿＿＿ jump on the bed, Tom. It’s not nice.

e: let’s 引導的句型為「Let’s＋原形動詞...」；而 and 連接兩個相同的動詞形式，故 go 和 have 都用原形。
q: Today is Children’s Day, son. Let’s ＿＿＿ to the zoo and ＿＿＿ some fun（樂趣）.

e: 否定祈使句的句型為「Don’t＋原形動詞...」；let’s 引導的句型為「Let’s＋原形動詞...」。
q: Please don’t ＿＿＿ sad. Let’s ＿＿＿ some games.

e: 由複數名詞 blankets 可知，前面應用複數 be 動詞 are；please 放在祈使句句首的句型為「Please＋原形動詞...」。
q:
A：Where ＿＿＿ my blankets?
B：Hmm... please ＿＿＿ here.

e: let’s 引導的否定句型為「Let’s not＋原形動詞...」。or 為對等連接詞，連接兩個相同的動詞形式，故 watch 和 play 都用原形。
q: The baby（嬰兒）is sleeping. Let’s ＿＿＿ play or ＿＿＿ TV in the living room.

e: 表示「不要做……」用「Don’t＋原形動詞...」；quiet 為形容詞，前面須加 be 動詞的原形 be 來形成祈使句。
q: Don’t ＿＿＿, Johnny. Please ＿＿＿ quiet in the classroom.

e: 用祈使句表達「兩動作都不要做」時，用連接詞 or。
q: Please don’t eat ＿＿＿ drink on the bus.

e: 祈使句的動詞須使用原形，且此句缺少動詞，因此句首用原形動詞 have。
q: Welcome to ABC Theme Park. ＿＿＿ fun（樂趣）.

e: 第一句是祈使句，須使用原形動詞；表「在……前面」用 in front of。
q: ＿＿＿! A bear is in front ＿＿＿ the house.

e: your brother 是第三人稱單數男性，所以主格用 He；而 with 後要接受詞，所以受格用 him。
q:
A：Where is your brother?
B：＿＿＿ in the living room. Tina is playing with ＿＿＿.

e: a cat 為單數名詞，故代名詞受格為 it。後句亦須用單數主格作主詞。
q: There’s（有）a cat under the tree. Look at ＿＿＿. ＿＿＿ so cute!

e: Mina 為女性，代名詞受格用 her。
q: Mina likes dolls. Let’s choose a doll for ＿＿＿.

e: 由句意可知，說話者是要 Winnie 先去劇院，故用 please go。Let’s 意為「我們一起……」，但依句意不應含說話者本人；而「我們」的受格形式為 us。
q: Winnie, ＿＿＿ to the theater first（首先）. Don’t wait for ＿＿＿.

e: 由第三人稱複數 they 可知，第一格要用複數名詞 brothers；而 with 後要接受詞，故第二格用第三人稱複數受格 them。
q: They are Diana’s ＿＿＿. I’m playing with ＿＿＿.

e: 主詞為第三人稱單數女性，故第一格應填 She’s，第二格填所有格 Her。
q:
A：Who is that tall girl?
B：＿＿＿ Mr. and Mrs. Smith’s daughter. ＿＿＿ name is Helen.

e: 「Ben 和 Peggy」兩人的所有格為 their。
q:
A：Are Ben and Peggy your students?
B：Yes, I’m ＿＿＿ English teacher.

e: 由 The tea room、black tea 及 thirsty可知，A 說的應是「我們喝些紅茶吧」，用 Let’s。
q:
A：The tea room is over there. ＿＿＿ have some black tea.
B：Great. I’m thirsty（口渴的）.

e: 介系詞 for 後面要接受格；由 son 可知，要用第三人稱單數男性的受格 him。
q:
A：Wow. A big cake!
B：Yeah. It’s my son’s birthday（生日）. The cake is for ＿＿＿.

e: 祈使句在原形動詞前加上 don’t 即形成否定；而第二句缺少動詞，故用 It is 的縮寫 It’s。
q: ＿＿＿ drink the tea on the table. ＿＿＿ very hot.

e: 表「別做……」用「Don’t＋原形動詞...」；表「我們不要做……。」，用「Let’s not＋原形動詞...」。
q: These are not our photos. ＿＿＿ upload them to Instagram.

e: 由 B 的回覆為某個地點的位置可推知，問句是詢問「在哪裡」。
q:
A：______
B：It’s in a tall building（建築物）, and the building is near a park.
o: Who is the man in front of the school?

e: 由 A 問「這是什麼地方？」可推知，B 要回答該地方的名稱。
q:
A：What is this place（地方）?
B：______ Its design（設計）is special（特別的）.

e: 由兩人分享同間房間可推測，最合適的描述應為「Elsie 的床就在 Irene 的床旁邊。」
q: Elsie and Irene are sisters, and they share（分享）one room. ______
o: Their beds are in different rooms.
Elsie’s bed is next to Irene’s bed.

e: 由 A 詢問 B 的睡眠品質，以及 B 回答自己背痛可推知，答句應是「床很硬。」
q:
A：How was（is 的過去式）your sleep?
B：______ My back hurts（背痛）now.
o: I have a good night’s sleep.

e: 由 A 詢問 B「浴室在哪裡？」可推知，B 應回答浴室的「位置」，符合文意的只有「它在廚房跟客廳中間」。
q:
A：Excuse me（不好意思）. Where is the bathroom?
B：______
A：OK. Thank you.
o: It’s under the bed in the bedroom.
It’s between the kitchen and the living room.

e: A 詢問 B「Jenny 的座位在哪裡？」B 回答「它在 Hank 旁邊。」A 又問 B「你確定嗎？Dora 的座位在 Hank 的座位旁邊。」B 回答「喔，抱歉。Jenny 的座位在 Hank 的座位後面」。
q:
A：______
B：It is next to Hank’s seat（座位）.
A：Are you sure（確定的）? Dora’s seat is next to Hank’s seat.
B：Oh, sorry. ;JENny’s seat is behind Hank’s seat.

e: A 詢問 B「Judy 和 Kevin 在客廳嗎？」B 回答「不，他們不在。他們在飯廳。現在是午餐時間。」
q:
A：Are Judy and Kevin in the living room?
B：No, they’re not. ______ It’s time（時間）for lunch now.

e: 由問句可知，回答中須有「地點」。而 Ann 不在學校，「她在她的房間裡。」
q:
A：Isn’t Ann at school?
B：＿＿＿
o: Yes, she is in the kitchen.
No, she’s not in her room.

e: A 找不到手錶，而下一句則是對 B 表達感謝，可推知 B 告訴 A「手錶不是在桌上嗎？」。
q:
A：I can’t find（找不到）my watch.
B：＿＿＿
A：Oh, yes. Thank you.

e: 由 A 提醒 B 別忘了帶智慧型手機及 B 對 A 表示感謝，可推知 A 告訴 B 智慧型手機在書桌上。
q:
A：Don’t forget（忘記）your smartphone. ＿＿＿
B：Thanks.

e: A：我妹妹不在她房間。她在「浴室」裡。 B：她在那裡做什麼？ A：她正在幫狗洗澡。
q:
A：My sister is not in her room. She’s ______.
B：What is she doing there?
A：She’s washing the dog.

e: 兒子：媽媽，我的智慧型手機在哪裡？它不在臥室、客廳或廚房。 媽媽：「它在你的包包裡。」 兒子：謝謝。難怪我找不到它。
q:
Son：Where is my smartphone, Mom? It’s not in the bedroom, the living room, or the kitchen.
Mom：______
Son：Thanks. No wonder I can’t find（找不到）it.

e: 由 B 回答「我正在尋找我的手錶」及 A 的回覆「喔，不。它很貴的！」可知，B 找不到手錶。
q:
A：What are you doing in my room?
B：I’m looking for（尋找）my watch. ______, and it’s not in my bag, either（也不）.
A：Oh, no. It’s very expensive!
o: It’s between the door and the bed

e: A：「Amanda 在哪裡？」 B：她在廚房裡。 A：謝謝。我將會去那裡找她。
q:
A：______
B：She is in the kitchen.
A：Thanks. I’ll（將會）go find（找）her there.

e: A： Mike 在廚房裡。「那你的堂姐呢？」 B：她在學校。
q:
A：Mike is in the kitchen. ______
B：She’s at school.

e: A 說「醒醒。爺爺在哪？」B 回答「他不是在電視機前面嗎？」A 回應「不，他現在不在家。」
q:
A：Wake up（醒醒）. Where’s Grandpa?
B：Isn’t he ______?
A：No, he isn’t at home now.

e: A：爸爸在房子裡面嗎？ B：「不，他在房子前面。」他正在洗車。
q:
A：Is Dad inside the house?
B：______ He’s washing the car.
o: No, he’s in the living room.
No, he’s in front of the house.

e: 由 A 回應「哇，他很年輕」可推知，前一句是描述年紀。
q:
A：Look at that tall man. Who’s he?
B：He’s Jason’s cousin. He’s ______.
A：Wow, he’s young. Where is he from?
B：The USA（美國）.

e: 由後句「在桌子下還是桌子後面」，可推知前句應與詢問「位置」有關。而從語意及 it 為第三人稱單數主詞，故選 (B)。
q: ______ Is it under the table or behind the table?

e: 由後句「他們很刻薄」，可推知前句是「你的哥哥和妹妹人不好」。
q: ______ They are mean（刻薄的）.
o: Your brother and sister aren’t nice.
Joe’s sister is my good friend.
Those beds are big and soft.

e: 由後句可推知前句是詢問某個特定的場所。
q: ______ Is it a zoo?
o: What is the place（地方）in the picture?

e: 由後句「去那裡洗你的手」，可推知前句與浴室相關。
q: ______ Go there and wash your hands（手）.
o: The living room is beautiful and big.
This is my bedroom in my uncle’s home.
My new car is in front of the house.
The bathroom is next to the dining room.

e: 由「Daniel 的女兒不是在 Leo 前面」，可推知後句是在描述她的位置。
q: Daniel’s daughter isn’t in front of Leo. She’s ______.

e: 由後句「他現在正在看電視」可知，主詞為單數的男性；且符合文意的只有「John 在客廳裡」。
q: ______ He’s watching TV now.
o: The dog is on the TV.
Mrs. Brown is behind the TV.
John is in the living room.

e: 由 A 說「我把智慧型手機遺留在教室裡」可知，B 最有可能的回答是「我們去教室拿吧」。
q:
(On the bus)
A：Oh, no! I left（遺留）my smartphone in the classroom.
B：It’s OK. ＿＿＿
o: Let’s go to the classroom and take it.

e: 由「媽媽，我很抱歉」可知，媽媽應是說「不要在廚房玩」；而由媽媽接著要 Henry 去浴室洗手可知，選項 (D) 不符文意。
q:
Mom：Henry, ＿＿＿.
Henry：I’m sorry, Mom.
Mom：OK. Go to the bathroom and wash your hands（手）now. The lunch is on the table.
o: this is a toy for you

e: 由「別在這裡奔跑」可知，Miss Chen 要 Peter「聽話，當個好學生」的可能性最大。
q:
Miss Chen：＿＿＿ Don’t run here.
Peter：OK, Miss Chen.

e: 由 A 詢問 B「是什麼（事）？」可知，B 最有可能回答「不要在車上飲食」。
q:
A：Your new car is cool. Let’s go for a ride（兜風）.
B：No problem, but there’s one thing（有一件事）.
A：What is it?
B：＿＿＿
o: Don’t eat or drink in the car.

e: 由「那是給 Jason 的」及「你的果汁在黃色杯子裡」可知，前句應是說「不要喝紅色杯子裡的果汁」。
q: ＿＿＿ That’s for Jason. Your juice is in the yellow cup.
o: Where is the juice from? It’s good.
Don’t drink the juice in the red cup.
Please drink some juice on the table.

e: 由「媽媽昂貴的杯子壞掉了」可知，B 應是說「我們去告訴她吧」。
q:
A：Oh, no! Mom’s expensive cup is broken（壞掉的）.
B：＿＿＿
o: Yes, it is a sad theme.

e: 由 A 說「很熱」及 B 回答「沒問題」可知，A 最可能是跟 B 說「請打開門」以通風。
q: A：＿＿＿ It’s very hot. B：No problem.
o: Look at the woman at the door.
Don’t run in the living room.

e: 由「你可能會迷路」可知，媽媽應是要兒子「不要亂跑」。
q:
Mom：Hey! ＿＿＿. You might（可能）get lost（迷路）.
Son：OK, Mom.

e: 由 B 道歉可知他做了不好的行為，故 A 要 B「別在書上寫東西或畫圖」最合理。
q:
A：Hey! ＿＿＿ That’s not OK.
B：I’m sorry.
A：Don’t do that again. Those aren’t your books.
o: Please wait for your teacher here.
Let’s read this book about animals.
The books are on the desk, right?
Don’t write or draw in the books.

e: 在廚房裡要注意的是「不要奔跑或玩耍」。
q:
A：Tony, ＿＿＿ in the kitchen. That’s not nice.
B：No problem, Dad.

e: 那個遊樂場是 Jeff 跟 Amy 最喜愛的地方。Jeff 喜歡盪「秋千」，Amy 喜歡溜滑梯。
q: The playground is Jeff and Amy’s favorite place（最喜愛的地方）. Jeff likes to play on the ＿＿＿, and Amy likes to play on the slide.

e: A：Kay 跟 Tina 在哪裡？他們不在房子裡。 B：喔，他們正在公園玩「蹺蹺板」。
q:
A：Where are Kay and Tina? They are not in the house.
B：Oh, they are playing on the ＿＿＿ in the park.

e: 「籃子」裡有蘋果、柳橙、跟香蕉。你想要哪一個？
q: There’s an apple, an orange, and a banana in the ＿＿＿. Which（哪一個）do you want?

e: 她爸媽還在上班，可知 Tim 的姐姐必須「放學後」煮晚餐。
q: Tim’s big sister has to（必須）cook dinner ＿＿＿ tonight. Her parents are still at work（在上班）.

e: 由前句表達太陽很大，可推知後句為「我們在那棵樹下休息吧」。
q: The sun is shining brightly（明亮地）. Let’s ＿＿＿ under the tree.

e: 由說明字義可知，問句為 hungry 這個字是什麼「意思」。
q:
A：What’s the ＿＿＿ of the word（字）, hungry?
B：Wanting or needing food（需要食物）.

e: 由這間書店很受歡迎可知，店員很「友善」。
q: The clerk（店員）is ＿＿＿. No wonder the bookstore（書店）is popular（受歡迎的）.

e: 由後句可以去衝浪或潛水可知，前句表達有很多有趣的「事情」可以做。
q: There are a lot of fun（有趣的）＿＿＿ to do in Kenting. You can go surfing（衝浪）or diving（潛水）there.

e: 臺北 101 為臺北有名的「建築物」。
q: Taipei 101 is a famous（有名的）＿＿＿ in Taipei. It’s 382 meters tall.

e: 由 I’m new here. 可推知，要對方「帶他到處參觀」。
q:
A：I’m new here. Could you ＿＿＿?
B：No problem.

e: 由 Where is my hat? 可推知，「找」不到帽子。
q:
A：Where is my hat? I can’t ＿＿＿ it.
B：Isn’t it on your head（頭）?

e: 由報警可推知，上句詢問對方「外面」那個奇怪的男子是誰。
q:
A：Who is the strange（奇怪的）man ＿＿＿?
B：I have no idea. Let’s call the police（報警）.

e: 語意上有轉折，故用副詞 however 連接。
q: Tina and Jay have a lot of work to do. ＿＿＿, they still go to bed on time.

e: 由前句表達不應該對 Mia 那麼說可推知，後句表你在「想」什麼。
q: You should（應該）not say that to Mia. What are you ＿＿＿?

e: 由答句 there isn’t 可知，問句也要用 there 問；否定 Yes / No 問句與肯定的回答方式一樣，且由答句 isn’t 可知，第二格用 No。
q:
A：Isn’t ＿＿＿ a black cat behind the door?
B：＿＿＿, there isn’t.

e: 由 or 可知要連接兩個複數名詞，故第二格用 apples；由 any 可知為否定句，且 apples / bananas 為複數，故第一格用縮寫 aren’t。
q: There ＿＿＿ any ＿＿＿ or bananas in the box. In fact, the box is empty（空的）.

e: 肯定句用 some，否定句用 any。
q: There are ＿＿＿ sandwiches in the bag, but there isn’t ＿＿＿ juice in it.

e: sheep 為單複數同形的字，但由 some 可知要搭配複數 be 動詞，故第一格可用 Are 或 Aren’t；由 one 可知要搭單數 be 動詞，故第二格用 there is 或縮寫 there’s。
q:
A：＿＿＿ there some sheep on the farm（農場）?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿ one.

e: 由複數 be 動詞 Are 可知，第一格可用複數名詞 bears、tigers 或 goats；由 No 可知為否定簡答，故第二格要用 aren’t。
q:
A：Are there any ＿＿＿ in the zoo?
B：No, there ＿＿＿.

e: 由單數名詞 car 可知，第一格要搭配單數 be 動詞 is；由 my uncle’s car 可知，是在講前面提到的那部車，故第二格用that’s。
q:
A：There ＿＿＿ a cool car in front of your house.
B：Oh, ＿＿＿ my uncle’s car.

e: 由單數名詞 clock 及母音開頭的 old 可知，第一格要用 an；there is 在肯定簡答中不能縮寫。
q:
A：Isn’t there ＿＿＿ old clock on the desk?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿. It’s from my grandfather.

e: 由 two 可知 be 動詞應用 are；restroom 是公共廁所，故選 (B)。
q: There ＿＿＿ two ＿＿＿ in my house. One is beside the kitchen, and the other is in the front of the house.

e: 商店裡「有」許多漂亮的手錶。
q: ＿＿＿ are a lot of beautiful watches in the shop（商店）.

e: There is / are 為固定用法，後面是複數名詞 some people，故用 are。
q: There ＿＿＿ some people in the gym. What are they doing there?

e: 由答句說明有三隻可知，問句不可選 three 或 some；又若用 any 問時。答句會回答 Yes。
q:
A：Are there lions in the picture?
B：No, there are three.

e: There is / are 為固定用法，juice 為不可數名詞，用單數 is；some apples 為複數名詞，be 動詞則用 are。
q:
A：＿＿＿ there any juice in the refrigerator（冰箱）?
B：No, but there ＿＿＿ some apples. I can make some apple juice for you if（如果）you want.

e: There is / are 為固定用法，milk 與 juice 皆為不可數名詞，故 be 動詞用 is。
q:
A：＿＿＿ there any milk in the kitchen?
B：No, but there ＿＿＿ some juice.

e: Are there… 為固定用法，表「有沒有……？」主詞仍用 there，第二句主詞則用 They 代替已提及的 horses。
q:
Sherry：Are any horses here?
Liz：No. in the horse stable（馬廄）.

e: 由回答 Yes 可知應選 (A)。
q:
A：Aren’t there any eggs at home?
B：Yes, there are in the fridge（冰箱）.

e: Is there 後接未限定的「a / an / one＋單數可數名詞」或「any＋不可數名詞（如 cake）」。
q: Is there ?
o: my book bag in the bedroom
the cute cat on the bed
any cake on the dining table

e: There is / are... 表達「有……」，be 動詞單複數視後面的名詞而定，由 a lot of 可知 sheep 在此為複數，要搭配複數 be 動詞 are。
q: The farm（農場）is very big. There ＿＿＿ a lot of sheep on it.

e: There is / are... 表達「有……」，be 動詞單複數視後面的名詞而定，fish 在此為複數，又表示否定，故選 (A)。
q: The river（河）is dirty（髒的）. There any fish in it.

e: 由 What is there… 可知問句問箱子裡「有」什麼，表達「有……」用 There is / are...。
q:
A：What is there in the box?
B： I have no idea. Hey, what’s that sound（聲音）? Ha. I got it.

e: 由 empty 可知籠子中沒有老鼠，且 mice 為 mouse 的複數形。
q: There ＿＿＿ mice in the cage（籠子）. It’s empty（空的）.

e: 由 Yes, there is one. 可知，問句是問客廳裡是否有「任何」椅子。
q: A：Are there ＿＿＿ chairs in the living room? B：Yes, there is one.

e: 由第二句「它們是給你和你的兄弟的。」可知，書桌上「有」禮物，故用 some 表示「一些的」。
q: There are ＿＿＿ gifts（禮物）on the desk. They are for you and your brothers.

e: 由問句 Is there...? 與答句的 Yes 可知，答句也要用 there is 回答，故第一格用 there；由 cute 可知，是形容前面提到的 monkey，故第二格用代名詞 It。
q:
A：Is there a monkey in the tree?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿ is. ＿＿＿ is cute.

e: 由答句 Yes, there are sixty fish in it. 可知 (A) 和 (B) 的數量皆不合語意，另外 fish 在此為複數，因此 (A) 和 (C) 的 be 動詞不正確。
q:
A：＿＿＿ there ＿＿＿ fish in the pond（池塘）?
B：Yes, there are sixty fish in it.

e: 由單數名詞 man 可知第一格用 There is 或縮寫 There’s；由複數名詞 dogs 可知第二格用 There are。
q: ＿＿＿ a man in front of the library. Look! ＿＿＿ two dogs behind him.

e: 由複數名詞 people 可知要用複數 be 動詞 are，且由 any 可知為否定句，故 are 之後須接 not。
q: It’s very dark（昏暗的）. There ＿＿＿ any people at the park now.

e: There is / are（有……）為固定用法，後面是複數名詞 some students，故用 There are。第二句中的學生是受格，故用 them。
q: ＿＿＿ some students in the classroom. Ms. Lin is teaching（教）＿＿＿ math.

e: There is / are 為固定用法，後面是複數名詞 forty students，故用 are；students 為第三人稱複數，須用代名詞 They。
q: There ＿＿＿ forty students in Ms. Lin’s class. ＿＿＿ are all boys.

e: 由答句 It’s cool, right? 可知問句並非是問「有沒有」，而是詢問「車子是否是 B 的」，句型可用Is that / this 或是 Isn’t that / this。
q:
A： your car in front of the park?
B：Yes. It’s cool, right?

e: 樹已經死亡，故選 No, there isn’t.。
q:
A：Isn’t there an apple tree beside your house?
B： It died（死亡）, and we cut it down（砍下）last year.

e: There is / are（有……）為固定用法，疑問句 be 動詞須移到句首，後面是不可數名詞 hot water，須用單數 be 動詞 is。
q:
A：＿＿＿ any hot water（水）in the kitchen?
B：No, ＿＿＿.

e: There is / are（有……）為固定用法，疑問句 be 動詞須移到句首，後面是複數可數名詞，故用 Are there，回答用否定句 there aren’t。
q:
A：＿＿＿ any fruit（水果）trees in front of your house?
B：No, ＿＿＿, but there are some cherry blossom（櫻花）trees.

e: There is / are（有……）為固定用法，疑問句 be 動詞須移到句首，且後面是單數名詞 an egg，故選 Is there。
q:
A：＿＿＿ an egg in the refrigerator（冰箱）?
B：No, there are two.

e: 第一句的主詞為 gyms 故用 are；第二句的主詞為 a basketball court 故用 is。
q: There two gyms near my school, and there a basketball court between them.

e: Aren’t there 的疑問句，回答時也要用 there are，否定句用 there are not。
q:
A：Aren’t there two balls on the table?
B：No, ＿＿＿.

e: There is / are（有……）為固定用法，後面是複數名詞 two girls，故選 There are。
q:
A：＿＿＿ two girls over there. Are they waiting for you?
B：Yes. They are my sisters.

e: 由 B 回答「但是公園附近有一間」可推測，這附近「沒有」電影院。
q:
A：Isn’t there a movie theater near here?
B：＿＿＿, but there is one near the park.

e: There is 後接單數名詞，而單數名詞前須加冠詞 a(n)。
q: Yuck! There is ＿＿＿ under the dining table.

e: any 可用於疑問句或否定句。
q:
A：Are there ＿＿＿ students in the gym?
B：No, there aren’t ＿＿＿ students there.

e: 由複數的 parks 可知，必須搭配複數 be 動詞 are；由 a senior high school 可知，必須搭配單數 be 動詞 is。
q: There two parks on this road, and there a senior high school between them.

e: any 用於疑問句，且根據後方答句可知，問句應是問這附近是否有「任何」圖書館。
q:
A：Are there libraries around here?
B：Yes, there is one near the movie theater.

e: 從答句「我們用走的去動物園吧」可推知，這附近「沒有」任何公車站。bus stops 為複數名詞，故選 There aren’t。
q:
A： any bus stops（公車站）around here.
B：OK. Let’s walk to the zoo.

e: There is / are... 表達「有……」，cake 為不可數名詞，要搭配單數 be 動詞 is。而「吃一些」的慣用用法為 have some。
q: some cake on the table. Would you like to have ?

e: 表「有沒有……？」疑問詞用 Is / Are there…?，由答句 it 可知 trash 為不可數名詞，故用 Is there。
q:
A：＿＿＿ any trash（垃圾）in the kitchen?
B：Yes. Please take it out.

e: any 可用於疑問句或否定句；而 some 則用於肯定直述句；toys 為複數名詞應用複數 be 動詞 are。
q:
A：There any toys in the basket.
B：Not really. There are in it.

e: 由答句「不，只有一個學生」可知，A 是問「教室裡有許多學生嗎？」。
q:
A：Are there students in the classroom?
B：No, there is only one student.

e: 根據答句可知，今天是星期日不用上班，故推知停車場應是沒有車子。there are 的否定句可用 there aren’t any… 或是 there are no… 來表示。
q:
A：There are cars in the parking lot（停車場）.
B：It’s Sunday. No one comes to work.

e: 由答句的 it 可知，問句為「有一隻綿羊在吃草嗎？」。
q:
A：＿＿＿ there ＿＿＿ eating grass（草）?
B：Yes, its name is Murphy.

e: 用 Yes, there are. 回答表示前句是用 Are there…? 詢問。
q:
A：______
B：Yes, there are. They are fun（有趣的）.
o: Is there a library in your school?
Are there any special classes at your school?

e: 對話內容為 Alice 向 Kama 介紹 Dora，Kama 接著和 Dora 打招呼，選項中最合適的為介紹 Dora 的身分「她是我來自南韓的朋友」。
q:
Alice：Hi, Kama, this is Dora. ＿＿＿
Kama：Nice to meet you, Dora. My name is Kama. I’m Alice’s classmate.
Dora：Nice to meet you, too, Kama.
o: She is my friend from South Korea.

e: 由後句「我還在適應新環境」及連接詞 but 可推知，前句為「每個人對我都很友善」。
q:
A：How’s your new school?
B：It’s great! ＿＿＿, but I’m still finding my feet.

e: but 用來連接語意有轉折的句子，前句說明「我不餓」，故可推知後句為「我午餐還是吃了三明治」。
q: I’m not hungry, but ______.
o: I work out in the gym
I take a rest at home
I still have some sandwiches for lunch
I think about you all the time

e: A：你家附近有籃球場嗎？ B：「沒有，但是有個體育館在我家附近。」我哥哥和我時常在那裡打籃球。
q:
A：Is there a basketball court near your house?
B：______ My brother and I often（時常）play basketball there.
o: Isn’t the sports field near your house?
Yes, there is a basketball court near his house.
No, but there is a gym near my home.
No, there aren’t any basketball courts near my home.

e: 由回答 Me too. 可知空格為直述句，又由語意可推知應選 (D)。
q:
A：______
B：Me too. Let’s visit（拜訪）her this weekend.
o: I think about Grandma all the time.

e: 問句為 Yes / No 問句，故選 (C)。
q:
A：Are there any basketball cards in the box?
B：
o: No way. There’s a basketball card.
No, there aren’t any basketball cards.
There are some basketball cards here.

e: 問句為 What’s there… 可知，回答要用 There is / are… 回答。
q:
A：What’s there in the box?
B：

e: A 詢問「他們在哪裡」，而 B 應回答地點，又由後句「在蹺蹺板上玩」可知地點為 playground。
q:
A：There aren’t any students in the classroom. Where are they?
B：______ They are playing on the seesaws.

e: A：看。桌上有一張照片。她是誰？ B：喔，是我媽媽。
q:
A：Look. a photo on the table. Who is she?
B：Oh, my mom.

e: 由「女子學校」可推測最合適的選項為「這裡沒有任何男學生」。
q: This is a girls’ school. ______
o: There isn’t a teacher in it.
There aren’t any boy students here.
They are in front of the library.

e: 由 banks 及 one 可推知空格應填 Are there 及 there is。
q:
A：I don’t have any money（錢）with me. any banks（銀行）around here?
B：Yes, one between the library and the school.

e: 由「裡面有好多的書及雜誌」可推知為「圖書館」。
q: ______ There are a lot of books and magazines（雜誌）in it.
o: I can take a rest at home.

e: 由上下文可知是在問體育館在哪裡，故選 (D)。
q:
A：There is a gym near our school.
B：Really? Where ?

e: 答句中有 there is，表示問句為 Is / Are there 開頭，但 (B)、(C) 與答句不符。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：No, there is only one girl in the show.
o: Isn’t that your sister in the show?
Is there a show this evening?
Aren’t there two girls in the show?

e: A：你在哪裡？ B：我在公車上。「這裡有好多人。」真擁擠。
q:
A：Where are you?
B：I’m on the bus. ______ It’s crowded（擁擠的）.
o: There is a boy next to me.
There are a lot of people here.

e: A 詢問 B「你在哪裡？」B 回答「我在 Sunny 農場。這裡很漂亮。」A 又問 B「農場裡有很多動物嗎？」B 回答「沒有，這裡沒有任何動物，但這裡你可以看到許多果樹。」。
q:
A：Where are you?
B：I’m at the Sunny Farm（農場）. It’s beautiful.
A：Are there a lot of animals on the farm?
B：No, ______, but you can see a lot of fruit（水果）trees here.
o: there are a lot of animals here

e: A 詢問 B「教室裡有學生嗎？」B 回答「沒有。」A 又問 B「那麼，他們在哪裡？」B 回答「他們在遊樂場。他們正在玩蹺蹺板。」。
q:
A：Are there any students in the classroom?
B：______
A：Then, where are they?
B：They’re in the playground. They’re playing on the seesaws.

e: 簡答主詞為 it 可推知問句用 Isn’t / Is that…?。
q:
A： your car outside the store（商店）?
B：Yes, it is.
A：Can you move（移動）it? It’s blocking（阻擋）the way.

e: 表達「有……」用 there is / are。
q:
A：Do you know（知道）any beautiful parks around here?
B：Yes, one next to the library.

e:
1. 由下句 To Mountain Green? 可推知，Shirley 此處問的是地點。
2. 由後句「我們也可以去釣魚」可推知，露營地點在湖「旁邊」。
3. 由下句「晚上會冷」可推知，指的是「毛毯」。
4. 由前句「我要帶我的相機」可知，此句應為「我要拍很多很棒的「相片」。
p:
Shirley：Jack, what are you going to do this Saturday?
Jack：I’m going camping with Lisa and Derek. Do you want to go with us?
Shirley：Yes, I do! ＿1.＿ To Mount Green?
Jack：Yes, and it’s ＿2.＿ a lake. We can go fishing, too.
Shirley：Cool! What should I bring?
Jack：Some food. Oh, bring a ＿3.＿ with you. It’s cold at night.
Shirley：OK. I want to bring my camera. I want to take a lot of good ＿4.＿!
Jack：Great. See you this Saturday!
go camping 去露營 Mount 山 lake 湖 should 應該 bring 攜帶 food 食物 camera 相機

e:
1. 由後句「我的學校只有兩棟建築物」可推知，此處應為「我的學校不大」。
2. 由前句詢問這間學校有多少學生可推知，此處應回答學生人數。
3. 主詞 a big playground 為單數，故用 There is。
p:
Hi, my name is Joseph. I am a junior high school student in Taiwan. Where is my school? My school is in the mountains in Nantou. ＿1.＿ There are only two buildings in my school. One is for the classrooms, and the other one is for the school library. How many students are there in my school? ＿2.＿ We always study and play together. ＿3.＿ a big playground next to the library. We always play in the playground.
mountain 山 how many 多少 always 總是 study 讀書

o: There are five people in my family.
I work out after school every day. every 每一
There are eighty students in my school.

e: 先由句尾的 either 可知前後句都是否定語氣，前句中已有片語動詞 get up，主詞 my brother 是第三人稱單數，因此用 doesn’t 形成否定句，後句主詞是第一人稱，因此用 don’t。
q: My brother ＿＿＿ get up early on weekends, and I ＿＿＿, either.

e: 問句中有一般動詞 play，your father 是第三人稱單數，因此用 Does 形成問句。答句用 He is a... 完成句子，plays 不符合語意。
q:
A：＿＿＿ your father play basketball well（好地）?
B：Yes. He ＿＿＿ a good basketball player. Take a look at the news. His photo is in it.

e: but 用來連接前後語意相反的句子，後半句用 don’t play，可推知前句表肯定。
q: I ＿＿＿ play basketball, but I don’t play baseball.

e: but 連接前後語意相反的句子，前句為一般動詞 takes，後句則用 doesn’t 簡答。
q: Ken takes a bath after dinner every night, but his sister ＿＿＿.

e: 用助動詞 do 問，就用助動詞 do 回答，表示否定用助動詞 don’t。
q:
A：Do you want some milk?
B：No, thanks. I ＿＿＿ like milk.

e: 由肯定回答及補充說明時間、小狗的行為，可推知是問小狗「是否」每天在這裡等牠的主人，因此用助動詞 does 形成疑問句。
q:
A：＿＿＿ the dog wait for its owner（主人）in front of the school every day?
B：Yes. It comes here, sits, and waits.

e: 用助動詞 do 問，須用助動詞 do 回答，yes 用 do，no 用 don’t。
q:
A：Do you play video games?
B：No, I ______ like video games.

e: 回答是位醫生，表示問職業，用「What do / does＋人＋do?」，句末的 do 當動詞用，因此用原形。
q:
A：What does your sister ＿＿＿? A teacher?
B：No. She is a doctor.

e: 主詞為第二人稱，且答句中有一般動詞，可知問句用助動詞 Don’t。
q:
A：＿＿＿ you like grapes?
B：Yes. I like them.

e: 由「每週五在那裡打籃球」可知為「規律的活動」，用現在簡單式。
q: My students are in the gym. They ＿＿＿ basketball there every Friday.

e: but 連接前後語意相反的句子，所以前句是肯定語氣的一般動詞，後句便是否定，主詞為 my friends，第三人稱複數，故答案為 don’t。
q: I play tennis every day, but my friends ＿＿＿. They play badminton.

e: 先由句尾的 too 可知前後句都是肯定語氣；主詞 Robert 與 his classmate (Helen) 都是第三人稱單數，故第一個空格應為 enjoys；而 and 連接前後語意相似的句子，故第二個空格用 does 簡述。
q: Robert ＿＿＿ his junior high school life, and his classmate, Helen, ＿＿＿, too.

e: Who 當主詞時，視為單數，使用第三人稱單數動詞 has；答句中主詞 my little brother, Bill 為同位語，指同一人，為第三人稱單數，故用 does 簡答。
q:

B: Well… my little brother, Bill, ______, I think.

e: 主詞為第三人稱單數，句中有動詞 like，用 does 形成問句；must 後接原形動詞。
q:

B：What color ＿＿＿ he like? White?
A：We can ask Mom. She must ＿＿＿ that.

q:

B：I ＿＿＿ do that, either.

q: My brothers ＿＿＿ any homework today, but I do. And they ＿＿＿ TV in the living room.

B：Sorry, I ＿＿＿. I ＿＿＿ do my homework first（首先）.

Ms. Wu：Good morning, everyone. ＿1.＿ Sandy, please say hello to your classmates.

Emma McKeon
Emma McKeon is now a star in Australia. This young swimmer comes from a swimming family. Her brother and her father are both Olympic swimmers.
To join Olympic games and become a fast swimmer, she knows that she must practice every day. First, she starts her day at about five-thirty and goes to the pool. She usually has a small snack like a banana on her way out. She gets to the pool at six o’clock and then warms up before jumping into the pool. The morning training lasts for two hours. After that, she goes home, eats breakfast, and has a break until noon.
From one o’clock to three o’clock, she eats lunch and then studies. She practices again in the afternoon. She is back in the pool by three-twenty and swims for two hours. The afternoon training is the main set, so it is harder and more tiring.
After training, she gets home between six o’clock and six-thirty. She makes something quick for dinner because she is very hungry. People don’t know that she enjoys cooking, but she is not good at it. In the evenings, she watches TV or reads a book and then gets to bed at about nine o’clock because she has to get up so early again the next morning.

p:
Kenny is a college student with a busy life. He is on the school tennis team and practices tennis every morning. After class, he works part-time in a restaurant, from Monday to Friday. On weekends, he goes out with his family or friends. Kenny seldom has time for his studies and homework. And he is often late for school. He worries about his grades. Now he is looking for help from his teacher, and his teacher gives him a new schedule.

3. 由對話可知，Peter 和 Hank 下午會去看電影，故選 (B)。
p:
Peter：I’m so tired today. I wake up at 6 every day to practice tennis.
Hank：Wow! That’s really early. I practice basketball after school, but then I don’t have much time for my homework.
Peter：I worry about that, too, so I do sports in the morning. By the way, do you also practice on weekends?
Hank：No. I like to play video games on weekends. You can come and play with me. I have some new games, and they are really fun.
Peter：Oh, I like video games too. But this weekend I want to watch a movie.
Hank：What movie do you want to see?
Peter：The Meaning of Life. My sister likes it very much. Do you want to come with me?
Hank：Sure. How much is the ticket?
Peter：It’s only 180 dollars. Sunshine Theater has a special price for students.
Hank：That’s great. And what time is the movie?
Peter：At 10 a.m. and 3:30 p.m. Let’s go in the afternoon. I don’t want to wake up early even on weekends.
Hank：Ha ha, no problem.

o: They will watch a movie in the afternoon.
They want to watch a movie after their basketball and tennis practice.
Hank and Peter want to play sports together in the afternoon.

The date of Father’s Day is different around the world. In the USA, after seeing Mother’s Day become a national holiday, a daughter wanted to celebrate Father’s Day on June 5 in 1910 because it was her father’s birthday. In 1966, the president of the USA made the third Sunday of June Father’s Day.
People in Australia also wanted to celebrate Father’s Day in a nice season. That’s why it is on the first Sunday in September, and the first Sunday in spring.
People in Thailand celebrate Father’s Day on December 5. It is also the birthday of their king.
In Taiwan, we thank our fathers on August 8. In Chinese, the number “eight” sounds like “dad,” so it is on the eighth day in the eighth month of a year.
The date of Father’s Days may be different around the world, but most importantly, it is always a day to spend with family.

In fact, people in Taiwan enjoy food together on their big holidays in a year. And these holidays fall on a different date every year. For example, people eat a big dinner on Chinese New Year’s Eve. It usually falls in January or February. Fifteen days later, they have Yuanxiao on the Lantern Festival. People can eat it hot or cold. In June, they make and eat rice dumplings on Dragon Boat Festival. Then it’s the Moon Festival in September. Hey! Here is my idea： I am coming back to the USA next month. Then I can join you there and enjoy great holidays in November and December! I can’t wait!
Love,
Katty

A：There isn’t enough hot ＿＿＿ for everyone to take a bath.
B：Let’s take a quick（快速的）shower（淋浴）then.

e: 這裡有 25 個人，但我們只有 20 個草莓蛋糕，可知「不夠」給每個人。
q: There are not ＿＿＿ strawberry cakes for everyone. There are 25 people here, but we have only 20 strawberry cakes.

e: 今天的作業很「容易」。我很快就完成了。
q: Today’s homework was ＿＿＿. I finished（完成）it quickly（快速地）.

e: B 回答放了一些牛奶在紅茶中，所以 A 是詢問在紅茶裡「添加」了什麼。
q:
A：What did you ＿＿＿ to the black tea? It’s delicious.
B：I put some milk in it.

e: 這魚湯不夠熱。請把它「加熱」。
q: The fish soup（湯）is not hot enough. Please ＿＿＿ it up.

e: 此句在問「喜歡藍色或是黑色的手錶？」，為選擇性的問句，故用疑問詞 Which。
q:
Ken：＿＿＿ watch does your sister like, the blue one or the black one?
Joe：The black one.

e: 可數名詞前面應加 a / an，或在後面加 s。
q: Time for dinner. Which do you want, ＿＿＿ or ＿＿＿?

e: 此句在問「喜歡水或是果汁？」，為選擇性的問句，故用疑問詞 Which。
q:
Lily：＿＿＿ would you like, water or juice?
Mia：Water, please.

e: 問「喜歡哪種動物」，為選擇性的問句，故用 Which animal；問句中 like 為一般動詞，故前面要用助動詞 does 形成問句。
q:
Pete：＿＿＿ your brother like, cats, rabbits, or pet pigs?
Ella：He likes rabbits.

e: 此句在問「喜歡去哪家店」，為選擇性的問句，故用疑問詞 Which，其後也可接名詞。
q: ＿＿＿ shop（店）do you go to, George’s or Winnie’s?

e: 此句在問「你喜歡哪一個」，為選擇性的問句，故用疑問詞 Which，其後也可接名詞。
q: ＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ do you like, fruit cake or banana pie?

e: A 有書，但是不「多」，故用 many 修飾複數可數名詞 books。
q:
A：Do you have any books?
B：Yes, but not ＿＿＿.

e: noodles 為可數名詞，其前可與 a bowl of / a lot of / any / two plates of 搭配，故選 (C)。
q:
A：Do we have ＿＿＿ noodles for dinner tonight?
B：No, we don’t.

e: 回答 three，表示詢問「需要多少」。watermelon 為可數名詞，須用 How many 詢問，故選 (B)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ watermelons do you need today?
B：Three.

e: there is / are some 表「有一些……」。there is 接單數可數名詞或不可數名詞，而 apple juice 為不可數名詞，故選 (C)。
q:
A：There ＿＿＿ some apple juice for you on the table.
B：Wow, I love apple juice. Thank you so much.

e: 此句在問「你喜歡芭樂或是草莓？」，因此疑問詞須用 Which；連接詞則須用 or，故選 (D)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ do you like, guavas ＿＿＿ strawberries?
B：Guavas. They are my favorite（最喜愛的）fruit.

e: 第一格有「米飯或麵條」，可推知是問你需要「哪一種」，後面有限定選項，故疑問詞應填入 Which；第二格問需要幾碗飯，bowls 為複數可數名詞，應填入 many，故選 (B)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ do you want, rice or noodles?
B：Rice.
A：How ＿＿＿ bowls do you need?
B：Two.

e: person 為可數名詞，故用 How many 問有幾個家庭成員，故選 (C)。
q:
A：How ＿＿＿ people are there in a your family?
B：Four.

e: 本題詢問每天喝多少茶，由於 tea 為不可數名詞，須用 How much 詢問；答句則填入 a lot of，故選 (C)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ tea do you drink every day?
B：I drink ＿＿＿ tea.

e: juice 為不可數名詞，故選 (A)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ juice do you need?
B：I need six cans, please.

e: 問句中有一般動詞及主詞 you，所以疑問詞須用助動詞 Do / Don’t；some 常用於肯定句，而 any 則常用於疑問句或否定句，故選 (D)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ you want any grapes?
B：Yes, I want ＿＿＿ grapes.

e: books 為可數名詞，須使用疑問詞 how many；又基數 twenty 後面不加 of，直接接名詞，故選 (B)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ books do you have?
B：I have more than（超過）＿＿＿ books.

e: 由疑問詞 how many 可知後面名詞為複數可數名詞，故選 (A)。
q:
A：How many ＿＿＿ do you need to make a cake?
B：I need four.

e: students 為複數可數名詞，故詢問有多少人數須用 How many。
q:
A：How ＿＿＿ students are there in the school?
B：There are 3,500 students. It’s a big school.

e: some 表示「一些」，後面可接複數可數名詞或不可數名詞，故第一格可填入 milk、noodles 或 papayas；第二格 one 的後面須接單數的數量詞，故選 (A)。
q:
A：Let’s get some ＿＿＿ in the store（商店）.
B：OK, Mom. Is one ＿＿＿ enough?

e: rice 為不可數名詞，不可直接加上數量、冠詞，故 (A) 錯誤；(B) 選項之單位 bowl of 前面須加上冠詞 a；(C) 應將 some plate of rice 改為 some plates of rice，故選 (D)。
q:
A：Please pass（傳遞）me ＿＿＿. I’m still hungry.
B：OK. Here you are.

e: juice 為不可數名詞，故用 How much 來詢問有多少果汁，故選 (D)。
q:
A：How ＿＿＿ juice do you have?
B：Two cans.

e: B 說「我需要三瓶（水）。」，可推知 A 所問為「數量」，又因 water 為不可數名詞，故空格應填入 How much 或 How many bottles of，故選 (C)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ water do you want?
B：I need three bottles.

e: watermelon milk 是不可數名詞，詢問數量時須用 How much。
q:
Amy：Can I have some watermelon milk, Dad?
Dad：Sure. How ＿＿＿ do you want?
Amy：One glass, please.

e: (B) milk 為不可數名詞，其前不可加冠詞 a；(C) 肯定句中表示「一些」須用 some；(D) 牛奶為不可數名詞，量詞表示法為「a／數量＋單位＋of」，故選 (A)。
q:
A：I drink ＿＿＿ milk before（在……之前）I go to bed every day.
B：Me too. It helps me have a good night’s sleep.

e: pens 為複數可數名詞，故用疑問詞 How many，且 be 動詞用 are，故選 (B)。
q:
A：How ＿＿＿ pens ＿＿＿ there on your father’s desk?
B：Only two.

e: How much 之後接不可數名詞，故選 (D)。
q:
A：How much ＿＿＿ does your sister drink a day?
B：Eight glasses.
A：Wow, she drinks a lot.

e: 「there＋be 動詞」用於表存在的句型，且 flour 是不可數名詞，故第一格應填入 is there；第二格空格後接複數可數名詞 two bags，其前須用 there are，故選 (A)。
q:
A：How much flour ＿＿＿ on the table?
B：There ＿＿＿ two bags on it.

e: water 為不可數名詞，故 be 動詞要用 is，且第一句中有 any，故應選表否定的 isn’t；第二句空格後的 bottles 為複數，be 動詞要用 are，故選 (B)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ any water at home.
B：Don’t worry. ＿＿＿ two bottles in my car.

e: pie 在此為單數且為可數名詞，前方需有冠詞，且 apple 字首為母音，故第一個空格應填 an；some 可接複數可數名詞 eggs、apples或不可數名詞，故選 (D)。
q:
A：I want to make ＿＿＿ apple pie in the afternoon.
B：Great! Let’s buy some ＿＿＿.

e: 問句後方有提供兩個選項，所以必須用 which 開頭的問句；答句的主詞為第三人稱單數，現在簡單式的一般動詞要加 s，故選 (C)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ does Joe like, papaya milk or black tea?
B：He ＿＿＿ black tea. He doesn’t like any drinks with milk.

e: 由第一格空格前的冠詞 an，可推測應填入字首為母音的單數可數名詞 egg；a lot of 之後可接可數名詞 noodles 或不可數名詞 rice、fish（表「魚肉」），故選 (A)。
q: Brian is hungry. He wants an ＿＿＿, two cans of orange juice, and a lot of ＿＿＿.

e: juice 果汁為不可數名詞，不可直接加上數量或冠詞，故 (A)、(B) 錯誤；(C) 選項之單位 bottle 字尾須加 s，故選 (D)。
q: Today is Tina’s birthday. Let’s get ＿＿＿ for her party.

e: 由答句中提及價錢，可推測問句為詢問價錢的句型，用 How much 表示；問句的主詞 they 表複數，可推測前方句子的量詞為複數量詞，故選 (B)。
q:
A：I want ＿＿＿ water. How ＿＿＿ are they?
B：NT $60.

e: 由 B 詢問 “How many...?”，可見 A 詢問的東西是複數可數名詞，故選 (C)。
q:
A：Do you have any ＿＿＿?
B：Of course. How many do you need?

e: 疑問句中表示「一些」須用 any，若問句中肯定意味較濃厚，也可用 some；答句中表肯定可用 some 或 a lot of，故選 (A)。
q:
A：Do we need ＿＿＿ drinks for the party?
B：Yes, we need ＿＿＿ tea and juice.

e: 動詞為單數 be 動詞 is，空格內須用疑問詞「How much＋不可數名詞」，故選 (C)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ is there on the table?
B：I’m not sure.

e: 問句中的 guava juice 為不可數名詞，第一個空格的 be 動詞要用單數的 is，而答句中的 glasses 是複數，be 動詞要用複數 are，故選 (C)。
q:
A：How much guava juice ＿＿＿ there on the table?
B：There ＿＿＿ two glasses on it.

e: rice 為不可數名詞，問「多少米飯」要用 How much rice；問「多少碗米飯」時，因為 bowl 為可數名詞，疑問詞則要用 How many；答句中主詞 Two bowls of rice 為複數，be 動詞用 are，故選 (A)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ does Jean eat a day?
B：She doesn’t eat a lot. Two bowls of rice ＿＿＿ enough for her.
o: How many bowls of rice; is
How many bowl of rice; are

e: 由答句「大約二十隻。」可知此處為指「20 隻綿羊」，故第一個空格選 How many；sheep 的單複數同形，故第二個空格應填入 sheep，故選 (A)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ ＿＿＿ does the farmer keep（飼養）on his farm（農場）?
B：About twenty. He also keeps some horses.

e: fish 指魚的「數量、條數」時為可數名詞，且 fish 單複數同形。由問句第一句中的 a lot of fish 可知，池塘裡有許多條魚，fish 在此為複數，第一個空格填 be 動詞 are，第二個空格問數量要用 How many，故選 (A)。
q:
A：There ＿＿＿ a lot of fish in the pond（池塘）. ＿＿＿ fish do you have?
B：About sixty.

e: 問句中，be 動詞是單數形 is，故疑問詞應為「How much＋不可數名詞」；答句中回答「五包」，故 be 動詞須用複數形 are。
q:
A：＿＿＿ is there in the box?
B：There ＿＿＿ five bags.
o: How many bags of salt; are
How many bags of salt; is

e: people 為可數名詞，故須搭配疑問詞 how many；而 tea 為不可數名詞，若要「泡給每人一杯茶」，則為 make everyone a cup of tea，故選 (D)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ people will（將會）come to this meeting?
B：Fourteen.
A：Thanks. I need to make everyone ＿＿＿.
o: How many; a cup of tea

e: 由不可數名詞 milk 可知第一格要用 How much；由 What can I do for you? 可知第二格也要用助動詞 can 詢問，故選 (B)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ hot milk do you want?
B：One cup is enough, thanks. By the way, ＿＿＿ you help me?
A：Of course. What can I do for you?

e: 由 How many 可知第一格要用複數名詞，sheep 單複數同形，pig 字尾加 s 形成複數；he 為第三人稱單數，須配合單數動詞 has，故選 (D)。
q:
A：How many ＿＿＿ does James have?
B：I don’t know. But he ＿＿＿ at least（至少）three cans of juice.

e: 母熊會在洞穴裡等上幾個月，「直到」小熊長得夠大可以外出。
q: The mother bear will（將會）wait months in the cave（洞穴）＿＿＿ the little bears are old enough to go outside.

e: 由問句後方有提供選項，可推測是用 which 開頭的問句，詢問「哪一個……」；答句的主詞為第三人稱單數，現在簡單式一般動詞要加 s，故選 (C)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ does Joe like, papaya milk or black tea?
B：He ＿＿＿ black tea. He doesn’t like milk.

e: 由 ice cream 和 grape 以及 strawberry 可推知，此為詢問口味的問句，問話者希望對方從兩種口味中擇一，故選 Which flavor；答話者兩種都想要，故選 both 表示「兩者」，故選 (C)。
q:
A：I want some ice cream（冰淇淋）.
B：＿＿＿ do you want, grape or strawberry?
A：I want ＿＿＿. I like grape and strawberry.

e: juice 為不可數名詞，由後方答句可推測為詢問數量，故選 (A)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ juice do you need?
B：Three cans, please.

e: 由複數名詞 apples 可知，第一格用 How many 詢問「多少」；由第三人稱單數主詞 she 可知，第二格用單數動詞 wants，故選 (A)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ apples does Mom need for the party?
B：About twenty. And she ＿＿＿ ten papayas, too.

e: 由 mice（mouse 的複數形）可知，第一格要用 How many 詢問「多少」；由 them 可知數量不只一個，第二格可用 A lot (of mice)、Two 或 Five；由 can 可知，第三格要用原形動詞 help，而 help 的用法為「help＋人＋(to) V」，故選 (D)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ mice are there in the kitchen?
B：＿＿＿. Can you ＿＿＿ me get them away?

e: orange juice 為不可數名詞，故第一格要用 How much 詢問「多少」，而第二格則要加入計量單位 glasses 才能用數字表示有多少杯，故選 (B)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ orange juice do you want?
B：＿＿＿ orange juice. I’m very thirsty.

e: 由 How many 可知，第一格要用複數名詞，故須加入計量單位 bottle，用 bottles of milk來表示「多少瓶牛奶」，此時動詞也要複數，故第二格要用複數 be 動詞 are，故選 (B)。
q:
A：How many ＿＿＿ milk ＿＿＿ there in the refrigerator（冰箱）?
B：There’s still a lot. Don’t worry.

e: 由不可數名詞 rice 可知，第一格要用單數 be 動詞 is；由複數名詞 bags 可知，第二格要用複數 be 動詞 are，故選 (D)。
q:
A：How much rice ＿＿＿ there in the box?
B：We still have a lot. There ＿＿＿ at least（至少）ten bags.

e: 由 How much 可知，第一格要填入不可數名詞 flour，而第二格則要填入數量單位 Two bags，故選 (C)。
q:
A：How much ＿＿＿ do you need?
B：＿＿＿. I will（將要）make thirty orange pies for the children.

e: 由後句她需要「它們」來做晚飯，可推知媽媽「這兩者」都需要。
q:
A：Which does Mom need, the pan or the plate?
B：＿＿＿ She needs them to make dinner.
o: Really? Can I teach me to cook?
There are some eggs and flour on the table.
Can she put the batter in it?

e: 由答句「是的，我仍覺得餓」，可推知後句為「我甚至可以吃五盤麵」。
q:
A：Are you still hungry?
B：Yes, I am. ＿＿＿
o: I can’t eat any more food.
We can’t get enough of them.
I can even eat five plates of noodles.

e: 由 B 回答「我需要三杯（這種東西）來跟雞蛋混合」，可推知 A 詢問 B「你需要多少麵粉？」。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：I need three cups of it to mix with the eggs.
o: Which do you need, a cup of flour or an egg?
How much flour do you need?
How many cups of flour are there on the table?

e: 由 A 說「我口很渴。有水嗎？」，可推知 B 的回答應與水相關，故選 (C) 較符合文意。
q:
A：I’m thirsty. Is there any water?
B：＿＿＿
o: Of course. Let’s water the flowers（花）together.
Which do you want, the glass of juice or the cup of tea?
No, but there are some cans of orange juice. Do you want some?
Yes, there is some apple juice on the table. I can get some for you.

e: 由 B 反問 A「你是否可等我？」，以及 A 回答「當然。我稍後將會過來找你。」，可知 B 願意教他寫英文作業，只是現在沒空。
q:
A：Can you help me with the English homework?
B：＿＿＿ Can you wait for me?
A：Sure.
o: Sorry, I don’t have time until 3:00.
Oops. Math is hard for me.
Of course not. English is difficult for me.
You’re right. I teach English at a junior high school.

e: 由 A 問「我可以要兩顆雞蛋嗎？」及 A 說「太感謝你了。」，可推知 B 願意給 A 兩顆雞蛋。
q:
A：How many eggs are there in the box?
B：There are twelve in it.
A：Can I have two eggs, please?
B：＿＿＿
A：Thanks a lot.

e: 由後句「八十九元」，可推知 B 詢問「它們多少錢？」。
q:
A：Good morning. Our fruit is very fresh（新鮮的）today.
B：Good. I need ten oranges and five apples. ＿＿＿
A：Eighty-nine dollars.
o: How many guavas do you have?

e: 由於 A 回答的是製作蛋糕的步驟，可推知 B 在詢問蛋糕的作法。
q:
A：Do you want to try（試）this cake?
B：Sure. Wow, it is delicious. ＿＿＿
A：First, I put an egg into a bowl with a cup of flour. Second, I mixed them together, and then….
o: How many eggs are there in the kitchen?
How much flour do we have?

e: 由於 B 與 C 均回答需要一杯果汁，可推知 A 在詢問「誰要喝果汁？」或「要喝幾杯果汁？」，故選 (A)。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：I want one glass of juice.
C：Me too.
A：OK. There you go.
o: How much juice do we have?
How many apples do you need to make juice?
Which do you want, apple juice or guava juice?

e: 由於 B 回答「我不喜歡果汁或茶飲。我可以喝一些水嗎？」，可知 A 在詢問 B 這兩種飲料之中，他想要哪種？
q:
A：What’s up?
B：It’s hot, and I’m thirsty.
A：I have some juice and tea. ＿＿＿
B：I don’t like juice or tea. Can I have some water?
A：But I don’t have any water, sorry.

e: 詢問「誰想要熱狗，Jimmy 還是 Ted？」，故應回答兩人其中一人想要、兩人都想要，或兩人都不想要。
q:
A：Who wants hot dogs, Jimmy or Ted?
B：＿＿＿
o: Ted does. He is very hungry.
Jimmy does. He wants a pet dog.
Don’t eat too many hot dogs.

e: 由 B 反問 A 是否能教他寫數學作業，可推知 A 在詢問這兩科作業之中，哪一科作業比較難。
q:
A：How much homework do you have today?
B：A lot. I have English and math homework.
A：＿＿＿
B：The math homework is. Can you help me with it?

p:
Follow the steps, and you can make delicious mashed potatoes. It’s very easy.
1. Take the skin off the potatoes and cut them into pieces, so they don’t take too much time to cook.
2. Put some salt in a big pot of hot water and boil it.
3. Add those potato pieces and cook for 15 minutes.
4. Pour out the water and mash the potatoes.
5. Put one cup of milk and some butter in a small pot and heat it up.
6. Add the milk and butter to the potatoes and mix everything together.
7. Enjoy your yummy mashed potatoes!

p:
Oat School has a cooking contest today. Many students are in the gym now. They all have different things to cook for the contest.
Emma and her friend Jack are in the contest, too. They want to make pancakes. They have flour, eggs, and butter. Emma mixes flour and water in a bowl. Jack adds sugar and a little salt. The batter is ready.
Next to them, Lisa and May are busy with a big plate of noodles. They add butter and fish to the noodles. Lisa’s mom teaches her to cook it, and it is delicious. The third group, Tom and Eric, makes a round pie. They use apples and sugar. It is a yummy apple pie.
When the teacher says, “Last five minutes,” Emma is very nervous. Their pancakes are still white. Jack turns up the heat right away. Finally, the pancake is brown on both sides. “It must be soft and yummy,” Emma thinks.
The teacher looks at all the food on the tables. Who can win the contest? She is now ready to eat them and find out.

p:
Mrs. Wang is a Chinese teacher in Taiwan. She is good at designing different games for her students. Her classes are always fun and easy to follow.
This year, Mrs. Wang teaches 7 classes and has 200 students from around the world. 30% of them are from Japan. Students from Japan are hard-working, but they are usually quiet. 25% of her students are from the USA. They ask many questions in class, and they like to practice. She also has students from Korea, the UK, and some other countries. Students from Korea love to work together, and students from the UK often have cool ideas. They all love Mrs. Wang’s class, and Mrs. Wang loves her students, too!

q:

e: 由「會議在十二點」，可推知還有一「小時」。

q:

e: 由「很少打掃房間或拖地」可知，Todd 是「懶惰的」。
q: Todd is ＿＿＿. He seldom cleans his bedroom or mops the floor.

q:

q:

e: 由「我們昨天下午在公園野餐。」可知，Vicky 為小孩們準備了許多「點心」像是鬆餅和蛋糕。

e: 由「他們就像小猴子」可知，這些孩子們時常「爬」樹。

e: 由前句「我無法了解 Patrick 在說什麼」可知，後句為所以 Carol「解釋」給我聽。

e: 由「不，但他現在是。」可知，問句為過去式，your brother 為第三人稱單數主詞，故第一格可用 Was 或 Wasn’t，而第二格可用過去時間 two years ago 或 before，故選 (D)。

e: 由對話得知情境全是過去式，you 的 be 動詞為 were，且由 Ben 回答 At Joan’s birthday party. 可知問地點，疑問詞用 Where，故第一格用 Where were；由 Ben 回答 Great. 可知派對很棒，可推知問句問派對如何，疑問詞用 How，故第二格用 How was。

e: 第一句主詞為第二人稱，故使用過去式 be 動詞 were；第二句主詞為第一人稱單數，搭配過去式 be 動詞 was，故選 (D)。

q:

e: 由 was a student 可知，是在談論過去的事，故問答句的時態皆用過去式，第一格用 did，第二格用 wanted。

e: 今天早上打掃過浴室，應用過去式，第一格填cleaned；表示現在很乾淨，用現在式，故第二格填 it’s。
q: Dad ＿＿＿ the bathroom this morning, and ＿＿＿ very clean now.

e: 由 this morning 可知是已發生的事，要用過去式，表示否定一般動詞 do（做）的過去式，要用助動詞過去式 didn’t，而後句表肯定的簡述句要用助動詞過去式did。
q: My brothers ______ do the housework this morning, but I ______.

e: Eason：你昨天下午有練習網球嗎？ Carrie：有，我練習了兩小時。問句中 Did 後面要接原形動詞 practice，肯定詳答句中的動詞要用過去式 practiced。
q:
Eason：Did you ＿＿＿ tennis yesterday afternoon?
Carrie：Yes, I ＿＿＿ tennis for two hours.

e: 由第一個 Ella 對話可知，她和 Jerry 今天說過話了，故第一格用過去式 talked；問句中助動詞 did 後面應接原形動詞，故第二格填 talk。
q:
Ella：Guess what? Jerry, the handsome basketball player on the school team, ＿＿＿ to me today. I really like him.
Todd：Really? What did you ＿＿＿ about?
Ella：Our favorite（最喜愛的）drink.

e: 由後句 was 可知為過去時間發生的事，故前句兩個動詞都用過去式。
q: We ＿＿＿ the science camp and ＿＿＿ it very much. It was really great.

e: 由答句中的過去式動詞 failed，可知問句要用過去式助動詞 Did 或 Didn’t。
q:
Ben：＿＿＿ Dr. Chen ＿＿＿ the kid’s life?
Mia：No. He failed（失敗了）.

e: 由問句 did 及 yesterday 可知，動詞須用過去式，故第二格用 exercised；由上下句意可知，問句是問下班後做「什麼」，故第一格用疑問詞 what。
q:
Sean：______ did you do after work yesterday?
Ruth：I ______ with my friend at the gym.

e: 由 worked 可知，第一句是在談論過去的事，故第一格用 didn’t；由 now 及 every day 可知是在講現在的事，故第二格用 does。
q: Jason ______ exercise before he worked in the gym. Now, he ______ it after work every day.

e: Jill 問 Ivy「現在正在做什麼」，故第一格用現在進行式；上傳照片是過去的動作，用過去式。
q:
Jill：What are you doing?
Ivy：I ______ out Terry’s Instagram. He just ______ some new photos.

e: 前句由時間副詞 before 可知，助動詞應用過去式；後半句由 now 可知，動詞應用現在式。
q: My brother ＿＿＿ like papayas before, but he ＿＿＿ them now.

e: 由 the day before yesterday 可知，是問過去的事件，故用過去式助動詞 did，回答也用過去式動詞 visited。
q:
Liz：When ＿＿＿ you visit Mr. Smith the day before yesterday?
Joe：I ＿＿＿ him at 11 a.m.

e: 由 then 可知，是在談論過去的事情，故動詞皆用過去式。
q: Todd ＿＿＿ in the kitchen then. He ＿＿＿ his sister cook dinner.

e: 由 she isn’t on any teams（她不在任何隊上）可知，Jessie 沒有加入棒球校隊，故用 No, she didn’t.。
q:
Fred：Didn’t Jessie join the school baseball team?
Sue：______, she ______. In fact, she isn’t on any teams.

e: 由問句的 didn’t 跟 was 可知，是在談論過去的事，動詞皆用過去式。
q:
Bruce：I didn’t see Amy this morning. Where was she?
Sandy：Oh, she ＿＿＿ to songs and ＿＿＿ the Internet in her room this morning.

e: 助動詞 did 後面接原形動詞，故第一格用 play；由 did 可知是在談論過去的事，故第二格用過去式 washed。
q:
Bill：Did you ______ basketball with Jason this afternoon?
Iris：No, I ______ the car for my father.

e: 由助動詞 did 可知，此句為過去式，故答句用過去式動詞 learned；助動詞後面須接原形動詞 join。
q:
Silvia：What camp did you ＿＿＿ two months ago?
Daniel：A science camp. I ＿＿＿ a lot there.

e: 由問句 surfing 可知為進行式，故第一格用 Are；由 never 與 before 可知第二格用過去式 surfed。
q:
Harry：______ Grandma and Grandpa surfing the Internet?
Tina：Yes.
Harry：I can’t believe it. They never ______ the Internet before.

e: 由 really busy then 可知，Vincent 上個月沒有造訪臺東；yes / no 的否定疑問句回答方式跟肯定一樣，故用 No, he didn’t.。
q:
Evan：Didn’t Vincent visit Taitung last month?
Tracy：______, he ______. He was really busy then.

e: 第一個問句沒有一般動詞，故用 be 動詞過去式；第二個問句已有一般動詞 have，故用過去式助動詞 Did。
q: Who ＿＿＿ with you last Sunday night? ＿＿＿ you have a good time?

e: 由 didn’t like 可知，前半句的時間副詞應用過去時間 before。後半句由 now可知，應用現在簡單式動詞 has。
q: Leon didn’t like cats ＿＿＿, but he ＿＿＿ two cats now.

e: 由答句 No, he didn’t. 可知，問句要用過去式助動詞 Did；且助動詞 did 後面須接原形動詞。
q:
Zoe：______ Jerry ______ out the trash?
Eric：No, he didn’t. He’s still doing his homework in his room.

e: 問「……如何」用 be 動詞，用 be 動詞問，就用 be 動詞回答，前後時態須一致。
q:
Sam：How ＿＿＿ your first day at new school?
Kim：It ＿＿＿ terrible.

e: 問句使用助動詞 did，所以答句也用過去簡單式。
q:
Jane：Did you and Peter watch that movie yesterday?
Sally：Yes, we ＿＿＿. But it ＿＿＿ an awful（糟糕的）movie.

e: 前句有 many years ago 表過去的時間，故動詞用過去式 exercised；後句有 now，時間為現在，又 but 連接前後相反的語氣，應選否定 doesn’t。
q: Chris ＿＿＿ a lot many years ago, but he ＿＿＿ now.

e: 由答句的 watched，可知，問句應用過去簡單式。
q:
Grace：＿＿＿ Jay and Ken ＿＿＿ on the Internet last night?
Ivan：No, they watched TV.

e: 由問句 Did 及答句 practiced 可知過去加入足球校隊，故用肯定簡答 Yes, I did. 表示。
q:
Laura：Did you join the school soccer team in junior high school?
Henry：______, I ______. I practiced soccer after school three times a week then.

e: 由問句 last year 及答句 Yes, he did 可知是問去年是否每天玩電腦遊戲，故第一格用過去式助動詞 did；由轉折語 but 可知是指現在已不再如此，故第二格用 doesn’t。
q:
Dylan：______ Daniel play computer games every day last year?
Alice：Yes, he did, but he ______ anymore（再也不）.

e: 由 never 可知以前從未煮飯給家人吃過，故用否定簡答 No, he didn’t.、No, never. 或 No, he never did.。
q:
Amber：Did Kevin cook for his family before?
Frank：______, he ______. He never cooked for his family.

e: 助動詞 Did 後面接原形動詞。問句為過去式，簡答用過去式助動詞 did。
q:
Joe：Did your brother ＿＿＿ science last weekend?
Meg：Yes, he ＿＿＿.

e: 由時間副詞 yesterday afternoon 可知，須用過去式助動詞 did，助動詞後面須接原形動詞 go。
q:
Adam：Where ＿＿＿ you and Jane ＿＿＿ yesterday afternoon?
Judy：To the gym. We exercised there.

e: 前半句由時間副詞 before 可知，動詞應用過去式 liked；後半句由時間副詞 now 可知，動詞應用現在式 loves。
q: Gary ＿＿＿ the small town before, but now he ＿＿＿ the big city.

e: 由 did 可知是指昨晚準備考試一事，故第一格用 studied；由 now 可知是指現在的狀態，故第二格用 am。
q:
Mary：Did you study for the test last night?
Philip：Yes, I did. I ______ until 3 a.m., so（所以）I ______ tired（疲累的）now.

e: 我們的可愛寵物 Mimi 發生什麼事了？我一整天都沒看到她。動詞 happen 只能用事物當主詞，故疑問詞 What 後面只能接 is happening 或 happened。選項 (B) 和 (D) 的疑問詞要用 How。
q: What ＿＿＿ to our cute pet Mimi? I didn’t see her all day.

e: 答句為「我幫了 Green 太太。」，問句應為「昨天你幫了誰？」，故用 did you help。如果是選項 (C)，回答應為「人名＋helped me.／人名＋did.」。
q:
Liz：Who ＿＿＿ yesterday?
Bob：I helped Mrs. Green.

e: Amanda 沒跟她妹妹分享水果派。她吃完了。表示否定 share（分享）的過去式，要用助動詞過去式 didn’t。
q: Amanda ＿＿＿ the fruit pie with her sister. She ate it up（吃完）.

e: 前天的蛋糕，動詞用 be 動詞過去式 was。
q: ＿＿＿ the cake the day before yesterday yummy?

e: 由 before 可知時態為過去式，be 動詞的過去式為 was，故選 (B)。
q: Mr. Chen ＿＿＿ on the school table tennis team before.

e: 由 Judy 問句中的過去式動詞 studied，可知為一個小時前發生的事，故用助動詞過去式 did 代替問句中的整個動作。
q:
Judy：Who studied with you in the library one hour ago?
Alex：My classmate Kevin ＿＿＿.

e: 由過去式動詞 downloaded 可知，時間副詞應用表過去時間的 last night。ago 前須加一段時間，故不可選。
q: Flora downloaded some songs and movies for her grandmother ＿＿＿.

e: 由前句的 didn’t check 可知，時間副詞應用表過去時間的 before。ago 前須加一段時間，故不可選。
q: Michael didn’t check his Instagram ＿＿＿, but now he checks it every day.

e: (B) There were 後面不接所有格或定冠詞等限定名詞；(C) 其前動詞應為 are；(D) 其前動詞應為 was。
q: There were ＿＿＿.
o: my tickets under the bed then
so many students in the library now
some water in the bottle this morning

e: 由 Nelson 回答「四個。幸運地，我家每個人都沒事。」，可推知 Willy 問「火災那時你家房子裡有多少人？」
q:
Nelson：The fire（火災）last night was terrible.
Willy：It really was. ＿＿＿
Nelson：Four. Luckily（幸運地）, everyone in my family was OK.
o: How many people were there in your house then?

e: 由哥哥擅長籃球，可推測出「他以前在學校校隊。」，故選 (B)。
q: My brother is good at basketball. ＿＿＿
o: This sport is too difficult for him.
He was on the school team before.
He didn’t learn anything about sports.
I played baseball with him every weekend.

e: 由 Sam 感慨公園附近過去和現在差異很大，可推知 Jane 回答「現在每個事物都不一樣了。」，故選 (A)。
q:
Sam：There were many trees around the park two years ago. Now, there are only tall buildings.
Jane：＿＿＿
o: We weren’t in the building then.
Were you in the park yesterday?
There are some people hunting here.

e: 由前句「喔，不。我的點心在哪裡？」，可推知後句會說「它們十分鐘前在桌上。」。
q: Oh, no. Where are my snacks? ＿＿＿
o: My snacks were in your bag.
They were on the table ten minutes ago.

e: 由後句「我打了幾次電話給她，但她沒有回電。」可知，前句為「Jessie 又把她的手機留在家裡了嗎？」。
q: ______ I called（打電話）her many times, but she didn’t answer.
o: Where were you one hour ago?
What did Mr. Chen do yesterday?
Yes, I watched a movie with Tina last night.
Did Jessie leave（留下）her cellphone at home again?

e: 由前句「昨晚的爵士音樂節很棒。」可知，後句為「大家都非常喜愛它。」。選項 (A) was 應改成 wasn’t；選項 (B) isn’t 應改成 wasn’t。
q: The Jezz festival（爵士音樂節）last night was great, ______.
o: and not many people liked it
and everyone enjoyed it a lot

e: Joyce 參加了為期三週的英語營，但「她不喜愛它」。選項 (A) 應加連接詞 and，it’s 應改成 it was。
q: Joyce joined an English camp for three weeks, ______.
o: and she didn’t learn any English

e: 陳先生今天早上沒有煮飯，「但是他太太有」。
q: Mr. Chen didn’t cook this morning, ______.

e: 第二句後半提到「我可以成為 Daisy 特別的朋友」可知，前面為「有了這封情書」符合語意，故選 (D)。
q: Thanks for helping me write this letter. ______, I can be Daisy’s special friend.

e: 由 Ray 回應「他們在等一位電影明星。」可知，Jill 想知道「怎麼了？」，故選 (A)。
q:
Jill：＿＿＿ There are so many people in front of the gate of the building.
Ray：Oh, they are waiting for a movie star（明星）.

e: 由 Zoe 回應「去問 Bob。他擅長英文」可知，Ron 是要問「我應該要怎麼做？」，故選 (B)。
q:
Ron：I can’t write an English letter. ＿＿＿
Zoe：Go ask Bob. He’s good at English.
o: Can you read this for me?

e: 由前句「看！Kenny 現在沒事了。」，可推知「他一個小時前很難過。」。
q: Look! Kenny is OK now. ＿＿＿
o: He was very sad an hour ago.

e: 由 Mark 回應「我現在有空，我們來搬吧。」可知，Mark 答應 Lisa 的請求，故選 (A)。
q:
Lisa：Can you help me move these chairs to the gym?
Mark：＿＿＿ I’m free now, so let’s do it.

e: 由 Erin 回應「禁止飲食」可知，Luke 是要問「告示牌上寫什麼？」，故選 (B)。
q:
Luke：Look at the sign over there. ＿＿＿
Erin：No eating or drinking.

e: 前者說對方今天早上不在教室，後者用過去式回答自己當時的所在地點，故選 (D)。
q:
Ruth：You were not in the classroom this morning.
Kyle：＿＿＿
o: I was in a baseball game.

e: 答句「是的，我是。」為第一人稱，故問句主詞應用第二人稱 you 且為單數，故選 (A)。
q:
May：＿＿＿
Ivan：Yes, I was.
o: Were you a science teacher before?
Were you art teachers ten years ago?
Was your son short and thin then?
Was Tanya in the library at two o’clock?

e: 本題為 be 動詞過去式，且主詞為複數名詞，故選 (B)。
q:
Rex：Were Peter and Ryan friends before?
Mina：＿＿＿

e: 由 Pete 後句「我的美術老師將會不高興」可知，Pete 感謝 Eva 借他畫筆，「拯救了他」，故選 (B)。
q:
Eva：These are my brushes. You can use them for art class.
Pete：Thanks! ＿＿＿, or my art teacher wouldn’t（將不會）be happy.

e: 由 Ian 回答「它很棒。」可知，Joe 是問「美術營如何？」。
q:
Joe：＿＿＿
Ian：It was great. We enjoyed it very much.
o: Did you play computer games last night?

e: Henry 上週日忙著準備數學考試，所以他沒跟Nina 去動物園，也不可能去參訪藝術博物館，故選否定簡答。
q:
Linda：Did you go to the zoo with Nina last Sunday?
Henry：＿＿＿ I was busy preparing for the math test.
o: Yes, it was a lot of fun.
No, but I visited an art museum.

e: 由 Nina 回答可知她的週末過得很棒，故後句應為「我和我媽媽學習烹飪。」。
q:
Jack：How was your weekend?
Nina：Great. ＿＿＿
o: Can you explain everything to me?
I learned cooking from my mother.
We visited a museum, but it wasn’t any fun.

e: 由 Sue 回答「當然！我看了三遍。」可知，Ron 是問「你看湯姆‧霍蘭德的新電影了嗎？」。
q:
Ron：＿＿＿
Sue：Sure! I watched it three times.
o: Did you watch Tom Holland’s new movie?
How many times did you watch the movie?

e: 含疑問詞的問句不能用 Yes 或 No 回答，Jim 以「那很有趣。我在營隊學了許多。」來回應Mia 問的「你覺得今天烹飪營如何？」。
q:
Mia：How did you like the cooking camp today?
Jim：＿＿＿
o: Yes, I did. I loved it very much.
Of course. I can share the snacks with you.
It was a lot of fun. I learned a lot at the camp.

e: 含疑問詞的問句不能用 Yes 或 No 回答，Ryan 問 Anna「你今天下午做了什麼？」，Anna以「我和 Hank 打網球。」回應。選項 (B) 語意不明，故不選。
q:
Ryan：What did you do this afternoon?
Anna：＿＿＿

e: 由 Eric 回答「我和我朋友們在新的健身房健身。」可知，Kay 是問「你上週六做了什麼？」。
q:
Kay：＿＿＿
Eric：I worked out with my friends at the new gym.
o: What did you do last Saturday?
Did you visit your friend yesterday?

e: 由 Kim 回應「那很危險」可知，Kim 不認同 Max 要爬樹採香蕉的點子，因此要他不要開玩笑，故選 (C)。
q:
Max：There are bananas on the tree! Let’s climb up to get them.
Kim：＿＿＿ We’re not monkeys. It’s dangerous（危險的）.

e: 由 Jay 前句肯定回答可知，後句應為「它（電腦營）很好玩。」；選項 (B) 跟昨天電腦營無關；選項 (C) likes 應改為 liked。
q:
Iris：Didn’t you have a great time at the computer camp yesterday?
Jay：Yes, I did. ＿＿＿
o: It was a lot of fun.

e: 由 Doris 後句說「他認識A到E。」可知，Little Johnny 正在學習字母，故選 (B)。
q:
Doris：______ He knows A to E now.
Evan：Isn’t he two years old? He’s smart.
o: Little Johnny can’t read or write.
Little Johnny is drawing a picture.

e: 由 Kate 回應「他正在找大家。喔，他抓到 Ryan了。」可知，Jeff 是問「Nick 和他的朋友們正在玩抓迷藏嗎？」，故選 (D)。
q:
Jeff：＿＿＿
Kate：Yes, he’s looking for them right now. Oh, he caught（抓到）Ryan.
o: Is Nick hunting a rabbit for food?
Is Nick hiding behind the big tree?
Is Nick playing soccer with his classmates?
Is Nick playing hide-and-seek with his friends?

e: 答句「是的，我是」為第一人稱，故問句應用第二人稱單數 you 提問，故選 (B)。
q:
Tony：＿＿＿
Jason：Yes, I was.
o: Were you nurses ten years ago?
Was Tanya in the library at two o’clock?

e: 由 Enid 後句說「你幫了我很多」可知，Enid 覺得 Joan 是真朋友，故選 (C)。
q:
Enid：＿＿＿ You helped me a lot.
Joan：Anytime! We’re good friends.
o: I wanted a computer from you.

e:
1. 文章提及 Sandra 以前並非住在城市，且她 21 歲離開去念大學，比對選項僅 (A) 符合。
2. 由後文提到那是 Sandra 很久以來第一次回來，可知她待在大學很長一段時間。
3. 由「她不敢相信她的眼睛」可推知城鎮有了明顯變化。
4. 由文中提及許多新商店、大街與人行道出現可推知此處填 (D) 最為適當，其餘與文章描述不符。
p:
Sandra didn’t live in a big city. __1.__, she lived in a small, quiet town by the sea. When she was 21 years old, she left to go to college, __2.__. Last summer, she decided to visit her old town and see it for the first time in a long time.
When Sandra arrived at her old town, she couldn’t believe her eyes. __3.__ The main street was really big, and there were many shops on each side of it. There were even new sidewalks, and they were really big, too. A lot of people were walking on the sidewalks. In fact, many of them were visitors, and they enjoyed the nice weather and checked out the shops. Also, __4.__. It wasn’t the small, quiet town from Sandra’s childhood.
live 居住 sea 海 when 當……時 college 大學 summer 夏天 decide 決定 arrive 抵達 shop 商店 visitor 遊客 weather 天氣 childhood 童年

o: Before she moved from the city
but she missed the city life
and she didn’t like the town
and she was there for a long time
It wasn’t there by the sea.
It was very different from before.
all the big beautiful buildings were gone
there were more tall buildings in the town

e:
1. 從句中的 before 可知，本句表示過去的狀態，be 動詞要用過去式第三人稱單數的 was，故選 (B)。
2. 第一至三句提到「Sharon 以前非常胖」、「一天居然要吃八餐」，後面又說「現在，她開始健康的飲食」，可推知「她當時並不健康」，故選 (C)。
3. 從後句 starts 可知本句是現在式，故選 (C)。

Yesterday, Lucy and Ben talked about their old friend, Jack. They were good friends with him a few years ago. Jack loved science and always learned new things.
Lucy：Do you remember the science camp we went to with Jack?
Ben：Yes! Jack was so excited. He wanted to visit the science museum every day. We spent hours there!
Lucy：Ha ha! And he always brought his notebook computer to the camp. He liked to surf the Internet and show us lots of new science facts.
Ben：Yes, he even taught me to save files on the notebook computer. Jack was like a teacher.
Lucy：I hope he still loves science. We should visit him.
