p:
Dear Owen,
I really want to thank you for teaching me your study tips. I seldom get good grades. In many teachers’ eyes, I’m a lazy student. However, I am not lazy at all. I’m just not very smart, I guess. I studied for 3 or 4 hours every day for tests, but that didn’t help.
Last night, I used your tips and only studied for 1 hour for the English test. You know what? Today I got an 88! Your tips saved me lots of time. I even worked out with my brother at 8 at a new gym and went to bed at 10:30. Last month, I never went to bed before 12 a.m., and I was always tired.
By the way, the new gym is right behind Sunny Park. It’s not very big, but it has everything. It’s new and nice. I want to go there again this weekend. Do you want to come with me?
Thanks again for helping me. Now I have time to do other things. Your tips really saved my life!
Thanks,
Jane

Science for Everyone
We are the Einstein Science Museum, and we love to share the fun of science. Kids can touch real things, play games, and learn in many different ways here.
(Number of Schools)
We started to invite schools to bring students here in groups. At first, only about 3 or 4 schools visited us. We learned a lot of great ideas from those students. For example, we didn’t have any science shows before, but from May, we now have 10 every month. Our museum was large, but it was not very friendly to children. This year, we designed some special rooms for them. In these rooms, kids can make small robots and take them home.
We love these changes. More and more students learn and have fun with us every day. We are always ready to welcome new friends. Come and visit us today!

e: 哦，不。我無法啟動我的電腦。有人可以幫我「修理」嗎？

q:
A：Look at the boy! He’s in d______r.

e: A：夏天時，「多雲的」天氣是在山中健行的最佳時機。 B：的確。晴朗的日子太熱。
q:
A：In summer, the ______ weather is the best（最佳的）for hiking in the mountains.

e: 昨天是「雨」天。我沒有外出，因為我不想弄溼。
q: Yesterday was a ＿＿＿ day. I didn’t go out because（因為）I didn’t want to get wet.

e: 我不喜歡臺灣夏天的「天氣」。太熱而且潮溼。
q: I don’t like the ＿＿＿ in Taiwan in summer. It’s too hot and wet.

e: A：「春天」快來了。我最喜歡這個季節。 B：我也是。我等不及冬天趕快結束。
q:
A：＿＿＿ is coming. I like this season the best（最）.
B：Me too. I can’t wait for winter to be over（結束的）.

e: 去年的「夏天」非常熱。我每天都像豬一樣汗流浹背。
q: It was a hot ＿＿＿ last year. I was sweating（流汗）like a pig every day.

e: 今天是個「晴朗」且溫暖的日子。我們去野餐吧。
q: Today is a ＿＿＿ and warm day. Let’s go on a picnic（去野餐）.

e: 「雨」後空氣比較清新。
q: The ＿＿＿ is fresher（比較清新的）after the rain.

e: 「雪」融化後很冷。你出門時要穿上外套。
q: It’s cold after the ＿＿＿ melts（融化）. Put on your coat（外套）when you go out.

e: 樹葉在「秋天」轉變成紅色、黃色或橘色。秋天真是個美麗的季節。
q: Leaves（樹葉）turn（變成）red, yellow, or orange in ＿＿＿. It’s a beautiful season.

e: 我喜歡「冬天」，因為我喜愛玩雪。冬天是我最喜愛的季節。
q: I like ＿＿＿ because（因為）I enjoy playing in the snow. It’s my favorite（最喜愛的）season.

e: 美國在冬天會「下雪」。孩子們在那時候可以去滑雪。
q: It is ＿＿＿ in the USA in winter. Children can go skiing（去滑雪）at that time.

e: 不要把那炊具丟掉。你應該先「修理」它。
q: Don’t just throw the cooker（炊具）away. You should ＿＿＿ it first.

e: 那漁夫的皮膚是「深色的」。那是因為他總是在陽光下工作。
q: The fisherman’s skin（皮膚）is ＿＿＿. That’s because（因為）he always works in the sun.

e: 今天「風」太強了。我們沒辦法在公園打羽毛球。
q: The ＿＿＿ is strong（強勁的）today. We can’t play badminton in the park.

e: 一年有四個「季節」―春天、夏天、秋天跟冬天。
q: There are four ＿＿＿ in a year－spring, summer, fall, and winter.

e: 由「所以，我們帶她去警察局」可知，這個小女生在夜市裡迷路而「哭泣」。
q: The little girl got lost（迷路）and ＿＿＿ at the night market. So, we took her to the police station（警察局）.

e: 由「他很少笑且對我很嚴格。」可知，我很「怕」我的數學老師。
q: I’m ＿＿＿ of my math teacher. He seldom has a smile（微笑）on his face, and he is very strict with me.

e: 由「Daniel 的寵物貓昨晚死了。」可知，他「感到」很難過。
q: Daniel’s pet cat died（死了）last night. He ＿＿＿ so sad.

e: 由「爸媽，別擔心我們。」可知，我們在這裡都很「安全」。
q: Mom and Dad, don’t worry about us. We’re all ＿＿＿ here.

e: 脫掉你「溼的」衣服。你不想感冒，對吧？
q: Take off your ＿＿＿ clothes. You don’t want to catch a cold（感冒）, right?

e: 雨後「天空」出現了彩虹。
q: A rainbow（彩虹）appeared（出現）in the ＿＿＿ after the rain.

e: 小孩在黑暗中感到害怕是很「普遍的」，但 Jerry 不會。他總是關掉燈，待在黑暗中。
q: It’s ＿＿＿ for kids to feel afraid in the dark, but not for Jerry. He always turns off lights（關燈）and stays（待在）in the dark.

e: 在我「忘記」之前，讓我記下那會議的日期。
q: Let me write down the date of the meeting before I ＿＿＿ it.

e: 下雨了。我可以和你共撐一把「雨傘」嗎？
q: It’s raining. Can I share a(n) ＿＿＿ with you?

e: A：好熱。我想「淋浴」。 B：好的。這是你的毛巾。
q:
A：It’s so hot. I want to take a ＿＿＿.
B：OK. Here is the towel（毛巾）.

e: A：今天天氣怎麼樣？ B：我不確定。我沒看天氣「報導」。
q:
A：How’s the weather today?
B：I’m not sure. I didn’t watch the weather ＿＿＿.

e: 初學者需要很多幫助。然而，許多學校沒有足夠的資源。
q: Students at the beginner（初學者）＿＿＿ need a lot of help. However, many schools don’t have enough resources（資源）.

e: 我父親五十年前「建造」了這棟房子，而它現在仍然保持良好的狀態。
q: My father ＿＿＿ the house fifty years ago, and it is still in good condition（狀態）.

e: 那學校不「遠」。你可以在轉角看到它。
q: The school is not ＿＿＿. You can see it at the corner（轉角）.

e: Jane 二十歲時就「成為」母親。這不是一件容易的工作，但她做到了。
q: Jane ＿＿＿ a mother when she was twenty. It was not an easy job, but she did it.

e: 我之前「住在」湖邊。我每天都能看到湖景。
q: I ＿＿＿ by the lake before. I could watch the lake view（景色）every day.

e: Tom 說他將會做任何事「保護」他的妻子，但那不是真的。他只關心他自己。
q: Tom said he would（將會）do anything to ＿＿＿ his wife, but that wasn’t true. He only cared about himself（他自己）.

e: Sandra 喜歡外出去「大自然」，所以她時常在週末去賞鳥。
q: Sandra enjoys being out in ＿＿＿, so she often goes bird-watching on weekends.

e: 當車子撞到我的腿時，我真地感覺到我的生命處於「危險」之中。
q: I really felt my life was in ＿＿＿ when the car hit me on my leg.

e: A：《美國棒球史》這本書在哪裡？ B：它在你頭「上」的架子上。對你來說太高了。讓我幫你拿。
q:

e: 在船上工作的職業應是「漁夫」。
q: My uncle is a ＿＿＿. He works on the boat（船）.

e: Nancy：沒有人可以「解決」我的問題。我該怎麼辦？ Peggy：你可以找李老師幫忙。

Peggy：You can ask Mr. Li for help.

e: 答句第一句用 It 代替問句主詞，並接 was...，第二句表在臺北下很多雨，rain 是不可數名詞，視為單數，故用 There was...。
q:
A：How was the weather in Taipei last weekend?
B：＿＿＿ hot and rainy. ＿＿＿ lots of rain in Taipei last weekend.

e: 問句用「Be 動詞＋there...?」，rain 是不可數名詞，視為單數；答句 rainy 是形容詞，主詞是「天氣」，主詞用 it，再接單數 be 動詞。
q:
A：＿＿＿ a lot of rain in Taipei yesterday?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿ rainy the whole（整個的）day.

e: 問句用「人＋have snow」；答句用 it never snows 之外，we never have snow 也正確。
q:
A：Do you ＿＿＿ in Kaohsiung in winter?
B：No, ＿＿＿ never ＿＿＿ here in winter.

e: 本對話的 rain 當名詞，故可用 there is... 與 they / you have... 的句型開頭，故選 (C)。(D) 因答句的主詞與問句的主詞不一致，故不可選。
q:
A：＿＿＿ lots of rain here in summer?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿ lots of rain here in summer.

e: 問句 snow 是當動詞，故主詞只能用 it，並用助動詞 Does 形成問句；答句 snow 是當名詞，由於地點是 here，因此可用 there isn’t 或 we don’t have 作答。
q:

B：No, ＿＿＿ much snow here in winter.
o: Do they have; we don’t have

e: 本句缺動詞，故選 rains a lot。

e: rain 在此當不可數名詞，選項 (A) 須改為 Does it rain a lot；選項 (D) 應改為 Do we / you have...?。

B：I have no idea. I’m new here.

e: 主詞是 It，動詞用 snows。頻率副詞 seldom 須放 snows 之前。

e: these 應搭配複數名詞。

e: 空格應填入名詞，rain、snow 為不可數名詞。clouds 不符合語意，故選 (D)。
q: The weatherman said there could be a few ＿＿＿ on Friday.

e: snow 為不可數名詞，故需 much、a little、little 修飾，又 little不符合語意。

e: rain 為不可數名詞，故需 much 修飾。

e: 由動詞 was 可知，應填入過去的時間副詞及動詞。

e: 由後句可推知，現在外面正在下雨。

q: ＿＿＿ because（因為）it is not too hot or too cold. I can do outdoor（戶外的）sports.

q:
Gina：Oh, no! It’s raining.

o: Doesn’t it rain too often in May?

e: 由前後文可推知空格處應提及與「賞花」相關的活動，故選 (D)。

e: 由 Amy 回答 Yes，表示去年冬天紐約市下很多雪」，可知後半句應為「天氣寒冷又多雪。」。

e: 「這裡雪下很大」，我只有兩件夾克。它們不夠溫暖。選項 (B) 不符語意；(C) 應改成 We have…；(D) 應改成 There is…。
q: ＿＿＿, and I have only two jackets（夾克）. They aren’t warm enough.
o: They have a lot of snow here
There was a lot of snow here

e: but 連接前後語意相反的句子，由前句「今天早上溫暖又晴朗」可知，後句應為「現在寒冷又多雨」。
q: It was warm and sunny this morning, but ＿＿＿.
o: it is cold and rainy now
it was still cloudy in the evening

e: 由 B 的回答可知 A 問了春天的天氣狀況，且不是使用 yes / no 問題，故選 (D)。

A：＿＿＿
B：We have a lot of rain in spring.

How’s the weather in your place in spring?

e: (A)、(B)、(D) 皆有 B 不喜歡的天氣，故選 (C)。
q:
A：What’s the weather like today?

e: (A)、(B) 時態不符，應用現在式回答；(D) 語意不符。
q:

o: I watched TV after you slept.
I surfed the Internet before I went to bed.

I don’t want to go to sleep.

e: 由回應 No 可推知，後句回應「我怕狗」。
q:
A：Hey, come to meet my pet dog.

e: A：Wayne 為什麼持續看手機？ B：他正在等朋友「打電話」告訴他碰面地點。
q:
A：Why does Wayne keep looking at his cellphone?
B：He’s waiting for a ＿＿＿ from his friend about the meeting place.

e: Mariah 今天早上「寄」了一個包裹給她的老朋友。
q: Mariah ＿＿＿ a package to her old friend this morning.

e: A：你「為什麼」開會遲到？ B：由於路上交通很塞，所以我遲到了。
q:
A：＿＿＿ are you late for the meeting?
B：I’m late because there was a lot of traffic on the road.

e: 這是一個「嚴重的」問題。我們必須立即解決它。
q: It is a ＿＿＿ problem. We must fix it right away.

e: Noah 感到胃「不舒服」，所以他晚餐沒吃任何東西。
q: Noah felt ＿＿＿ to his stomach, so he didn’t eat anything（任何東西）for dinner.

e: A：我找不到我的鑰匙。 B：「也許」它們在你的包包裡。再查看一次。
q:
A：I can’t find my keys.
B：＿＿＿ they are in your bag. Check again.

e: 由後句 was hungry 可知，在談論過去的事情，故用過去式 didn’t；「早上沒有吃早餐」為「因」，「10 點左右就餓了」為「果」，故用連接詞 so。
q: Lisa ＿＿＿ have breakfast this morning ＿＿＿ she was hungry at around 10 a.m.

e: 由 did、ate 及 was 可知是在談論過去的事，故第一格用 came；吃了一些鬆餅是「因為」當時很餓，故第二格用 because。
q:
A：What did you eat before（在……之前）you ______ to the party?
B：I ate some pancakes ______ I was really hungry then.

e: A 是在問 B「為什麼」那麼喜歡這部電影，故用疑問詞 why；而回答「它與烹飪有關，而我喜歡食物」為「原因」，故用連接詞 because。
q:
A：＿＿＿ do you like the movie so much?
B：I like it ＿＿＿ it’s about cooking and I like food.

e: 由 went 可知，是在談論過去發生的事，故第一格用 got；「沒有帶雨傘」是「淋溼」的原因，故第二格用連接詞 because。
q: Dan went to the park this morning, but he ______ wet ______ he didn’t bring his umbrella with him.

e: 「Ben想要看獅子」為「因」，「Ben 的媽媽帶他去動物園」為「果」，故第一格用連接詞 so；由 last Sunday 可知，是在談論過去的事，故第二格用過去式 had。
q: Ben wanted to see the lions ＿＿＿ his mother took him to the zoo last Sunday. They ＿＿＿ a lot of fun there.

e: 由上下句意可知，A 是在問原因，故用疑問詞 why。「我沒有足夠的錢」為「因」，故用連接詞 because。
q:
A：＿＿＿ didn’t you buy the coat?
B：＿＿＿ I didn’t have enough money（錢）.

e: 「早上游泳」及「下午健行」是他們疲倦的「原因」。而 that 為代名詞，故須在 because 後方加上介系詞 of。
q: Lydia and her family went swimming in the morning and went hiking in the afternoon. ＿＿＿ that, they were all tired（疲累的）.

e: 由 was busy 可知，是在談論過去的事，故第一格須用過去式 did 或 didn’t；由疑問詞 why 可知，A 是在詢問原因，故用連接詞 because。
q:
A：Why ______ you walk the dog?
B：______ I was busy cooking dinner.

e: 由 What happened…? 可知 A 在詢問原因，「她的隊伍輸掉比賽」為「因」，「她哭泣」為「果」，故第一格用連接詞 because；由 was crying 可知，是在談論過去的事，故第二格用過去式 lost。
q:
A：What happened to Jamie? She was crying after the game.
B：Jamie cried ______ her team ______.

e: 由上下句意可知，是在談論過去的事，故第一格可用 Did 或 Didn’t；「我將不會再這麼做」為「果」，「這對我的健康不好」為「因」，故用連接詞 because。
q:
A：______ you watch the baseball game on TV at 2 a.m. this morning?
B：Yes, but I won’t（將不會）do it again ______ it is not good for my health.

e: 由問句 did 可知，是在談論過去的事，故第一格用過去式 joined；「喜歡閱讀」是「加入讀書會」的原因，故第二格用 because。
q:
A：Why did you join the book club（社團）?
B：I ＿＿＿ the book club ＿＿＿ I like reading.

e: 「Peggy 買了新電腦給她女兒」是「她女兒今天生日」的「果」，故用連接詞 so；表「買某物給某人」可用「buy＋物＋for＋人」或「buy＋人＋物」；但物為代名詞 it 或 them 時，只能用「buy＋it / them＋for＋人」。由 did 可知，是在談論過去的事，故用過去式 bought。
q:
A：Why did Peggy buy a new computer?
B：Today is her daughter’s birthday ＿＿＿ she ＿＿＿ as a gift（禮物）.

e: 由答句 because 可知第一格要用疑問詞 why；由問句 did 可知時態為過去式，故第二格要用過去式動詞 went。
q:
A：＿＿＿ did Tina go to the hospital?
B：She ＿＿＿ there because she broke her arm.

e: 「show＋物＋to＋人」表「將某物拿給某人看」；由 last night 可知，是在談論過去的事，故用過去式 had。
q:
A：Could you show the pictures of yesterday’s party ＿＿＿ me? I ＿＿＿ a lot of fun last night, so I really want to see them.
B：Of course. Here they are.

e: 「send＋物＋to＋人」表「寄某物給某人」。
q:
A：I want to ＿＿＿ some clothes ＿＿＿ you. Could you give me your address（住址）?
B：Sure. It’s so nice of you.

e: 由 last year 可知，是在談論過去的事，故第一格須用過去式 made；「make＋物＋for＋人」表「做某物給某人」。
q:
A：My husband ＿＿＿ a song ＿＿＿ me last year.
B：Wow. It was so beautiful.

e: 「bring＋人＋物」=「bring＋物＋to＋人」表「帶某物給某人」；由問句 did 可知，是在談論過去的事，故用過去式 brought。
q:
A：Did you eat anything（任何東西）today?
B：Yes. Beth ＿＿＿ this afternoon.

e: 由 yesterday evening 可知，動詞應用過去式。「give＋物＋to＋人」表示「把某物給某人」。
q: Aunt Sally ______ a fruit pie ______ us yesterday evening. It was delicious.

e: 「give＋物＋to＋人」表示「把某物給某人」。
q: Mom gave movie tickets ＿＿＿ my brothers, but she didn’t give me any.

e: 「make＋物＋for＋人」表示「做某物給某人」；「媽媽很開心」是「做生日卡片給媽媽」的「果」，故用連接詞 so。
q: I made a birthday card ＿＿＿ Mom ＿＿＿ she was very happy.

e: 「give＋物＋to＋人」表示「把某物給某人」。
q: Karen gave a book ＿＿＿ me. It’s about a girl’s life in a poor family.

e: 「放學後不能和我們玩」為「果」，「必須照顧弟弟」為「因」，故用 because 連接。
q: Michelle couldn’t play with us after school ＿＿＿ she had to（必須）take care of her brother.

e: 由答句「因為昨天我感冒，但我現在好多了」可知，問句是在問昨天「為什麼」沒來學校，故用疑問詞 why；catch a cold 表示「感冒」，時間副詞為 yesterday，故應使用過去式動詞 caught。
q:
A：＿＿＿ didn’t you come to school yesterday?
B：Because I ＿＿＿ a cold yesterday, but I’m fine now.

e: 由答句可知，A 是在問 Andy 看到 B 跑走的原因，故用疑問詞 why。
q:
A：＿＿＿ did Andy run away when（當……時）he saw you?
B：Because he was afraid of my dog.

e: 由後句「因為……」可知，疑問詞要用 why。要表達「將某物拿給某人看」，且物為代名詞 it 或 them 時，用「show＋it / them＋to＋人」。
q:
A：＿＿＿ did you bring the photos to Taitung?
B：Because I’m going to（將）show ＿＿＿.

e: 「晚起床」是「因」，「未搭上第一班火車」是「果」，故用連接詞 so。
q: John was an hour late. He got up late ＿＿＿ he didn’t catch the first train（火車）.

e: 「show＋人＋物」＝「show＋物＋to＋人」表「把某物給某人看」。
q: Ricky is a serious man, and he never ＿＿＿ his feelings（情緒）＿＿＿ people.

e: 表「買某物給某人」用「buy＋物＋for＋人」。
q: This computer isn’t ＿＿＿ Mom. Dad bought it ＿＿＿ us. It’s ours.

e: 「Donna 難過」為「果」，「她沒有足夠的錢買鞋子」為「因」，故連接詞用 because。
q: Donna was sad ＿＿＿ she didn’t have enough money（錢）for the shoes.

e: 由 didn’t 可知此句為過去式，故時間副詞不可使用 now、later；「不能加入你們」是「果」，「今天的重要考試」為「因」，故用 because of 來連接後面的名詞。
q:
A：Why didn’t you come to the party ＿＿＿?
B：I couldn’t join you ＿＿＿ the big test today.

e: 「Fred 每天都練習網球」為「因」，「他贏得比賽」為「果」，故連接詞用 so；由後半句的 won 可知此句應使用過去式，後方的 every day 表過去每天的習慣。
q: Fred ＿＿＿ tennis every day ＿＿＿ he won the game. We were happy for him.

e: 由答句「你沒看到紅綠燈嗎？紅綠燈剛剛變成紅燈。」可知，問句是在問「為什麼」那名女子停下來，故疑問詞用 why。
q:
A：＿＿＿ did the woman stop?
B：Didn’t you see the lights? The traffic lights changed to red just now.

e: 「Martin 上禮拜沒有念書」為「因」，「數學考試成績不好」為「果」，故連接詞用 so。
q: Martin didn’t study last week ＿＿＿ he got a bad grade on the math test.

e: 由疑問詞 Why 可知，是在問 James 跑去運動場的原因，故回答用連接詞 Because。
q:
A：Why did James run to the sports field?
B：＿＿＿ his favorite（最喜愛的）player is there now.

e: 「早上沒有吃藥」是「因」，「現在頭痛」是「果」，另外，Because 跟 so 皆為表達因果關係的連接詞，不可用在同一句子中。
q: ＿＿＿ I didn’t take the medicine this morning ＿＿＿ my head hurts now.

e: 交通堵塞及空氣骯髒兩者非「因果關係」，而是皆為不喜歡 Apple Town 的原因，故第一格用 and 連接；「交通堵塞及空氣骯髒」為「因」，「我不喜歡它」為「果」，故第二格用連接詞 so。
q: Let’s not visit Apple Town. The traffic is heavy ＿＿＿ the air is dirty ＿＿＿ I don’t like it.

e: 「不做任何運動」為「因」，「不健康」為「果」，且 because 和so 不可同時出現在同一個句子中。
q: ＿＿＿ Jerry didn’t do any exercises, ＿＿＿ he was not healthy.

e: 由介系詞 to 可知第一格可用 give、send 或 bring。想要給她驚喜是「因」，請求幫忙是「果」，故用連接詞 because。
q:
A：Could you help me ＿＿＿ a cake to Mary?
B：Why?
A：＿＿＿ I want to give her a surprise（驚喜）.

e: 「喉嚨痛」是「因」，「無法唱歌」是「果」，故用連接詞 because；喉嚨痛 sore throat 的搭配動詞為 have。
q:
A：Come on! Sing along（一起唱）with us.
B：Sorry, I can’t sing ＿＿＿ I ＿＿＿ a sore throat.

e: 「重感冒」是「因」，「沒有去游泳」是「果」，故連接詞用 because；由 yesterday 可知，是在談論過去的事情，故第二格須用過去式動詞。
q: Vicky didn’t go swimming yesterday ＿＿＿ she ＿＿＿ a bad cold.

e: 表達「買某物給某人」用「buy＋物＋for＋人」。send、give、show 皆必須用 to 當介系詞。
q: Don’t ＿＿＿ candy（糖果）＿＿＿ our son. It’s not good for his teeth.

e: 「make＋人＋物」＝「make＋物＋for＋人」表「做某物給某人」。
q:
A：Teachers’ Day is coming. What about making ＿＿＿?
B：OK. Let’s do it.

e: 「write＋人＋物」＝「write＋物＋to＋人」表「寫信給某人」；「give＋人＋物」＝「give＋物＋to＋人」表「把某物給某人」。
q: Karen fixed my computer last week, and I ＿＿＿ to thank her.

e: 口罩 mask 的搭配動詞為 wear；「Wendy 咳嗽沒戴口罩」是「因」，「我們都感冒了」是「果」，故用 because of 來連接後面的名詞。
q: Wendy coughed（咳嗽）and didn’t ＿＿＿ a mask. ＿＿＿ her, we all caught a cold.

e: 「send＋物＋to＋人」表「寄某物給某人」；「give＋物＋to＋人」表「把某物給某人」。
q: If（如果）you see this message, please ＿＿＿ my cellphone ＿＿＿ me. Thank you.

e: 「Eugene 沒有吃早餐」是「因」，「我給了他一個三明治」是「果」，故連接詞用 so。「give＋人＋物」＝「give＋物＋to＋人」表「把某物給某人」。
q: I had three sandwiches. Eugene didn’t eat breakfast ＿＿＿ I gave one ＿＿＿ him.

e: 「我必須為我弟弟們煮飯」為「果」，「父母不在鎮上」為「因」，故連接詞用 because。
q: I need to cook for my brothers ＿＿＿ my parents are out of town today.

e: 「make＋人＋物」＝「make＋物＋for＋人」表「做某物給某人」。
q: Betty enjoys making cakes. She makes ＿＿＿ every week.

e: 「send＋物＋to＋人」表示「寄某物給某人」；「write＋物＋to＋人」表示「寫某物給某人」。
q: I am going to（將要）＿＿＿ a letter ＿＿＿ my friend Amy. She works in Hong Kong now.

e: 「buy＋人＋物」＝「buy＋物＋for＋人」，表示「買某物給某人」。
q: Mr. Chang visited Taitung last weekend, and he bought ＿＿＿.

e: 表「寫某物給某人」用「write＋物＋to＋人」或「write＋人＋物」；表「把某物給某人看」，用「show＋物＋to＋人」或「show＋人＋物」。
q:
A：Are you writing a love letter ＿＿＿ Linda?
B：That’s right. I want to show my love ＿＿＿ her.

e: 由 B 的答句可知，A是在問發生事情的「原因」，故用疑問詞 why；「他沒有回覆你的訊息」為「果」，「他忙於工作」為「因」，故用連接詞 because。
q:
A：＿＿＿ didn’t James answer my message this morning?
B：He didn’t answer your message ＿＿＿ he was too busy with his work.

e: 表「寄某物給某人」，且物為代名詞 it 或 them 時，用「send＋it / them＋to＋人」。
q: You can take some beautiful photos and ＿＿＿ when you get home.

e: 表「將某物給某人」且物為代名詞 it 或 them 時，用「give＋it / them＋to＋人」，故不能選 (B)。
q:
A：I just found these boxes under the Christmas tree. Are they yours?
B：Yes, they are. Please give me ＿＿＿.

e: 由前方的 didn’t 可知此句時態為過去式，故不可使用 next Friday 與 every Friday；「發燒」是「因」，「不能去美術課」是「果」，故連接詞用 because。
q:
A：Why didn’t you go to the art class ＿＿＿?
B：I didn’t go there ＿＿＿ I had a fever.

e: 頭痛 headache的搭配動詞為 have；「頭痛」是「因」，「沒去學校」是「果」，故連接詞用 so。
q:
A：I didn’t see you yesterday. What happened?
B：I ＿＿＿ a bad headache ＿＿＿ I didn’t go to school.

e: A 問「為什麼」Sam 今天早上沒跟 B 一起去市集，故用疑問詞 why；而「他今天早上沒有跟我一起去市集」是「果」，「他生病」是「因」，故連接詞用 because。
q:
A：＿＿＿ didn’t Sam go to the market with you this morning?
B：He didn’t ＿＿＿ he was sick.

e: A 是在問「為什麼」B 的朋友沒有參加比賽，故用疑問詞 why；而「他不能參加比賽」是「果」，「他昨天體育課的時候受傷」是「因」，故連接詞用 because。
q:
A：＿＿＿ didn’t your friend join the race?
B：＿＿＿ he got hurt in the PE class yesterday.

e: 所有格 my 不可單獨使用，後方應加上名詞，此處應使用所有格代名詞 mine 表示 my shoes；表達「製作某物給某人」，且物為代名詞 them 時，用「make＋them＋for＋人」。
q: These are my brother’s shoes, and ＿＿＿ are over there. My mom made ＿＿＿ as our birthday gifts（禮物）.

e: 表達「將某物給某人」，且物為人稱代名詞 it 或 them 時，用「give＋it / them＋to＋人」。
q:
A：Is the picture on the table yours?
B：Yes. I’m going to（將要）give ＿＿＿ to thank her for helping me with the English test.

e: 導致睡不多的原因是頭痛，故不是第一格用 Because，即是第二格用 so；because 與 so 皆為表達因果關係的連接詞，故不可用在同一句子中。
q: ＿＿＿ James had a bad headache last night ＿＿＿ he didn’t get much sleep. No wonder he has dark circles（黑眼圈）under his eyes today.

e: 「手機沒帶在身上」是「因」，「無法打電話」是「果」，故須在第一格填 Because，或在第二格填 so。because 與 so 不可用在同一句子中。
q: Sorry, I’m late. ＿＿＿ I didn’t bring my cellphone with me ＿＿＿ I couldn’t call you on my way here.

e: buy＋人＋物＝buy＋物＋for＋人。give＋人＋物＝give＋物＋to＋人。
q:
A：Why not ＿＿＿? She loves fruits.
B：Great idea.

e: 由 B 的答句可知，A 是在問「為什麼」Meg 昨晚沒跟 Peggy 去看電影，故用疑問詞 why；「她昨天下班很累，需要好好休息」是「因」，故用連接詞 because。
q:
A：＿＿＿ didn’t Meg go to the movies with Peggy last night?
B：＿＿＿ she was very tired（疲累的）after work yesterday, and she needed a good rest.

e: 表達「寄某物給某人」，且物為代名詞 it 或 them 時，用「send＋it / them＋to＋人」。
q: Here are some letters. Could you please help me send ＿＿＿ this afternoon?

e: 表達「把某物給某人」可用「give＋物＋to＋人」或「give＋人＋物」；「給小孩們圖畫書」是「果」，「今天是兒童節」是「因」，故用連接詞 because。
q:
A：Why did you give the children ＿＿＿ the picture books?
B：＿＿＿ it’s Children’s Day today.

e: because of 後面只能接名詞，不可接子句。
q: Stanley and I didn’t visit the art museum last weekend because of ＿＿＿.

e: 表達「把某物給某人」可用「give＋物＋to＋人」或「give＋人＋物」。
q:
A：Could you give ＿＿＿?
B：Sure. Here you are.

e: because 後接完整的子句；because of 後接名詞。
q:
A：I got a good grade on the science test.
B：That’s great.
A：Thank you. I could do well（好地）on the test all ＿＿＿ your help.

e: A：你現在感覺如何？ B：「今天早上我吃了一些藥」，但我的頭現在依然很痛。 A：那太糟了。
q:
A：How do you feel now?
B：＿＿＿, but my head still hurts now.
A：That’s too bad.
o: I can bring you some ice cream
I took some medicine this morning

e: 由回答「我做了一個蛋糕給他。」可知，是問「你給了 Luke 什麼？」。
q: A：＿＿＿ B：I made a cake for him.

Jen：What’s it about?
John：A cart race. Two people work together to prepare their cart for the race. To catch people’s eye, every cart is different. Look at this.
Jen：How funny! It is just like a guitar.
John：In the race, one sits in their cart, and the other pushes it all the way to the finish line.
Jen：That’s hard.
John：Right, and they might fall off their carts. But it seldom happens. Everyone joins the race for fun, not for the prize, so they don’t run very fast.
Jen：I see. So, what’s the prize?
John：It was always NT$1,000 before, but this year, it’s NT$1500.
Jen：Maybe we can join the race next year.

------------------------------------------------------
Dear Susan,
You finally tried Zang Zang Bao. That was great. But how does it get so popular in Taiwan? Do you know that? Well, everything began in Korea. Many famous people there ate Zang Zang Bao and didn’t wipe their mouths right away. Then they took photos and uploaded them to social media. Because of these interesting photos, Zang Zang Bao got people’s attention. Many people in Korea stood in a long line for it. Later, a famous person in Taiwan did the same thing. She uploaded her photo of eating Zang Zang Bao to social media, and then many people were crazy about it, too. By the way, I have free time this Saturday afternoon. Why don’t we meet up at Jenny’s and wait in line to enjoy some Zang Zang Bao?
Paula

q: Building different kinds of toy houses is i＿＿＿g to my cousin. She always has many ideas.

e: A：Karen 正在做什麼？ B：她正在「訓練」她的狗坐下。
q:
A：What is Karen doing?
B：She is t＿＿＿ning her dog to sit down.

e: Jane 上個月每天都在讀書。「令人遺憾地」，她沒有通過這次的考試。
q: Jane studied every day last month. S＿＿＿y, she didn’t pass（通過）the test this time.

e: A：為什麼這麼多人在這裡？ B：他們是「警察」。他們來這裡調查案件。
q:
A：Why are so many people here?
B：They’re ＿＿＿. They are here to look into the case（調查案件）.

e: A：Linda 是好的「女演員」嗎？ B：是的，她是。她在許多部電影裡表演得很好。
q:
A：Is Linda a good ＿＿＿?
B：Yes, she is. She acted very well（很好）in many movies.

e: Mike 是名好的「男演員」。我們喜歡看他的電視節目。
q: Mike is a good ＿＿＿. We like to watch his TV shows.

e: 這位商人太忙了。他需要一位「祕書」來協助他的工作。
q: The businessman（商人）is too busy. He needs a ＿＿＿ to help him with his work.

e: Adele 是名「歌手」。我喜歡她美麗的聲音，並且喜歡聽她的歌。
q: Adele is a ＿＿＿. I like her beautiful voice and enjoy listening to her songs.

q: Mrs. Lo is a(n) ______. She has to do housework and take care of her kids. She is busy at home all day.

q: Tim is a(n) ＿＿＿, and his job is to serve（端）food in the restaurant.

e: A：你看！餐廳裡的那人是你姐姐嗎？ B：是的，她在那裡工作。她是「女服務生」。
q:
A：Look! Is that your sister in the restaurant?
B：Yes, she works there. She’s a(n) ______.

e: Allen 撰寫有關運動員的新聞報導。他是一名體育「記者」。
q: Allen writes news stories about sports players. He is a sports ＿＿＿.

e: James 聚集信件並把它們送給人們。他是一名「郵差」。
q: James collects letters and brings them to people. He is a ＿＿＿.

e: Ivan 擅長「演戲」。他常在電影中扮演重要角色。
q: Ivan is good at ＿＿＿. He often plays important roles in movies.

e: 造訪不同國家很「有趣」，因為人們可以看到許多新事物。
q: Visiting different countries is ＿＿＿ because people can see many new things.

e: Amy 是一名年輕「作家」。許多青少年喜歡她的書。
q: Amy is a young ＿＿＿. Many teenagers like her books.

e: A：你「未來」想從事什麼？ B：我大學畢業後想成為歌手。
q:
A：What do you want to be in the ＿＿＿?
B：I want to be a singer after I finish college（大學）.

e: 我爺爺以前用「相機」拍照，但現在他用他的手機拍照。
q: My grandpa used a ＿＿＿ to take photos before, but now he uses his cellphone to do that.

e: 學生學習在校內相處融洽是「重要的」，因為這樣有助於防止霸凌。
q: It’s ＿＿＿ for students to learn to get along（相處融洽）with one another at school because it helps stop bullying（霸凌）.

e: 這首歌非常受到青少年「歡迎」。幾乎每位中學生都會唱它。
q: This song is very ＿＿＿ with teenagers. Almost every high school student can sing it.

e: 當我們看照片時都笑了。它們真「有趣」。
q: We all laughed（笑）when we saw the photos. They were so ＿＿＿.

e: Michael 下週一有數學考試。他「計畫」這週每天都到圖書館念書。
q: Michael has a math test next Monday. He ______ to study at the library every day this week.

e: A：Daniel 在做什麼？ B：他正在找他的鑰匙。「沒有」它們，他無法進門。
q:
A：What is Daniel doing?
B：He’s looking for his keys. He can’t get into his house ＿＿＿ them.

e: A：你看起來很累。你昨晚沒有睡夠嗎？ B：不，我沒有。我昨晚做了惡「夢」。
q:
A：You look tired（看起來很累）. Didn’t you have enough sleep?
B：No, I didn’t. I had a terrible ＿＿＿ last night.

e: 我媽媽在車上時常聽「音樂」。她在空閒時也會寫歌。
q: My mother often listens to ＿＿＿ when she is in the car. She also likes to write songs in her free time.

e: 我表妹是十四歲的「青少年」，但她現在已在學打鼓。那是她的夢想。
q: My cousin is a fourteen-year-old ＿＿＿, but she is learning to play the drums now. That is her dream.

e: 昨晚的籃球賽很「刺激」。許多人在看完球賽後因為太開心而無法入睡。
q: The basketball game was ______ last night. Many people couldn’t get to sleep after they watched it because they were too happy.

e: 昨天下午一些學生在球場上為了一顆籃球而「打架」直到他們的老師前來拉開他們。
q: Yesterday afternoon some students were ______ for a basketball on the court until their teacher came and pulled them apart（拉開他們）.

e: Mr. Kao 以前日以繼夜地工作。現在他有很多「錢」並時常用它幫助人們。
q: Mr. Kao worked day and night before. Now he has a lot of ＿＿＿ and often uses it to help people.

e: 那餐廳以它的雞肉麵而「聞名」。它們既特別且美味。
q: The restaurant（餐廳）is ＿＿＿ for its chicken noodles. They are special and delicious.

e: A：看！這位 YouTuber 很特別，她常在網路上表演「吉他」。 B：酷哦！她真地很棒。也許她以前在學校是學音樂的。
q:
A：Look! This YouTuber is very special. She often plays the ＿＿＿ on the Internet.
B：Cool! She is really good. Maybe she studied music in school before.

e: 在這座大城市，有很多汽車「工廠」。許多人在那裡上班。
q: There are a lot of car ＿＿＿ in this big city. Many people work there.

e: Frank「訓練」他的狗很多次。牠現在會接球和握手。
q: Frank ＿＿＿ his dog many times. Now, it can catch a ball and shake hands（握手）.

e: 那些醫生們已盡力搶救那個男孩。「令人遺憾地」，他還是喪命了。
q: The doctors tried to save the boy. ______, he still lost his life.

e: 昨晚睡覺前，Ted 給他女兒「講」了一個有趣的故事。然後她要 Ted 每天都要念故事給她聽。
q: Ted ______ his daughter an interesting story before bed last night. Then she asked Ted to read stories to her every day.

e: Alex 和 Ann 參加了表演和歌唱課程。他們想學習成為明星。
q: Alex and Ann joined an acting and singing program. They want to learn to be ______.

e: A：Greg 的媽媽是位有名的舞者。 B：或許 Greg 是從她那裡得到舞蹈的「天分」，因為他很會跳舞。
q:
A：Greg’s mother is a famous dancer（舞者）.
B：Maybe Greg got his ______ for dancing from her because he is really good at dancing.

e: 要獨自完成這個報告十分困難，所以 Tom「和」五名同學「組隊」來完成它。
q: It was hard to finish this report alone（獨自地）, so Tom ______ five classmates to do it.

e: 我只睡三小時，因為我和弟弟「熬夜」看足球比賽。
q: I only slept for three hours because I ______ late watching the soccer game with my brother.

e: 現在正在下雨。孩子們，停止「彼此」玩耍並進入室內。
q: It’s raining now. Children, stop playing with ______ and go inside.

e: 動名詞當主詞時視為單數，應搭配 be 動詞 is。
q: Taking care of kids ＿＿＿ not interesting to me at all.

e: 句中已有 be 動詞當主要動詞，故主詞須用動名詞。
q: ＿＿＿ enough water is important and healthy for us.

e: 虛主詞 it 開頭的句型，後面的真主詞常以不定詞呈現。
q: For my brother, it is fun ＿＿＿ computer games.

e: like 後面可接動名詞或不定詞。
q:
A：I like ＿＿＿ to music. What about you?
B：Me too.

e: 動詞 want 後面若接動詞，該動詞須以不定詞的形式呈現。
q:
A：Why does Jerry work day and night?
B：He wants ＿＿＿ more money to buy a new house.

e: 「have＋to V」表「必須做……」。
q:
A：Next Monday is my daughter’s birthday. I have ＿＿＿ new clothes for her as gifts.
B：Let’s find some beautiful clothes for her.

e: 介系詞之後若接動詞，該動詞須以動名詞呈現。
q:
A：Amy and I are thinking about ＿＿＿ a trip（旅行）to Hualien.
B：Can I go with you?
A：Let me ask Amy about it first.

e: 第一句為祈使句，故第一格用原形動詞；表達「做……是……」用「It＋be 動詞...＋to V」，故第二格用不定詞。
q: ______ your hands before meals（餐）. It’s not good ______ with dirty hands.

e: 介系詞後面若接動詞，該動詞應以動名詞呈現。
q:
A：We have to speak English to Julia.
B：Why?
A：Because she is not good at ＿＿＿ Chinese.

e: enjoy 後面須接動名詞當受詞。
q:
A：My son enjoys ＿＿＿ video games. He always plays four hours a day.
B：That’s a lot of time.

e: 虛主詞 it 開頭的句型，後面的真主詞常以不定詞的形式呈現，且 be 動詞應視所發生的時間來決定用什麼時態。由子句 when they were little 可知 be 動詞要用過去式 was。
q: It ＿＿＿ fun for James and his brothers ＿＿＿ soccer when they were little. They often played for three hours after school.

e: 由第一句可知 Mike 就讀國中時「因為」太矮，所以打籃球對他來說是件困難的事，故第一格用 was，第二格用 because。
q: It ______ hard for Mike to play basketball when he was in junior high school ______ he was too short. Now, he’s very tall and good at playing it.

e: 介系詞 at 後面的動詞形式須為動名詞，動詞 practice 後面須接動名詞。
q: Jeremy is good at ＿＿＿ basketball because he practices ＿＿＿ it every day.

e: need / want 後接 to V，而 have to 表「必須」，後接原形動詞；表達「做……是……」用「It＋be 動詞...＋to V」，故在此兩空格皆符合的選項為 (C)。
q: Sorry, I ______ go home now because it’s 11：00 p.m. ______ dangerous（危險的）to stay out late at night.

e: 此為虛主詞 It 代替真主詞不定詞（to V）開頭的句型；助動詞 can 後接原形動詞。
q:
A：Janet is smart. ＿＿＿ easy for her to learn new things.
B：You can ＿＿＿ that again.

e: like / enjoy＋V-ing、like / want / plan＋to V，故第一格可用 likes 或 enjoys；表達「做……是……」用「It＋be 動詞...＋to V」，故第二格用 to do。
q: Jenny ______ helping poor people. It is nice of her ______ that.

e: 動名詞當主詞時視為單數，應搭配 be 動詞 is。
q: Sean, don’t add too much salt to the soup（湯）. ＿＿＿ too much salt ＿＿＿ bad for your health.

e: 由問句 Was your dog swimming…? 可知答句也要用過去進行式回答，肯定簡答為 Yes, it was.；表達「喜愛做……」可用 love to V 或 love＋V-ing，而 and 為對等連接詞，故在此用 love to swim and (to) catch balls。
q:
A：Was your dog swimming when I saw you at the beach?
B：Yes, it ______. It loves ______ and catch balls.

e: 第一句由 is 可知空格須用不定詞或動名詞當主詞，故第一格可用 To learn 或 Learning；表達「做……是……」用「It＋be 動詞...＋to V」，故第二格用 to find。
q: ______ English is very important. If（如果）you speak good English, it might be easy for you ______ a job.

e: like 後面可接動名詞或不定詞；動名詞當主詞時視為單數，應搭配表單數的 be 動詞 is。
q:
A：Why do those kids like ＿＿＿?
B：Because drawing pictures ＿＿＿ fun for them.

e: 句中已有 be 動詞 is 當主要動詞，主詞須用動名詞或不定詞。表達「對某人而言」，用「for＋人」表示；「of＋人」通常用於形容「人格特質」。
q: ＿＿＿ computers is difficult ＿＿＿ my grandpa, so he often asks me for help.

e: enjoy 後面須接動名詞。根據前句的 enjoys，後句應用現在簡單式動詞。
q: Lucy enjoys ＿＿＿. She ＿＿＿ a lot in her free time.

e: love 後面可接動名詞或不定詞。go＋V-ing 表示「從事……活動」。
q: Mr. Liu loves ＿＿＿. He goes ＿＿＿ every morning.

e: 表達「練習（做）……」用 practice＋V-ing；表達「想做……」用 want to V。

e: 介系詞後面若接動詞，該動詞應以動名詞呈現；「help＋人＋with＋名詞」表「幫助某人某事」。
q:
A：Thank you for ＿＿＿ me ＿＿＿ my math homework.
B：Don’t mention it（別客氣）.

e: keep 表「一直做……」之意時，後面接的動詞應以動名詞呈現。
q: Jessica couldn’t find her pencil box, so she kept ＿＿＿ for it in the classroom.

e: 「叫某人不要做某動作」的句型為「tell sb not to V」，而「教某人做某動作」的句型為「teach sb to V」。
q: My parents always tell my brother and me ＿＿＿ each other（互相）. They teach us ＿＿＿ nice to each other.

e: 「叫某人做某動作」的句型為「tell sb to V」，而虛主詞 it 開頭的句型，後面的真主詞常以不定詞的形式呈現。
q: Doctors always tell us ＿＿＿ more fruit and vegetables（蔬菜）, but it is not easy ＿＿＿ a person’s eating habits.

e: 第一個空格的句子中，「am training」為主要動詞，後面的動詞應以不定詞形式呈現；第二個空格，介系詞後的動詞要以動名詞的形式呈現。

e: plan 與 need 後面接動詞時，該動詞皆以不定詞的形式呈現。

e: 第一個空格，begin / began 後面接動詞時，該動詞以不定詞或動名詞的形式呈現；第二個空格的句子，「is learning」為主要動詞，後面的動詞須以不定詞的形式呈現。

e: 由 is 可知第一句主詞可用不定詞或動名詞；finish 後接 V-ing。
q: ______ before bed is my sister’s everyday habit. She finishes ______ five books every month.

e: 虛主詞 it 開頭的句型中，nice 為形容「人格特質」，表對方人很好，介系詞用 of；又 and 為對等連接詞，連接兩個動詞（to＋V… and V…）或連接兩個不定詞（to＋V… and to V…）。
q:
A：It was nice ＿＿＿ you to walk my pet dog, Lucky, and ＿＿＿ food for him when I was out of town.
B：No problem. I like Lucky. He is a good dog.

e: like 後面可接動名詞或不定詞當受詞。若接兩個不定詞時，則第二個不定詞片語的 to 可以省略。
q: My mother likes ＿＿＿ and ＿＿＿ songs at the same time.

e: practice 後面的動詞須以動名詞的形式呈現，而 or 為對等連接詞，故空格也應為動名詞，答案選 acting。
q: On weekends, Eric practices playing the drums or ＿＿＿. He is on his way to becoming a popular star.

e: 第一個空格，learn、plan 後面的動詞以不定詞呈現，enjoy、finish 後面接動名詞，而從前後語意可知，答案應為 enjoy；第二個空格，介系詞後的動詞要以動名詞呈現。
q: I ______ exercising in the mountains, but I never do that without ______ my dog with me. He can protect me.

e: keep 後面須接動名詞，而 stop 表「停止某個動作」時，後接動名詞。
q:
A：Why does Toby keep ＿＿＿?
B：He can’t stop ＿＿＿ because he likes to share his school life with other people.

e: 表達「計畫做……」用 plan to V；表達「對……來說」用「for＋人（受格）」。
q: James is planning ______ the baseball school team although（雖然）it is difficult ______ him to play baseball.

e: 表達「喜歡做……」可用 like to V 或 like＋V-ing，而 and 為對等連接詞，故第一格要配合 listening 用 reading；第二句由複數 things 可知是指看書和聽音樂這兩件事，故第二格用 They’re。
q: I like ______ books and listening to music. ______ my favorite（最喜愛的）things to do in my free time.

e: need / want 後接 to V；like 可接 to V 或 V-ing；enjoy 後接 V-ing；when 連接兩相同時態的句子，因 enjoyed 和 liked 皆為過去式，故 be 動詞用 was。
q: Judy ______ watching baseball games when she ______ a student. However, she is too busy to（而無法）do that now.

e: start 後面可接不定詞或動名詞；learn 後面須接不定詞。
q: Tina started ______ the guitar when she was young. Now she is also learning ______ the drums. Playing in front of people is her dream.

e: 介系詞之後若接動詞，該動詞須以動名詞呈現；want 後接 to V。
q: My grandma is good at ______ beef（牛肉）noodles. We want ______ them every time she makes them.

e: 「ask sb to V」表「要求某人做……」；「That / It＋be 動詞＋形容詞＋of＋人」則是形容某人個性的特質。
q:
A：We didn’t ask Nancy ______ us, but she just did.
B：That was very nice ______ her to do so.

e: 「stop to V」表「停下來去做某事」之意。
q: Frank was thirsty when he was playing tennis, so he stopped ______ some water.

e: B 說的第一個子句為祈使句，而 keep 接動名詞，need 接不定詞，故答案為 Keep。
q:
A：How can I pass（通過）the tests?
B：______ studying three hours a day, and you can make it.

e: 第一格後的 taking photos 視為單數主詞，故應填入 be 動詞 Is；第二格則必須用虛主詞 It 代替之後的不定詞片語（真主詞）。
q:
A：______ taking photos interesting?
B：Sure. ______ is interesting to take photos of these beautiful mountains.

e: 不定詞片語表「目的」，意即「為了……」。
q: ______ the swimming race, Gina practices five hours a day, seven days a week.

e: 「be busy＋V-ing」表「忙於……」；finish 後接動名詞。
q:
A：Henry, could you help me with my homework?
B：Sorry. I’m busy ______ the floor. Can you wait until I finish ______ it?
A：Of course.

e: 「It’s very important for sb to V」表「對某人而言，……是非常重要的」；give up 表「放棄」，後方接動名詞。
q:
A：I can’t stand（忍受）studying English two hours a day.
B：But it’s very important ______ you to do that, so don’t give up ______.

e: 主詞 playing in the water 和 eating ice cream 視為兩件事，故空格應為 be 動詞 are。
q: Playing in the water and eating ice cream ＿＿＿ fun on hot summer days. We really enjoy doing these things in summer.

e: 若將 when it is cool 移置句首，即可知此其實為「動名詞／不定詞…＋be 動詞...」的句型，故第一格用 Riding，第二格用 is。
q:
A：______ a bike（腳踏車）along the river when it is cool ______ a great thing to do.
B：Let’s rent（租）two bikes now.

e: 第一個空格，由前後文語意可知，Carl 重感冒，所以他爸爸「要求他不要」熬夜讀書，應用「asked him not to…」；「didn’t ask him to…」是指「沒有要求他去做某件事」。第二個空格，stay up 後面接動名詞。
q: Carl caught a bad cold, so his dad ______ stay up ______ tonight.

q: Sorry. I don’t ＿＿＿ your cellphone number. Could you please tell me again?

e: 現在這輛車子的「價錢」很低。我們應該趁便宜時買一輛。
q: The ＿＿＿ of the car is low now. We should buy one when it is cheap（便宜的）.

e: 明晚會停水，所以要「記得」儲存足夠的水。
q: There will be a water outage（停水）tomorrow night, so ＿＿＿ to store（儲存）enough water.

e: 抱歉，我現在沒有任何「現金」。我可以明天付錢給你嗎？
q: Sorry, I don’t have any ＿＿＿ now. Could I pay you tomorrow?

e: 那個夏令營非常有趣。我們有許多「美好的」回憶。
q: The summer camp was very interesting. We had a lot of ______ memories（回憶）.

e: 由 Are you going to 可知問句的時態為未來式，故第一格可用 this Sunday 或 next weekend；如果下雨「將會」待在家，故兩空格皆符合的選項為 (C)。
q:
A：Are you going to the beach ______?
B：Yes, but if（如果）it rains, we ______ stay at home.

e: 由回答 I’m happy I went 可知，第一個空格須用過去式助動詞 Did；由 tomorrow 可知，第二個空格要用未來式，可用 will go、am going to go、am going 表達。
q:
A：______ you have a good time at Laura’s place tonight?
B：Yes. I’m happy I went, and I ______ there again tomorrow.

e: 由 No, I didn’t 可知問句的 this morning 指過去時間，故第一格可用 Did 或 Didn’t；由後句的邀約可知 this afternoon 指未來時間，故第二格要用 will。
q:
A：______ you go swimming this morning?
B：No, I didn’t, but I ______ this afternoon. Do you want to come with me?

e: be going to 的問句句型為「Be 動詞＋主詞＋going to＋原形動詞...?」。
q:
A：＿＿＿ the movie ＿＿＿ begin?
B：Yes. Please turn off（關閉）your cellphone now.

e: 表達「將要……」，可用「will＋原形動詞」或「be going to＋原形動詞」。
q: My friends and I ＿＿＿ on a trip to Bangkok next week. We’re really excited（感到興奮的）.

e: 此為「be going to＋原形動詞」用法，主詞為複數人稱，be 動詞用 are。
q: Amy and Jason ＿＿＿ play the guitar after school.

e: 由 came back 可知，須搭配表示過去的時間副詞；由「be going to＋V」可知，須搭配表示未來的時間副詞。
q: Jeff came back from Singapore ＿＿＿, but he is going to visit Japan ＿＿＿.

e: 答句為 I will，可知問句的助動詞也要用 will；help 後面接原形動詞或「to＋V」。
q:
A：＿＿＿ you help Lucy ＿＿＿ the floor?
B：Of course, I will.

e: 由時間副詞 tomorrow 可知，問句應用未來式「Will＋主詞＋原形動詞...?」或「Be 動詞＋主詞＋going to＋原形動詞...?」。
q:
A：＿＿＿ you buy some cakes for us tomorrow?
B：No, I ＿＿＿. Cakes are not good for your health.

e: 答句的 won’t 為助動詞 will 與 not 的縮寫，可知問句的助動詞也要用 will，後面接「主詞＋原形動詞」。
q:
A：＿＿＿ come to the party tonight?
B：No, she won’t. She has to study for tests.

e: 表達「將要……」，可用「will＋原形動詞」或「be going to＋原形動詞」。wait須搭配不定詞。
q:
A：The singer ＿＿＿ come to our school this Saturday.
B：Cool! He is my favorite（最喜愛的）singer. I can’t wait ＿＿＿ him.

e: 由空格後為「to＋V」可知，此為「be going to＋原形動詞」用法。
q:
A：Is Mom in the kitchen now?
B：Yes, and she ＿＿＿ to cook dinner. Dinner will be ready in one hour.

e: 由問句 will 可知，答句也要用 will；help的句型為「help＋受詞＋（to）＋原形動詞」。
q:
A：What will you do tomorrow?
B：I ＿＿＿ my dad ＿＿＿ flowers at the market.

e: will 後面接原形動詞。由問句 Will... 可知，答句應為 won’t 或 will。由文意可知，Nick 星期三不會去圖書館，用 won’t。
q:
A：Will Nick ＿＿＿ to the library this Wednesday?
B：No, he ＿＿＿. He goes there only on weekends.

e: be going to 的問句句型為「Be 動詞＋主詞＋going to＋原形動詞...?」。問句由 be 動詞提問，且回答是 no，故為否定簡答 they aren’t。
q:
A：Are they ＿＿＿ eat some delicious cakes?
B：No, they ＿＿＿. The cakes are too sweet（甜的）for them.

e: 「There＋be動詞」表「（某地）有……」，不與 have 連用。此句 There will be...＝There are going to be...（將有……）。
q: There ＿＿＿ many people at the famous restaurant this weekend. We should get there early.

e: 由答句 No, he isn’t. 及 going to play 可知，問句為未來式 be going to，故第一格可用 Is 或 Isn’t，第二格用 going to practice。
q:
A：______ Sam ______ badminton with his friends?
B：No, he isn’t. He’s going to play video games with them.

e: 由 going to take 及 tomorrow 可知問答句皆使用 be going to 的未來式，故第一格用 Is；由 no 可知為否定簡答，故第二格用 isn’t。
q:
A：______ Joyce going to take a trip to Taitung with you tomorrow?
B：No, she ______. She’ll have to help her brother prepare for an important test.

e: 由回答 she won’t 可知問句須用「will＋原形動詞」，由 She’s＝She is 可知，後句要用「be going to＋原形動詞」表達「將要……」。
q:
A：Will Sara ＿＿＿ to our house and have dinner together?
B：No, she won’t. She’s ＿＿＿ study at home.

e: 由答句 I’ll go 可知，問句可用 Will 或 Won’t 起首。
q:
A：＿＿＿ you go camping with us next Saturday?
B：OK. I’ll go with you.

e: 表達「將要……」，可用「will＋原形動詞」或「be going to＋原形動詞」。
q: Julia’s birthday is next Saturday. Her father ＿＿＿ have a birthday party for her.

e: will 後面接原形動詞。
q: Fiona will ＿＿＿ for her math test in the afternoon. She can’t have lunch with you.

e: 由回答「也許大約四十分鐘」可知，詢問花費多久時間，疑問詞用 How long。it 為虛主詞，代替句中的真主詞 to go to the bank。
q:
A：＿＿＿ does it take ＿＿＿ to the bank?
B：I’m not sure. Maybe for about forty minutes.

e: 由回答「大約三個月」可知，是詢問花費多久時間，疑問詞用 How long。
q:
A：＿＿＿ did you spend on the project（計畫）?
B：About three months.

e: 由回答「大約十分鐘」可知，是詢問花費多久時間，疑問詞用 How long。
q:
A：＿＿＿ will it take you to walk to the bank?
B：About ten minutes.

e: 由回答「新臺幣三千元」可知，是詢問花費多少錢，疑問詞用 How much。
q:
A：＿＿＿ did it cost Julia to buy the shoes?
B：Three thousand NT dollars.

e: 「人＋spend＋金錢＋on 物品」表示「某人花多少錢在某物品上」、「人＋pay＋受詞＋to＋V」表「某人付錢叫人做某事」。
q: Ted ＿＿＿ a lot of money on an English program（課程）, and he ＿＿＿ a tutor（家教）to teach his eight-year-old son.

e: 「人＋spend＋金錢＋on＋物」表「某人花了……錢買某物」。
q: I ＿＿＿ NT$4,000 ＿＿＿ my wife’s birthday gift. It was a nice watch.

e: 主詞為人，搭配花費時間的動詞為 spend。
q: In the past, people would ＿＿＿ hours writing letters, but now people use LINE to send messages.

e: 「A＋pay＋B＋金錢」表「A 付給 B……錢」。「人＋spend＋金錢＋on＋物」表「某人花了……錢買某物」。「人＋pay＋金錢＋for＋物」表「某人付了……錢買某物」。「物＋cost＋人＋金錢」表「某物花了某人……錢」。
q:
A：Did you buy the book from Tom yesterday?
B：Yes. I ＿＿＿.
o: paid one hundred NT dollars for Tom
spent one hundred NT dollars in the book
paid one hundred NT dollars for the book
cost one hundred NT dollars to buy the book

e: 由主詞 you 及 for 可知為「人＋pay＋金錢＋for＋物」的用法，所以第一格用 pay；由 It（= The computer）可知為「物＋cost＋人＋金錢」的用法。
q:
A：How much did you ＿＿＿ for the computer?
B：It only ＿＿＿ me NT$12,000 because the computer store is having a big sale（特價）today.

e: 根據回答「三萬元」，表示問「多少錢」，疑問詞用 How much。「數字＋thousand＋dollars」時，thousand 字尾不加 s。
q:
A：＿＿＿ did your parents pay for your new computer?
B：Thirty ＿＿＿ dollars.

e: 「人＋pay＋金錢＋for＋物」表示「某人付了……錢買某物」。
q: Bill is going to ＿＿＿ a lot of money ＿＿＿ the new car. I can’t believe that.

e: 以事物為主詞，搭配花費時間的動詞 take。「decide to＋原形動詞」表「決定……」。
q:
A：It ＿＿＿ me a lot of time to find my dream job.
B：So, why did you decide ＿＿＿ a cook?

e: 「It takes / took＋人＋時間＋to V」表示「做某事花了某人……時間」。
q: It ＿＿＿ me a week to finish the work because it was really difficult.

e: 「It takes / took＋人＋時間＋to V」表示「做某事花了某人……時間」。
q: It took the group two months ＿＿＿ the beach. They met on weekends and worked together with the local people there.

e: 「It takes / took＋人＋時間＋to V」表「做某事花了某人……時間」。
q: ＿＿＿ took me half an hour to write a card for my mom.

e: 「人＋spend＋時間＋V-ing」表「某人花……時間做某事」。
q: Sam ＿＿＿ a lot of time ＿＿＿ for the test, but he still didn’t pass it.

e: 「人＋spend＋金錢＋on＋物」表「某人花了……錢買某物」。
q: Bruce ＿＿＿ almost all his money on the house, and his dream of having his own house finally came true.

e: 「spend＋時間＋V-ing」表「花……時間做某事」。
q: ＿＿＿ thirty minutes practicing English every day, and you can speak it well（好地）.

e: 由 ... me two hundred NT dollars 可知為「物＋cost＋人＋錢」的用法。
q: I bought two boxes of face masks. They ＿＿＿ me two hundred NT dollars.

e: 「某物＋cost＋某人＋金錢」表示「某物花了某人……錢」。
q: The red line parking ticket（停車罰單）＿＿＿ Noah NT$900.

e: 「某物＋cost＋某人＋金錢」表示「某物花了某人……錢」。
q: The dress（洋裝）＿＿＿ Alice a lot of money. She decided to wear it to the party tomorrow.

e: 「It cost＋人＋金錢＋to＋原形動詞」表「做某事花某人……錢」。
q: It ＿＿＿ me nine hundred NT dollars to get the fan.

e: 「數字＋thousand＋可數名詞」表示「多少千……」；「thousands of＋可數名詞」表示「數以千計的……」。
q: Nina found ＿＿＿ NT dollars under her bed this morning.

e: 「人＋spend＋金錢＋on＋物」表「某人花了……錢買某物」。
q:
A：Are the show tickets expensive?
B：Yes. I spent NT$8,000 ＿＿＿ my ticket.

e: 「人＋spend＋時間＋V-ing」表「某人花了……時間做某事」。
q: Lily’s science report was hard. She spent two hours ＿＿＿ it last night.

e: A：為什麼非洲的大象要長途跋涉找水源？ B：因為現在不是雨季，「這裡的河即將乾枯」。 A：我了解了。
q:
A：Why do these elephants in Africa（非洲）go a long way to find water?
B：Because it’s not the rainy season now, ＿＿＿.
A：I see.
o: this is going to be exciting
the rivers here are going to dry out
the zebras will stay here until the elephants come back

e: A：你猜怎麼著？王先生跟王太太下週要搬到另一個城市。 B：真地嗎？那他們要怎麼處理他們的舊房子？ A：「他們想以高價賣掉房子。」 B：如果他們賣掉房子，他們會賺多少錢？ A：大約新臺幣兩百萬。
q:
A：Guess what? Mr. and Mrs. Wang are going to move to another city next week.
B：Really? What will they do with their old house?
A：______
B：How much money will they make if（如果）they sell their house?
A：About two million（百萬）NT dollars.
o: They want to sell the house at a high price.
The house doesn’t cost them much money.
They will pay NT$9,800,000 for the house.
They plan to spend NT$9,800,000 on the house.

e: A：你今天下午將去參觀博物館嗎？ B：當然。現在那裡有 Monet 的畫作。 A：真地嗎？我喜歡這位偉大的畫家。「我要和你一起去。」
q:
A：Are you going to visit the museum this afternoon?
B：Of course. There are Monet’s paintings（畫）there now.
A：Really? I like the great painter（畫家）. ______
o: It won’t take you much time.
I’m not going there this afternoon.

e: A：我們到了。安帕瓦水上市場！ B：感謝你帶我來到這裡。我等不及要參觀市場了。 A：慢慢來。「我們會在這裡花費三小時。」
q:
A：Here we are. Amphawa Floating Market!
B：Thanks for taking me here. I can’t wait to visit the market.
A：Take your time. ______
o: We’ll go there on our own.
It won’t take you much time.
How long will they stay here?
We are going to spend three hours here.

e: A：「你下個月要造訪曼谷嗎？」 B：是的，我是。我等不及要看看這著名的城市。 A：祝你旅行愉快。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：Yes, I am. I can’t wait to see the famous city.
A：Have a good trip.
o: Will you go to the famous restaurant?
Are you going to visit Bangkok next month?
Is your brother going to go swimming this weekend?

e: A：「你明天要跟我們去造訪水上市場嗎？」 B：好啊。造訪水上市場很有趣。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：Yes. Visiting floating markets is very interesting.
o: Are you going to the supermarket?
What are you going to do tomorrow?
Is visiting night markets popular here?
Are you going to visit the floating market with us tomorrow?

e: A：我這週可以花多少錢買零食，爸爸？ B：「大約新臺幣兩百元。」吃太多零食對你不好。
q:
A：How much money can I spend on the snacks this week, Dad?
B：＿＿＿ Having too many snacks isn’t good for you.
o: I decided to stay at home.
They only cost me fifty NT dollars.
We’ll stay in the hotel for one week.

e: A：你為什麼這麼疲累？ B：因為我今天早上跟我朋友踢足球。 A：你們花了多少時間比賽？ B：「我們花了三小時踢足球」且沒有休息。 A：難怪。
q:
A：Why are you so tired（疲累的）?
B：Because my friends and I played soccer this morning.
A：How long did you spend playing the game?
B：＿＿＿ without taking a break.
A：No wonder.
o: I am going to get some sleep
We spent three hours playing soccer
We didn’t play soccer until 11 o’clock
It took me 30 minutes to get to the park

e: A：你這週日要去教堂做禮拜嗎？ B：「不會，但我下星期會。」
q:
A：Will you go to church this Sunday?
B：＿＿＿
o: No, but I will do it next week.
No, I will go to church with you.
Yes, I’m going to go shopping, too.
Yes, I’m going to spend my Sunday at the beach.

e: A：Johnson 夫婦將會前往百貨公司嗎？ B：是的，「他們要去購買禮物。」
q:
A：Are Mr. and Mrs. Johnson going to leave for the department store?
B：Yes, ＿＿＿.
o: they are going to shop for gifts
it won’t take you too much time
Mr. Johnson is going to take a trip
Mrs. Johnson goes to the department store

e: A：我們吃完晚餐後將要做什麼？ B：「我們將要去超級市場買些飲料。」
q:
A：What are we going to do after dinner?
B：＿＿＿
o: He will pay for the dinner.
They are going to have chicken rice for dinner.
We are going to get some drinks at the supermarket.
We often take a walk along the river before dinner.

e: A：你跟 Joan 將會去明晚的表演嗎？ B：嗯，我會去，「但 Joan 不會去那場表演」。
q:
A：Will you and Joan go to the show tomorrow night?
B：Well, I will, ＿＿＿.
o: but I am going to the show now
but only Joan will go to the show
but Joan will not go to the show
but Joan and I are not going to the show

e: A：你這週末將要做什麼？ B：「我這週末將要在我哥哥的花店工作。」
q:
A：What are you going to do this weekend?
B：＿＿＿
o: I go to the department store on weekends.
We visited a famous temple last weekend.
We don’t go to school during summer vacation.
I need to work at my brother’s flower shop this weekend.

e: A：我們家下星期將要去日月潭旅行。 B：太棒了！日月潭周圍有很多不錯的旅館。「你們要住在哪家？」 A：這次我們將要去露營，所以我們將睡在我們的帳篷裡。
q:
A：My family will take a trip to Sun Moon Lake next week.
B：Great! There are many good hotels around the lake. ______
A：This time we are going camping, so we’ll sleep in our tents（帳篷）.
o: Which one will you stay at?
Will you take a photo at the lake?

e: 走到山頂，那麼「你可以看見沿著河邊的所有漁船。」你也可以看見海洋。
q: Go to the top of the mountain, and ______. You can also see the ocean（海洋）.
o: check out the post offices around here
share the story about the famous temple
you can see all the fishing boats along the river
you can learn the names of the places from the book

e: 「我們正在計畫今年冬天到宜蘭旅行」，而且我們將會在一間有名的飯店泡溫泉。你想要跟我們去嗎？
q: ______, and we’ll have a hot spring bath（溫泉）at a famous hotel. Do you want to go with us?
o: We don’t like to take a bath
We stayed there for a week
We spent two hours walking there
We’re planning a trip to Yilan this winter

e: 「爸爸叫我放學後買晚餐回家」，因為他工作很忙，今晚沒辦法煮飯給我們吃。
q: ______ because he is busy with work and can’t cook for us tonight.
o: Dad will have dinner with us
The restaurant is next to the metro station
Making dinner only took Dad half an hour
Dad told me to buy our dinner home after school

e: 我家今年寒假將要去新加坡旅行，所以我爸爸要我規劃旅行。「他也要我查看一些飯店」，因為他想要選一間好的來住。
q: My family will take a trip to Singapore during the winter vacation, so my dad told me to plan the trip. ______ because he wants to choose a good one to stay at.
o: He will pay for the trip
We will visit some famous temples
He also asked me to check out some hotels
He also asked me to stay at the restaurant

e: A：「John 今天要去拜訪 Stella 伯母嗎？」 B：或許會。你想跟他去嗎？
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：Maybe. Do you want to go with him?
o: What’s your plan for the trip?
Are you going to watch the show?
Is John going to visit Aunt Stella today?

e: 現在正在下雨，所以「我決定待在家」。我不想去外面被雨淋溼。
q: It’s raining now, so ______. I don’t want to go out and get wet.
o: I decided to stay at home
I’ll go to the beach on my own
I’m going to leave for the bus station
it took me half an hour to walk to the station

e: A：他們要跟我們去購買食物嗎？ B：「是的，他們要。」
q:
A：Are they going to shop for food with us?
B：＿＿＿
o: Won’t they go with a group?
No, it won’t take you too much time.

e: A：我餓了。 B：「我也是。」我們去郵局旁邊的中式餐廳吃晚餐吧。
q:
A：I’m hungry.
B：＿＿＿ Let’s have dinner at the Chinese restaurant next to the post office.

e:
1.「人＋pay＋金錢＋for＋物」表「某人付了……錢買某物」。
2. 由上句「鞋匠帶了皮革回來」可知，下句為「我會用皮革做一些鞋子」。
3.「人＋spend＋金錢＋on＋物」表「某人花了……錢買某物」。
4. 由下句「我們走吧」可知，上句為「我們現在應該離開」，空格應填 leave。
5. 由上句「他們的衣服看起來很舊」可知，下句為「為什麼我們不做新衣服給他們？」。
p:
The Shoemaker and the Elves

3. (A) 由「每年都會去不同的旅遊景點」可知，作者去年沒有造訪紐約；(B) 第二天是博物館之旅，可知作者會吸收關於藝術的知識；(C) 由第一段前兩句可知，作者與家人同行旅遊；(D) 在 the Met 才會看到 Monet 的畫作，故選 (A)。
p:
Every year, my family take a trip to a different country. This year, we decided to visit the USA. We got to New York City yesterday, January 23rd. After we checked in at the hotel, we went to Times Square（時代廣場）. There are many theaters in and around Times Square, and we saw a musical, The Lion King, there. Then we rode bicycles to the Brooklyn Bridge（布魯克林大橋）. On the way there, we enjoyed many beautiful sights. I will always remember them even in the future.
Tomorrow, we are going to have a museum day. In the morning, we will visit the Met. There are many wonderful works of art there, and I really want to see Monet’s and Picasso’s paintings. In the afternoon, we will go to the American Museum of Natural History. It was the setting for the successful movie, Night at the Museum. Maybe my legs will feel sore after I walk around these places all day, but I will learn a lot for sure.

2. 對話中提到，旅程中必須爬山、在雨中穿越森林、露營及搭吉普車。
3. (A) 只有 James 是有經驗的嚮導；(B) 現在是雨季，所以去 Mazumo 很困難；(D) 租吉普車一天要 20 元，嚮導也是 20 元，所以一天要花 40 元。
p:
(Last weekend, Roger watched a video about a fun trip on the Internet. Then he packed his clothes and hurried to take a trip to a small but interesting place, Haru Island.)
Roger：Excuse me. Can you show me the way to Mazumo on Haru Island?
Woman：It’s a very long way to get to Mazumo. First, you have to climb a big mountain and go through a big forest. And then there is still a very long way to go.
Roger：Wow, getting to Mazumo is really difficult! It will be a ten-day trip, right?
Woman：Yes. You will camp for a few nights. And you will also need a jeep and an experienced guide to get there.
Roger：I see. How can I find a jeep and an experienced guide?
Woman：Lucky you! My brother, James, is an experienced guide. He is free now, and he can lead you to Mazumo.
Roger：Cool! So, how much is it for the jeep and the guide?
Woman：Well, twenty dollars a day for a jeep, and the same for James.
Roger：I’m OK with that.
Woman：There are not any stores along the way, so you need to buy enough food for the trip. By the way, it is very difficult to go through the forest now because it is the rainy season. You have to listen to him on the way there, and you can’t make him do any dangerous things.
Roger：Sure. I can’t wait to go now.

Roger will have to pay twenty dollars a day for a jeep and a guide to get to Mazumo.

p:
Good morning, Mr. and Mrs. Maxwell. My name is Jason Jones. Let me tell you about our hotel trips. Our popular one is a one-day trip to Rainbow Canyon（彩虹峽谷）. First, you will enjoy the view of Rainbow Canyon when you ride a raft down the river. Then you will have a delicious lunch at a barbecue restaurant. After that, you will visit an old village and experience the life there. Finally, our guide will take you to a special place. It’s a great place for watching beautiful animals in Rainbow Canyon. If that is too much, you might like our half-day trip to Topaz Lake（托帕斯湖）. On this trip, you can go out on the water on your own boat. Also, you will get a free lunch, and you can eat that on the boat or back in the restaurant. After that, you will visit the same old village as the one-day trip. For each of our trips, our guide will drive you, show you around, and bring you back when you finish the trip. If you would like to join either of these tomorrow, please let me know by six o’clock tonight.

Jamie and I will visit Berlin from July 6th to July 12th. We are very excited. We can catch up with you in Berlin in your free time. We will meet the president of Horch Factory first, and then we will have some meetings in the city. After we finish those meetings, we will have three free days. I want to have some delicious food there. Can you recommend some local restaurants for us? We also want to visit Pergamon Museum and Neues Museum there because they are very famous in the world. Maybe you can come with us. And do you need anything from Taiwan? I can get them for you. Just let me know.
Best wishes,
Maggie

q: Don’t spend your money on the ______. I never see you wear anything on your head.

e: 果汁店的「老闆」非常友善，總是以較低的價格賣給學生果汁。
q: The ______ of the juice shop is very friendly and always sells juice to students at a lower price.

e: 爸爸買了一副新的棒球「手套」給我，讓我這個周末練習用。
q: Dad bought me a new pair of baseball ______ for practice this weekend.

e: 形容詞原級比較句型「as＋形容詞原級＋as」表示「像……一樣……」。
q: Ashley seldom talks. She is as ______ as a mouse.

e: 由 than 可知此句為比較級；而根據語意，Olivia 很擅長數學，所以可推測她的數學考試成績比我的還要「好」，故要用 good 的比較級 better。
q: Olivia is good at math. Her grades on math tests are always ______ than mine.

e: 由 as smart 可知，此句為形容詞原級比較句型「as＋形容詞原級＋as」，第一格要填 as；而根據語意「Sue雖然沒有和 Joe 一樣聰明，但是她工作比較認真。」可知，此處應用比較級，而 serious 為兩音節以上的形容詞，故其比較級在前面加 more 即可。
q: Sue is not as smart ______ Joe, but she is ______ serious about her work.

e: Jenny 姐姐的裙子是在特價時買的，但 Jenny 的不是，可知 Jenny 買的裙子比較貴，故第一格應填比較級 more；比較級是用來比較兩個同類型的人、事、物，故第二格應選 your sister’s (skirt)。
q:
Kevin：Jenny, is your skirt ______ expensive than ______?
Jenny：Yeah. She bought it when it was on sale, but I didn’t.

e: of the two 為兩者之中的比較，句型為「A＋be 動詞＋the＋形容詞比較級＋of the two」。
q: Annie is 175 cm tall. Her brother is 150 cm tall. She is ______ of the two.

e: popular 為三音節形容詞，其比較級應在前面加 more。high 為單音節形容詞，使用比較級時，直接在後方加上 -er 即可。
q: Baseball is ＿＿＿ popular than basketball in Taiwan, so baseball players get ＿＿＿ salaries（薪資）.

e: good 的比較級為 better；比較級是用來比較兩個同類型的人、事、物，故第二格應填 Tom’s (car)。
q: Mike’s parents bought him a new car. Now, his car is ______ than ______.

e: 選項中可以修飾比較級的只有程度副詞 a little。
q: Vivian is 15 years old. Wendy is 16 years old. Vivian is ______ younger than Wendy.

e: important 為多音節形容詞，其比較級應在前面加 more；由 in your life 可知，此處為同範圍的比較，故可用「any other＋單數名詞」或「all the other＋複數名詞」或 anything else 來表示最高級，故選 (A)。
q: Don’t stay up late too often. Remember, your health is always ______ than ______ in your life.
o: more important; all the other thing

e: interesting 是兩個音節以上的形容詞，其比較級應在前面加 more；比較級是用來比較兩個同類型的人、事、物，因此前者是動名詞，後者也要用動名詞，故第二格填 reading。
q: For me, listening to music is ______ interesting than ______ because I can also do some other things at the same time.

e: 題目中有 than，可見此句為比較級，應用比較級形容詞 more。
q: There are ______ people on the train than on that bus. So, could we take the bus?

e: 選項中可以用來修飾比較級的只有 far。
q:
A：Annie is 37 years old. Her brother is 30. She is actually ______ older than him.
B：I can’t believe it! She is seven years older than her brother!

e: 我的弟弟比我「更矮小」，所以他也許可以穿我的舊衣服。short 是單音節形容詞，所以其比較級直接在形容詞後加 -er。
q: My younger brother is ______ than me, so maybe he can wear my old clothes.

e: 由 than 可知要用比較級，delicious 是兩個音節以上的形容詞，其比較級應在前面加 more；those 代替前面提過的複數可數名詞。
q: You should try these pies. They are ______ delicious than ______ on that table.

e: strong 的比較級為 stronger，而 even 及 much 為程度副詞，用來修飾比較級。
q: Mr. Lohan and his son go to the gym almost every day. He is strong, but his son is ______ than him.

e: 由 as... as… 可知為原級比較，故用 fashionable；表示「試穿……」可用「try on＋名詞」或「try＋代名詞＋on」。
q:
A：This pair of blue jeans is as ______ as yours.
B：Why don’t you ______?

e: much 修飾比較級，而 tall 及 strong 皆為單音節形容詞，比較級直接在後面加 -er 即可。
q: David is much ______ and ______ than me. No wonder he can join the school basketball team.

e: 第一格為一般直述句，故用 famous 修飾名詞 actor；第二格根據句意可知，Leo 變得「更加有名」，故選 (D)。
q: Leo was a ______ actor before, but now he is ______ because of the new movie.

e: 由前句可知，李先生比李太太年輕，而 young 為單音節形容詞，在它後面直接加 -er 即形成比較級。
q: Mr. Lee is 30 years old. Mrs. Lee is 33 years old. Mr. Lee is three years ______ than Mrs. Lee.

e: 由 of the two girls 可知是兩者之中的比較，句型為「A＋be 動詞＋the＋形容詞比較級＋of the two＋複數名詞」。
q: Judy is taller than Sammy. Judy is ______ of the two girls.

e: even 修飾比較級，且根據語意，我昨天過得不好。猜猜怎樣？我今天甚至過得「更糟」。
q: I had a bad day yesterday. Guess what? I had an even ______ day today.

e: beautiful 的比較級為 more beautiful，而 much 用來修飾形容詞比較級。由 in the world 可知，是同範圍的比較，故選「any other＋單數名詞」。
q: My girlfriend is beautiful. In my eyes, she is ______ beautiful than ______ in the world.

e: 比較級是用來比較兩個同類型的人、事、物，故第一格應選 mine（= my computer）；此處沒有專指哪部電腦，且前方有 a 可知，第二格應填單數 one。
q: Hey! Your computer is much heavier than ______. You should get a lighter ______.

e: 由 than 可知，第一格為比較級 more；而因為比較的是「去年和今年的學生數」，第二格為 there were，故選 (A)。
q: There will be ______ students in my class this year than ______ last year.

e: 要描述事物「越來越……」用「形容詞比較級＋and＋形容詞比較級」或「more and more＋形容詞原級」。
q: The weather is getting ＿＿＿ and ＿＿＿. I’m happy because winter is my favorite season.

e: 由 as... as… 可知為原級比較，表示「和……一樣……」，須使用形容詞原級，故第一格填 tall；後半句由 than 可知，此句須用形容詞比較級，故第二格填 shorter。
q: Tom is as ＿＿＿ as Jack, but he is ＿＿＿ than Mike.

e: 比較的對象須對等，that 代表的是 the weather。
q: The weather in Japan is colder than ______. Remember to bring a heavy coat with you when you go on a trip there.

e: 要描述可數名詞「越來越少……」用「fewer and fewer…」。
q: There are ______ people smoking（抽菸）now because it’s not good for their health.

e: 句子的結構是比較兩者在學習上的時間花費，根據「twice as ___ time」這樣的比較結構，應使用 “much” 來修飾不可數名詞 “time”。
q: Students in Taiwan spend almost twice as ______ time as students in America on their studies.

e: 此處為同範圍的比較，故用 any other blanket。
q:
Clerk：How can I help you?
Jenny：I’d like to buy this blanket because it is more comfortable than ______ in the shop.

e: 此處代名詞代替的對象 pants 為複數，且無明確的指稱對象，故用 ones。
q: The pants are too big for me. Do you have smaller ＿＿＿?

e: 此處第一格代名詞代替的對象 cups 為複數可數名詞，且有明確指出是哪些杯子，故用 them；而第二格代名詞代替的對象同樣是複數可數名詞 cups，不過並未明確指稱對象，故用 ones。
q: These cups are still very dirty, so please wash them again. And be careful not to break ＿＿＿, or you should buy the same ＿＿＿ for me.

e: 不定代名詞 one 和 ones 用來取代前面已提過的不特定可數名詞，以避免重複。one 代替單數名詞，ones 代替複數名詞。由後句 it 可知應用單數，故用 one。
q:
A：Which bag do you like?
B：I like the ＿＿＿ on the left. It is great.

e: 此處代名詞代替前方的單數可數名詞 this bowl of beef rice，且有明確的指稱對象，故用 it。
q: This bowl of beef rice is so good. Do you want to try ＿＿＿?

e: 此處代名詞代替前方的單數可數名詞 dress，以避免重複，故第一格用 one；Sally 比較喜歡紅色裙子的原因是因為它「比較不昂貴」，也「比較漂亮」，故第二格要用劣勢比較 less，第三格要用 more。
q: Sally doesn’t like the yellow dress. She likes the red ＿＿＿ better because it is ＿＿＿ expensive and ＿＿＿ beautiful.

e: a lot bigger 表「大很多」，為加強語氣用法，此外 even 及 much 皆可用於加強語氣；此處比較的對象是 my shoes 和 your shoes，故用 yours (= your shoes) 代替。
q: You wear size 10 shoes. Believe it or not, my shoes are ＿＿＿ than ＿＿＿.

e: 修飾比較級應用程度副詞，故第一格填 much；由 in Mr. Wang’s class 可知，Mary 不在同一班級，為不同範圍的比較，故第二格填 any student。
q: Mrs. Lin’s student Mary is so smart, and she is ______ nicer than ______ in Mr. Wang’s class.

e: 由 songs at the party 可知專指這場派對上的歌曲，為相同範圍的比較，故第一格填 all the other；此處代名詞代替單數可數名詞 song，以避免重複，故第二格用 one。
q:
A：Listen! The last song is more beautiful than ______ songs at the party.
B：You’re right. The last ______ is my favorite.

e: 第一格前為 more，可知應選多音節形容詞；兩者之間的比較句型為「A＋be 動詞＋the＋形容詞比較級＋of the two＋複數名詞」。
q:
A：Who is more ______, Alex or Cameron?
B：Cameron. He is also ______ of the two men.

e: 「很少」學生，故用 few；根據句意，第二格應為「比以前更難」，故選 (D)。
q: ＿＿＿ students got over 80 on the test because it is ＿＿＿ than before.

e: 由 than 可知，此處為比較級，且語意為魚堡比牛肉堡「還小」。然而，魚堡的價錢「比較高」。故第一格填 small 的比較級 smaller，而要形容價錢比較高，應用 high 的比較級 higher。
q: The fish burger（漢堡）is ＿＿＿ than the beef burger. However, the price of the fish burger is ＿＿＿.

e: 前句代名詞代替的對象為單數可數名詞 Your T-shirt，且有明確的指稱對象，故第一格用 it；後句亦為單數，且無明確的指稱對象，故第二格用 one。
q: Your T-shirt is so special. Where did you get ＿＿＿? I want to buy ＿＿＿, too.

e: 由 all the other fruits 可知第二句為比較級句型，再由第一句「是我最喜愛的水果」可知非劣勢比較，不能用 less... than。
q: Watermelons are my favorite fruit. They’re ＿＿＿ delicious ＿＿＿ all the other fruits.

e: 形容詞比較級前面可以用程度副詞 even（甚至更……）來修飾。
q: Pamela is popular with teenagers. She is ＿＿＿ more popular than Howard, the best（最棒的）YouTuber last year.

e: Mina and I 是兩個人，所以 (A)、(B) 不可選，而 them 為受格，不可放在 be 動詞之後，故選 (C)。
q: Few people know about this new restaurant, so Mina and I were the only ＿＿＿ here.

e: 做比較時，若比較的事物是相同類型，可以用指示代名詞 that 或 those 代替前面提過的事物；that 代替單數，those 代替複數。本句是用 those 代替computers。
q: Computers now are not as expensive as ＿＿＿ in the past.

e: A：你看！那個男人好強壯。他可以移動那個沉重的箱子。B：我同意你的說法。「他跟牛一樣強壯。」
q:
A：Look! That man is so strong. He can move the heavy box.
B：I agree with you. ______
o: He is as strong as an ox.

e: 這件短褲要價新臺幣四百元，那件長褲要價新臺幣三百五十元。「這件短褲比那件長褲貴。」
q: The shorts cost NT$400, and the pants cost NT$350. ＿＿＿
o: The shorts are less expensive than the pants.
The pants are as expensive as the shorts.
The pants are more expensive than the shorts.
The shorts are more expensive than the pants.

e: A：你什麼時候要前往美國？B：越快越好。「我等不及在那裡展開新的學校生活了。」
q:
A：When will you leave for the USA?
B：The sooner（越快）the better. ______
o: I can’t wait to start my new school life there.
The country is larger than before.
As for the USA, it is my favorite country.
It didn’t cost me a lot of money to fly there.

e: 那家餐廳比它以前棒多了。「它乾淨且明亮許多。」
q: That restaurant is better than it was before. ______
o: It is getting more and more expensive.
I will never go there again.
Fewer and fewer people want to have dinner there.

e: A：你何時有空？我有事要告訴你。B：現在是恰當的時間因為「我等一下會更忙」。
q:
A：When do you have time? I have something to tell you.
B：Now is the right time because ＿＿＿.
o: I have no time for you
it is difficult for me to see you

e: 「Ben 比較高，手臂也比較長。」他應該能夠幫你拿到高處的那本書。
q: ＿＿＿ He might get that book up there for you.
o: Ben is taller and has longer arms.
Mike is nicer and kinder than all the other people here.
Dan is a big fan of that book.
Steve is smaller and younger than you.

e: A：我家離學校只有兩個街區遠，所以我每天早上都可以睡很晚，上學也不會遲到。B：真好！你可以睡得多。「我家離學校更近」，但是我每天仍然必須早起練習籃球。
q:
A：My house is only two blocks away from school, so I can sleep late and won’t be late for school every morning.
B：How nice! You can get more sleep. ______, but I still have to get up early to practice basketball every day.
o: My room is much more comfortable
My house is a lot bigger than yours
Your house is cheaper than mine
My house is closer to school

e: A：買快時尚的衣服不總是讓你省錢，但是買很多新衣服會傷害地球更多。B：你說的沒錯。「我們應該在買新衣服前多想想。」
q:
A：Buying fast fashion clothes won’t always save you money, but buying many new clothes will always hurt the Earth more.
B：You can say that again. ＿＿＿
o: We have no idea about those clothes.
Then what do you think about my new clothes?
I want the same clothes as yours.
We should think twice before we buy new clothes.

e: A：我才離開一小時，「而現在這棟房子比剛剛更髒了。」B：別擔心。我將會把所有東西打掃乾淨。
q:
A：I only left for one hour, ＿＿＿.
B：Don’t worry. I will clean everything up.
o: but the place is better and cleaner
so it’s not as dirty as before
and I think it’s more beautiful than your room
and now the house is dirtier than it was

e: A：如果 Jim 約你出去的話，你會答應嗎？ B：「不會，因為他人沒有 Andy 好。」
q:
A：Will you say yes to Jim when he asks you out?
B：＿＿＿
o: Yes, he is waiting outside for him.
Sure, I will ask him for help.
No, because he’s not as nice as Andy.
I will never do that because I want to go out with him.

e: A：為什麼你不想買那件洋裝？它很適合你。B：它比所有其他件洋裝還時尚，「但它貴多了。」
q:
A：Why don’t you want to buy that dress? It is so good on you.
B：It’s more fashionable than all the other dresses, ______.
o: but you are worse than you think
and I’m really a fan of it
or I already have the same one as yours

e: 遺憾地，這種藥對我沒有效。「我的頭痛甚至比之前更嚴重。」
q: Sadly, the medicine didn’t work for me. ＿＿＿
o: And it helps me get better.
My headache is even worse than before.
I’m healthy again and can jump around like a monkey.

e: A：你為什麼買這雙運動鞋？B：「因為它比我舊的那雙還輕。」有了它，我可以跑得更快。
q:
A：Why are you getting the sports shoes?
B：＿＿＿ With them, I can run faster.
o: Because they are the wrong size for me.
Because they are lighter than my old ones.
Because they are not as fashionable as before.
Because they are much heavier than yours.

e: A：你覺得我穿這件黑色的夾克怎麼樣？B：「它比那件黑色大衣還糟。」而且它非常貴。
q:
A：What do you think about the black jacket on me?
B：＿＿＿ Also, it is very expensive.
o: It’s worse than the black coat.
Why didn’t you try it on?
I agree. It is great on you.
It means more money and more free time.

e: A：你覺得我的新髮型如何？B：哇！「它比以前的還要短多了。」
q:
A：What do you think about my new hairstyle?
B：Wow! ＿＿＿
o: I agree with you on this.

e: A：你覺得我應該買哪個包包，大的還是小的？B：「小的比較沒那麼昂貴」，而且你沒有那麼多錢買大的包包。A：你說的對。那麼，適合我的就是這個。
q:
A：Which bag should I get, the big one or the small one?
B：＿＿＿, and you don’t have that much money for the big one.
A：You’re right. That’s the one for me then.
o: The small one is less expensive
The big one is lighter and better
Both of them are at the same price
The two together are cheaper for you

e: 這件牛仔褲不對。它一直掉下來。「你可以拿一件比較小的給我嗎？」
q: These jeans are wrong. They keep falling down. ＿＿＿
o: May I try on a bigger size?
Could you get me a smaller pair?
I don’t usually wear jeans to work.

e: A：「這件大衣可以給我大一點的尺寸嗎？」這件我穿起來不舒服。B：沒問題。稍等一下。A：嗯……。這件好多了。謝謝。
q:
A：＿＿＿ I am not comfortable in this one.
B：No problem. Just a second.
A：Hmm... This one is much better. Thank you.
o: Could you give me a bigger size of the coat?
What do you think about the shoes?

e: A：你有看到 Lucy 今天一整天笑得合不攏嘴嗎？B：「有啊，她比昨天開心多了。」A：那是因為她所有考試都拿了 A。
q:
A：Did you see Lucy smiling（微笑）from ear to ear all day long?
B：＿＿＿
A：That’s because she got all As on the tests.
o: No, she had a worse day today.
I agree. How could she be the sadder of the two girls?
Yeah, she is a lot happier than yesterday.
I see, but why is she getting more and more fashionable?

e: Dad：你的腳怎麼了嗎？你走路的方式很奇怪。Jim：「你可以買雙新的籃球鞋給我嗎？」。這雙太小了。Dad：當然。我們明天去百貨公司吧。
q:
Dad：What’s wrong with your feet? You’re walking in a funny way.
Jim：＿＿＿ These are too small.
Dad：Sure. Let’s go to the department store tomorrow.
o: The new running shoes are the right size for me.
Those in the store are fashionable.
Do you have this pair of jeans in a bigger size?
Could you buy me a new pair of basketball shoes?

e: A：快時尚要付出很很高的代價。B：「你說得對。」所以，我很少買新衣服，而且我只買品質好的衣服。
q:
A：That is a high price to pay for fast fashion.
B：＿＿＿ So, I seldom shop for new clothes, and I only buy clothes of high quality（品質）.

e:
1. 由後句提到「它上週五才剛上市」及有較大的螢幕，推知要選「KPhone XS 是市場上最新的手機」。
2. 由後句提到「如果買 OBBO R15 的話，我可以省很多錢」，推知「OBBO R15 比 KPhone XS 便宜很多」。
3. 由圖表及後句提到「攜帶它很容易」，推知 OBBO R15 比 KPhone XS「輕」。
4. 由後句提到 Linda 寫這則訊息的原因是問 Matt 意見，推知「她自己很難做決定」。
p:
Hey Matt,
There is something wrong with my smartphone, so I plan to buy a new one. I’m thinking about these two smartphones.
＿1.＿ It was just on the market last Friday. It has a cool style and a larger screen. I like it because I usually read e-books on my smartphone. However, it doesn’t have my favorite color, purple. Larry：Wait a minute, David. I really need to take a break.
David：Are you all right? Your face went pale.
Larry：Yeah, just give me a second to catch my breath. I’m not as strong as before.
David：You are the same as before to me.
Larry：Well, I’m not. In fact, I’m older, slower, and a lot heavier than my younger self.
David：Don’t worry. That happens to me, too. I’m also a little softer around the middle.
Larry：I don’t believe you. You are just as healthy as before, and you’re not even breathing very hard.
David：Well, I try to exercise when I can.
Larry：What do you usually do?
David：I go to the gym for an hour every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Also, I jog for an hour on Tuesdays and Thursdays and go hiking for about an hour on weekends.
Larry：That’s a lot!
David：For me, that’s not as much as before. Old age is catching up with me.

Tina is really into fashion. She has a lot of clothes in her room, and she’s always looking for new pieces to buy.
Though she likes to buy clothes, she won’t get any new styles. All the styles of her shirts, skirts, dresses, pants, coats, and jackets are from way back. For Tina, those clothes are better—the colors are brighter, and the styles are more fashionable. She also feels more comfortable when she wears them. Tina can’t stand the clothes of today. She really hates those from the world of fast fashion. For her, they are not as good or as cool as the clothes from the past. Although they are cheaper, lighter, thinner, they’re not as strong. She bought them before, but they just fell apart after she wore them once or twice. She will never do that again.

Cathy runs very fast, and she is faster than all the other students in her school. One day, two thieves broke into her house, took some things, and ran away. Cathy noticed that right away. She ran after them and cried out, “Hey! Stop! Stop! You can’t get away!” But the thieves ran faster than Cathy. She was very angry about it. She ran as best she could, and finally she outran the thieves. However, Cathy didn’t stop. She kept on running and met a friend on the way. Her friend asked her, “It’s good to see you. But what are you doing?” “I am trying to catch the thieves,” Cathy answered. “Then where are they?” Cathy’s friend asked. “They are behind me. They think they are faster than me. But as you can see, they are wrong. I’m faster than both of them!” Cathy said.

“HELP!” Note Found on Chinese Fast-Fashion Clothes
KS News by Ashley Smith
Many TikTok videos went viral when people saw “help” messages on some clothes from SHEEN company. The company told KS news, “The messages were asking people to help the Earth.” They said that it was part of a new clothing line, “We use less water to make these items, so by buying our clothes, you are helping the world.” However, many customers don’t believe the company. Joselyn, one TikTok user, said, “My sister bought two of the same shirts at the same time in different sizes, but the small one has the help message and the medium one doesn’t.” Another user, Tasha, said, “Sorry SHEEN, I won’t buy any of your clothes anymore.” More people are asking to see the working environment of the workers.
SHEEN is a popular clothing company from China. They sell fashionable clothes at low prices, from dresses, T-shirts, pants, to shoes and more. They became even more popular because of TikTok and the outbreak of Covid-19 in 2020. The company only has online stores, but it didn’t stop people from shopping. However, besides being cheap and popular, the company also made the news headlines for breaking labor laws. “SHEEN workers have to work more than 75 hours a week. That’s almost two times longer than those in the labor law,” some news reported back in 2019.
