A：May I take your ______, sir?
B：Yes. I’ll have a cup of coffee and a hamburger, please. Thank you.

e: Ricky「訂購的東西」送達他家附近的便利商店。他今天下午會過去拿。
q: Ricky’s ______ arrived（抵達）at the convenience store（便利商店）near his house. He is going to take it this afternoon.

e: A：為什麼你不「吃」你的午餐？ B：我兒子今天早上生病。我很擔心他。
q:
A：Why don’t you have a(n) ______ of your lunch?
B：My son was sick this morning. I worry about him.

e: A：為什麼這間餐廳裡沒有任何人？ B：看！前門上有個「打烊」的「標誌」。
q:
A：Why aren’t there any people in the restaurant?
B：Look! There’s a “Closed” ______ on the front door.

e: Daren 喜愛動物，所以他不吃任何「肉」。然而，他喝牛奶和吃雞蛋。
q: Daren loves animals, so he doesn’t eat any______. However, he drinks milk and eats eggs.

e: A：Tom 一「口」就吃掉了我的冰淇淋！我不敢相信他這麼做。 B：難怪你只有在他不在的時候才吃冰淇淋。
q:
A：Tom ate my ice cream in just one ______! I can’t believe he did that.
B：No wonder you only eat ice cream when he’s not around.

e: A：你今天有吃任何蔬菜嗎？ B：是的，我在吃牛排時有吃「沙拉」配菜。 A：那樣還不夠。
q:
A：Did you eat any vegetables today?
B：Yes, I had a side ______ when I had steak.
A：That wasn’t enough.

e: A：你可以把電視「聲音」調小聲嗎？我正在為明天的考試讀書。 B：沒問題。
q:
A：Can you turn the ______ of the TV down? I’m studying for my test tomorrow.
B：No problem.

e: 此處的 matter 為動詞，且主詞為第三人稱單數代名詞 that，根據語意可知應填入現在式助動詞 Does。
q:
Jane：Mom, Leo’s party is about to start. Could you drive me to his house?
Mom：OK. Hey, which dress should I wear, the black one or the blue one?
Jane：______ that matter? You won’t get out of the car.

e: 根據語意可知 Ella 喜歡鄉村樂，「而且」還喜歡搖滾樂，故應填入副詞 Besides。
q:
Sara：What type of music do you like?
Ella：I like country music. ______, I also like rock and roll（搖滾樂）.

e: 連綴動詞後可接形容詞或「like＋名詞」，根據語意可知空格應填入形容詞 thin，故選 (C)。
q:
A：Don’t you like the food?
B：Yes, but I want to ______ ______, so I’m on a diet（節食）.

e: 句意為「讓我的頭髮在理髮店被剪」，應用「have / get＋受詞＋過去分詞」或「let＋受詞＋be 動詞原形＋過去分詞」，故選 (B)。
q:
Tim：Did you cut（剪）your hair?
Dan：Of course not. I didn’t cut my hair, but I ______ my hair cut at a barbershop（理髮廳）.

e: look 當連綴動詞時，後可接形容詞或「like＋名詞」，在此 rain 為名詞，可知第一格用 looks like；表示「忘記要做……」用「forget to V」，而「忘記做過……」用「forget＋V-ing」，依句意可知為「別忘記要帶傘」。
q: It ______ rain. Don’t forget ______ an umbrella with you when you leave.

e: 根據感官動詞「notice＋受詞＋現在分詞／原形動詞」的用法，可知應選 (A)。
q: Though（雖然）many people noticed the little girl ______ out for help, no one stood out and helped her.

e: 由空格前的連綴動詞 looks 與空格後 than in any other dress，可知空格內應填入形容詞比較級 more beautiful。
q: Ivy looks ______ in the dress than in any other dress in the store.

e: 本題無比較的對象，故根據語意可知連綴動詞 felt 後面應接形容詞原級 sad。
q: The old lady missed her son so much. She felt ______ when he wasn’t around.

e: look 當連綴動詞時，其後可接形容詞或「like＋名詞」，exciting 為形容詞，所以第一格用 looks；get 當連綴動詞用時，後接形容詞。
q:
A：I’d like to try the new ride（遊樂設施）. It ______ exciting.
B：Yes, it is, but you’ll ______ all wet after the ride.

e: 連綴動詞 smell 後面可直接加「形容詞」或「like＋名詞」，又因為 banana cake 與 apple pie 兩者之間的比較，故選 (D)。
q:
A：Which do you like, the banana cake or the apple pie?
B：I’d like the banana cake. It smells ______.

e: 由空格後出現形容詞 beautiful，可知空格內應用連綴動詞或 be 動詞，且主詞 Betty 為第三人稱單數，故選 (D)。
q: Betty ______ as beautiful as her sister. They’re both models（模特兒）.

e: 根據語意，可知空格內應置入表「味道」的名詞 smell。
q: What’s that ______? Is something burning（燃燒的）?

e: less 後應用形容詞原級；very 用來修飾形容詞原級；much、even 則用來修飾形容詞比較級，故選 (D)。
q: After Gina lost 10 pounds（磅）, she looked ______ ______.

e: 空格後面為形容詞，選項中可接形容詞且符合時態的只有 gets。
q: Eat the soup before it ______ cold.

e: 「get＋形容詞」表示「變得……」。
q: Winter is my favorite season. When it ______ cold, I can go skiing（滑雪）.

e: feel、get 與 become 之中，僅 feel 之後可接「like＋名詞」。
q: Louis treats his wife so well. He always makes her ______ like a queen（皇后）.

e: look 當連綴動詞時通常不用進行式，其後接「形容詞」或「like＋名詞」；由 saw 可知此描述過去發生的事，所以第二格應置入 became。
q: When I saw Judy at the park, she ______ very sad. However, she ______ happy at the sight of（看到）her boyfriend.

e: 「The＋比較級…, the＋比較級…」表「越……，就越……。」由後句的形容詞比較級 warmer 可知語意為「Andy 穿越多衣服，他就覺得越溫暖。」，故應分別填入 more 與 felt。
q: The ______ clothes Andy put on, the warmer he ______.

e: price 不用 expensive 修飾，故不選 (A)，由後句 … we didn’t eat any vegetables last week，可知應是颱風來襲導致蔬菜價格「變得越來越高」，故選 (D)。
q: After the typhoon（颱風）, the vegetable prices ______. That’s why we didn’t eat any vegetables last week.

e: fresh 為形容詞，故選連綴動詞 look；非限定的指稱，故用 one。
q: The oranges on the table ______ fresh. Could I have ______?

e: 根據語意，由於夏天來臨，所以「天氣變得越來越熱」，故選 (C)。
q: The weather is getting ______ because summer is coming.

e: 根據語意，應是 Paul 只有 20 歲，但他「看起來」比實際年齡老，且 older 為形容詞，故空格僅能填入連綴動詞 looks。
q: Paul ______ older than he really is. In fact, he is only 20.

e: 在公園裡看煙火「聽起來」很有趣，故選 (A)。
q:
A：Let’s go out tomorrow night. We can watch the fireworks（煙火）in the park.
B：That ______ interesting.

e: 根據語意，John 想要減重和變得健康，所以應該是要每天運動且吃「較少的」速食，故選 less 來修飾不可數名詞 fast food；第二句中，and 為連接詞，前後動詞形式須一致，故使用原形動詞。
q: John exercises and eats ______ fast food every day. He wants to lose weight and ______ healthy.

e: look 當連綴動詞時，後接形容詞或「like＋名詞」。
q:
A：Jane and her sister ______ their mother.
B：Yeah. They ______ almost the same.

e: 第一格空格前有不定詞 to，且空格後接名詞，可置入原形的連綴動詞有 become, look like 或 be；第二格空格後為形容詞，且根據語意應置入 gets。
q: Cindy likes to help people. She wants to ______ a police officer when she ______ older.

e: 用動詞 think 表「你覺得如何？」，疑問詞須用 what；若用動詞 feel，則疑問詞用 how。
q:
A：Today is your first day of school. ______ do you think about your classmates?
B：They are great. Everyone is nice to me.

e: get 當連綴動詞時，後面須接形容詞，故不選 (B)；為了變得健康，所以 Rhonda「不用太多鹽和糖／使用較少的鹽和糖」，故不選 (A)、(D) feel like 表「想要」，後須接 V-ing。
q:
A：To get _____, Rhonda ______ salt and sugar when she cooks.
B：But the food tasted bland（無滋味的）. I don’t feel like ______ her food again.
o: health; doesn’t use much; to eat
the healthiest; doesn’t put less; eat

e: 連綴動詞（feel）後面接形容詞或「like＋名詞」，且配合時態，故第一格空格應填入 felt like，而第二格空格填入 tasted。
q: The hotel ______ home, and its food ______ great. I will visit it again next summer.

e: make 在此為使役動詞，句型為「make＋受詞＋原形動詞」。
q: Sandra’s dad ______ her ______ her homework at home this weekend.

e: help 後句接「to V」或「原形動詞」，故第一格用 wash；使役動詞的用法為「使役動詞＋受詞＋原形動詞」，故第二格用 help。
q: My son can help you ______ your car. I can have him ______ you if（如果）you like.

e: 由受詞（me）後方為原形動詞（stay）可知，前面動詞為使役動詞。
q: My parents had to take care of my grandpa at the hospital last night. They ______ me stay home and take care of my sister.

e: let、make 為使役動詞，句型為「let / make＋受詞＋原形動詞」。
q: Ivy was lost（迷路的）. She ______ the boy ______ her the way to the park.

e: make 在此為使役動詞，句型為「make＋受詞＋原形動詞」。
q: Grandma couldn’t hear（聽到）me. She made me ______ louder（更大聲地）.

e: have（第三人稱單數has）在此為使役動詞，句型為「have＋受詞＋原形動詞」。
q: The coach（教練）is very strict. He ______ the players ______ basketball after school every day.

e: 使役動詞 make 後接原形動詞，而 help 之後接原形動詞、「to＋V」或「with＋N」。
q: My mom made me ______ her ______ the housework this Saturday morning, and then she played tennis with me.

e: 使役動詞的用法為「使役動詞＋受詞＋原形動詞」，故第一格用 mop；由 made 可知是在談論過去發生的事，而後句提及 Jean 沒有幫忙拖地，可知她當時正在體育館裡練習羽球，故第二格用 was practicing。
q: When Miss Lin made me ______ the classroom floor, Jean ______ badminton in the gym. So, she didn’t help me with that.

e: 第一格後面直接接名詞，且根據時間副詞「五年前」，故須填入連綴動詞 become 的過去式 became；表「漸漸變得」則用 be becoming / getting。
q: Thomas ______ an actor five years ago. Now, he ______ more and more popular.

e: 根據語意，應是炒飯「聞起來壞了」，所以不要吃它，否則會生病，故選 (D)。
q: The fried rice ______. Don’t eat it, or you might get sick.

e: 連綴動詞後面接形容詞或「like＋名詞」，由於 each other 為代名詞，且主詞為複數，故應選 look like。
q: The twins（雙胞胎）______ each other. It’s hard for me to tell them apart（區分他們）.

e: 連綴動詞的問句為「What＋助動詞＋主詞＋連綴動詞＋like?」或「How＋助動詞＋主詞＋連綴動詞?」，故第一格應置入 How；第二格之前的 look 為連綴動詞，其後須接形容詞 great。
q:
A：______ do I look in this red dress?
B：You look ______. You should wear it to the party.

e: 我們要在天色「變」黑之前抵達，由文意可知是表達轉變的狀態，時態用現在式。
q: It will be very cold after sunset（日落）. We have to get there before the sky ______ dark.

e: 根據語意，糖放得越多，咖啡就變得（越）甜，故第一格應置入 sweet 或 sweeter；sugar 為不可數名詞，故其前僅只能置入 more。
q: The coffee became ______ after I added ______ sugar. Would you like a cup of it now?

e: 連綴動詞的問句為「What＋助動詞＋主詞＋連綴動詞＋like?」或「How＋助動詞＋主詞＋連綴動詞?」，問句有 like 故第一格應置入 What；第二格之前的 smell 為連綴動詞，後須接形容詞，又後句描述味道像死掉的大老鼠，故第二格應置入 terrible。
q:
A：______ does the cheese smell like?
B：It smells as ______ as a dead（死掉的）rat.

e: Jane 決定少吃多動，可推知她想減重。
q: Jane decided to eat less and exercise more because ______.
o: she tries to save more money
fruit and vegetables are good for health
she wants to lose some weight

e: 這條魚聞起來很糟。你應該把它丟掉，可推知吃它不是個好主意。
q: The fish smells bad. ______ You should throw it away.
o: It’s not a good idea to eat it.
I just fed it some bread.

e: Josh 很餓，可推知他等不及要坐在餐桌旁開始用餐。
q: Josh was very hungry. He couldn’t wait to ______.
o: sit at the dining table and start to dig in
use less oil, sugar, or salt in his meal
throw away the food because it went bad
help his parents do the dishes

e: 我爸爸每天送花給我媽媽，因為它們代表他對她的愛。
q: My father sends flowers to my mom every day because ______.
o: he makes the gifts by hand
they stand for his love for her

e: A 詢問 B 為何總是使用較少的糖或鹽在餐點中，可推知因為那對健康有益，所以 B 還推薦 A 不妨試試。
q:
A：Why do you always use less sugar or salt in your meals?
B：______ You should try it, too.
o: Because my parents don’t like green salad.
Because it takes less time to cook.
Because eating too much food isn’t good for me.

e: 由兒子說明自己沒有吃到午餐，可推知是班上的霸凌者脅迫他交出午餐。
q:
Mom：Why are you crying, son?
Son：I didn’t eat lunch.
Mom：Why?
Son：A bully（霸凌者）in my class ______.
o: made me give him my lunch

e: 由男子點了牛排佐薯條，可知服務生先詢問他是否要點餐了。
q:
Waiter：______
Man：Yes. I’d like a steak with French fries, please.
o: What would you like to drink?
What about having some fruit salad?
May I take your order, sir?

e: A 邀約 B 今晚去自己家裡舉辦的派對，而 B 回答「為什麼不呢？」，可知他覺得那聽起來很好玩。
q:
A：We’re having a party at my place tonight. Are you in?
B：Why not? ______
o: That sounds like a bad idea.
I have to help my grandpa.

e: A 說明自己今晚不能參加派對，可推知他媽媽臨時請他幫忙做家事。
q:
A：Oh, no! I can’t go to the party tonight.
B：Why not? You told me you could go yesterday.
A：______
o: I can probably be there soon.
I forgot to invite my friends to the party.
My mom had me help her with the housework.
You didn’t have enough money for the party.

e: 由 B 回答他只吃水果和蔬菜，以及 A 回應他盡量吃綠沙拉，可知 B 解釋自己不吃任何肉類。
q:
A：Why don’t you try any beef or pork? They are delicious.
B：______ I eat only fruit and vegetables.
A：Then enjoy the green salad. You can eat as much as you can.
o: Oh, I don’t eat any meat.

e: 由 B 說明 Mr. Johnson 想要大家多練習，可推知 A 害怕 Mr. Johnson 的原因是他出太多功課了。
q:
A：I’m afraid of Mr. Johnson.
B：Why do you say so?
A：______
B：Well. I think he wants us to practice more.
o: He always makes us do a lot of homework.
You should report him to the police.
He likes to read in the library.

e: A 建議 B 騎車上班前先把雨衣放進機車裡，接著又說外面是陰天，推知今天應該會下雨。
q:
A：You should put your raincoat（雨衣）in your scooter before you ride it to work.
B：Why should I do that?
A：It’s cloudy outside. ______
o: It’s probably going to rain this afternoon.
You will get a fever soon.
But it will get warmer and warmer next week.
You can try it on before you buy it.

e: 由 A 說明自己沒有準備任何禮物，可推知 Lisa 並沒有邀請 B。
q:
A：Who’s this gift for?
B：That’s for Lisa. I’ll give it to her at her birthday party tonight. What’s your gift for her?
A：I didn’t prepare anything ______.
o: ,and she thought my gift was the best
,so I will be there by seven
because she didn’t invite me to her party

e: A 詢問為何 Karen 這週都沒有來上學，由 B 的後句回答「這變成一個大的問題」，可知前句為「她的喉嚨痛越來越嚴重了」。
q:
A：Why didn’t Karen come to school this week?
B：______ It became a big problem.
o: Because she moved to Japan last year.
Because her sore throat is getting more and more serious.
Because everyone here stopped going to school.
Because people can swim in the river in summer.

e: 由 A 詢問 B 是否寫完功課，以及 B 的回覆，可推知 B 完成功課了，所以媽媽讓他玩電玩遊戲。
q:
A：Why are you playing video games? Did you finish your homework?
B：Yes. ______
A：I want to play video games, too. I have to hurry up.
o: I have to wait until Mom comes home.
It doesn’t sound like a good idea.
That’s why Mom let me play video games.

e: 由 B 說的 「Not in Mexico.」，可知墨西哥當地做豆子湯的方式與臺灣的方法不同。既然臺式的是豆子甜湯，可推知墨西哥式的應為加了鹽的鹹豆湯。
q:
A：What soup is it?
B：It’s bean soup. I used to eat this in Mexico（墨西哥）. Try it and tell me what you think.
A：It tastes good but a little strange. We often eat sweet bean soup here in Taiwan.
B：Not in Mexico. ______
o: You should add more oil to the soup.
People there like sweet bean soup a lot.
We don’t eat soup very often.
We often add salt when we cook it.

e: 由於 A 遠在三個街區就可以看見該餐廳的黃色招牌，且 B 也覺得招牌很特別，建議去該餐廳用餐。從他們的狀況可知，在餐飲業中，商店招牌的顏色真地很重要。
q:
A：I can see that yellow store sign of the restaurant from three blocks away.
B：It’s really special. Let’s go visit the restaurant and have something to eat.
A：All right. No wonder people always say that ______.
o: the colors of the walls should be white
the place of a restaurant is as important as its food
the colors of the store signs really matter in the restaurant business
it’s more convenient to order food on the Internet

e: 由 A 回覆說「不，它聞起來很糟。我才不要吃它。」，可知上一句應是 B 問 A 要不要嘗一嘗藍起司。
q:
A：What’s that smell?
B：It’s from the blue cheese. ______
A：No, it smells so bad. I’ll never try it.
o: Why don’t you throw it away?
Would you like to give it a try?
Will you buy this for me next time?
Let’s put it back in the refrigerator.

e: 由於 A 詢問 B 為何要拍食物的照片並張貼在臉書上，可推知 B 應回答他藉由照片跟朋友分享自己的生活和故事。
q:
A：Why don’t you eat your meal?
B：I have to take pictures of the food first and post（張貼）them on Facebook.
A：Why do you do that?
B：______
A：You should eat your meal, or it will get cold soon.
o: I’m good at drawing. I often draw pictures when I’m free.
I used to take photos with a camera, but now I do that with my smartphone.
I have many photos of Jennifer Lawrence. She’s my favorite actress.
I share my life and my stories with my friends through pictures.

e: 空格前 A 拒絕 B 去摸狗的提議，以及空格後下一句 B 要 A 不須要擔心，因為他的狗很友善，可推知應該是 A很怕被咬。
q:
A：Your dog looks cute.
B：His name is Toto. Do you want to pet him?
A：No, thanks. ______
B：Don’t worry. He’s very friendly.
o: I’m afraid that he’ll bite me.
I’d like to play with him later.
I can’t keep pets at home.

e: B 沒有點他最喜歡吃的牛排，可推測空格是「牛排聞起來怪怪的」。
q:
A：Did you enjoy your meal at the new restaurant?
B：Yes, but I didn’t order steak.
A：Why not? Isn’t that your favorite food?
B：______ when the waiter brought it to the table.
o: The cheese tasted better than the pork
The restaurant wasn’t a friendly place

p:
Do you know colors can affect people’s appetites? According to some studies, red, yellow, and orange may make people feel hungry. That is why many fast-food restaurants use these colors in their store signs. Green is often used in store signs, too. When people see it, they think of healthy food. On the other hand, black doesn’t look very appetizing. That’s why you don’t see many restaurants use this color in their store signs. White makes people think of something clean, but it also feels plain. So when the restaurants use it in their store signs, they should use it with care.
What about the color blue? Does it make people feel hungry? The answer is no. Some people think it is because there is not much food in this color. When people see it, their brains are turned off from it. However, when people are thirsty on hot days, which drinks look more eye-catching, the brown ones or the blue ones? Many people may go for the blue ones because the color makes people think of cool water. In a word, it is important for a person to know the magic of colors when he or she wants to open a restaurant.

p:
30-Hour Famine
Every year, there are more than twelve million children die because they don’t have enough food. Most of them are under five years old.
The “30-Hour Famine” began in 1971 in Canada. A group of teenagers didn’t eat food for 30 hours to raise money for hungry children. In Taiwan, this event first started in 1990.
Every year, more than a million people join in this event and help in different ways. They not only donate money, food, and clothes, but also help local people to dig wells.
Mother Teresa once said, “We cannot all do great things, but we can do small things with great love.” Let’s work together to save lives.
-------------------------------------------------------
Q & A
1. Q: I’m a girl. Can I join the famine?
A: Of course. If you are over 12 years old, you can join the famine at home or with a group.
2. Q: How long should I stop eating food?
A: 12 or 30 hours.
3. Q: What can’t I eat during the famine?
A: You have to stop eating solid foods, like bread, rice, and beef. But you can drink some water, milk, or juice.
For more information, please call 5252-1230.

e: 修飾動詞要用副詞；「as＋adj. / adv.＋as」表示「和……一樣……」，形容詞跟副詞須用原級。
q: Please walk ＿＿＿. You are moving as ＿＿＿ as a turtle（烏龜）.

e: 詢問「如何、程度」疑問詞用 how。beautifully 用來修飾動詞 dances。
q:
A：＿＿＿ does Betty dance?
B：She dances ＿＿＿.

e: 修飾主詞 I，故用形容詞比較級 better。
q: I tried to do my best in the football game, but I was not ＿＿＿ than anyone else on my team.

e: 由一般動詞 practice 及句意可知，第一格可用 hard 或 harder 修飾 practice；help 後可接原形動詞或 to V，故第二格可用 (to) train。
q: If（假如）you practice ＿＿＿, you may win the game. Besides, I will help ＿＿＿ you.

e: 第一格根據 than Mike，故用副詞比較級 faster；第二格由空格前的 the 與其後的 in our class，判斷使用副詞最高級 fastest。
q:
A：Finn runs ＿＿＿ than Mike.
B：Yeah. He is also the ＿＿＿ runner in our class.

e: Susie 在派對上穿得「最」漂亮，最高級在副詞前面加 most。
q: Susie caught everyone’s eye because she dressed ＿＿＿ beautifully at the party.

e: 由一般動詞 go 與 take 可知，兩格皆要用副詞修飾，late 的形容詞與副詞同形，所以第一格用 late，而 serious 的副詞為 seriously。
q: You always go to school very ＿＿＿ and seldom study. If（如果）you don’t take school more ＿＿＿, you won’t get good grades.

e: 首句為同範圍的比較，須排除自己，所以須用 anyone else。後句強調爸爸對我來說是最好的廚師，故用 the best。當最高級形容詞修飾名詞時，the 不可省略。
q: My father cooks better than ＿＿＿ in my family. To me, he’s ＿＿＿ cook in the world.

e: 根據句意，可知 B 最討厭紫色，故可以推知 A 詢問「你『最不』喜歡下列哪一種顏色？」，故選 little 的最高級。
q:
A：Which of these colors do you like ＿＿＿?
B：Purple（紫色）. I hate it.

e: 第一格須用副詞修飾動詞 drove，可用 very fast 或 fast；使役動詞 make 後接原形動詞，不可接不定詞。一般動詞 tell／ask 用法為「tell／ask＋受詞＋to V」。
q: The taxi driver drove ＿＿＿. I kept ＿＿＿ him to slow down, but he didn’t listen.

e: 修飾動詞須用副詞。根據句意，這兩格空格語意相反。lately 表「最近」。
q: Although（雖然）Susan got up ＿＿＿, she arrived at school ＿＿＿.

e: 修飾名詞 driver 要用形容詞；修飾動詞 drive 要用副詞。
q: Michael is a ＿＿＿ driver. He always drives ＿＿＿.

e: 修飾名詞要用形容詞；修飾動詞要用副詞。
q: That girl has a ＿＿＿ voice. She can sing ＿＿＿.

e: 由答句中的 No 與 actually 可知，第二格必須填入第一格的相反詞。又由句意可知，她是最後一名。late 為「晚地；遲地」，與句意不符。
q:
A：Didn’t Sally run ＿＿＿ in the race?
B：No, she ran ＿＿＿ actually. She didn’t win the race.

e: be 動詞後應填入形容詞；cry 為一般動詞，其後須接副詞修飾；get 當連綴動詞時，其後須接形容詞作補語。
q: My son is usually ＿＿＿, but he cries ＿＿＿ when he gets ＿＿＿.

e: 由 as... as… 可知為原級比較，第一格用 fast；由原形動詞 join 可知前面要用使役動詞 let。
q: Look! Ben is running as ＿＿＿ as Jay. Why not ＿＿＿ him join us for the relay race（接力賽）?

e: 由 in his class 可知為三者以上的比較，第一格要用副詞最高級 (the) best；help 後可接原形動詞或 to V，故第二格用 (to) teach。
q: John plays the guitar ＿＿＿ in his class. He often helps his music teacher ＿＿＿ his classmates to play it.

e: 第一格空格後因為有 in the band，故必須填入副詞最高級來修飾動詞 sing；第二格空格因為其前為 be 動詞，又其後有 than any other girl，應填入形容詞比較級。
q:
A：Does Jenny sing ＿＿＿ in the band（樂團）?
B：Yes, she does. She is also ＿＿＿ than any other girl in the band.

e: 第二格空格後因為有 of all，可知應填入最高級副詞，因空格前已有 the most，故 (C)、(D) 不可選。又由語意可知，應選 (B)。
q:
A：Do you draw ＿＿＿ than your brother and sister?
B：No, I draw the most ＿＿＿ of all.

e: 須填入情態副詞修飾其前的動詞；hardly 表「幾乎不」。
q:
Son：It’s raining ＿＿＿ outside. I can’t play baseball with my friends.
Mom：Then, why don’t you study at home this afternoon?

e: 副詞 highly 表「程度或地位非常高」，置入後不符合語意，故選 (A)。
q: I saw a girl jump really ＿＿＿ and run quite（非常地）＿＿＿ on the sports field the other day. I want to know ＿＿＿ about her.

e: 第一格空格前的 look 為連綴動詞，故應填入形容詞；第二格前的 looked at 為一般動詞，故應填入副詞修飾動詞。
q:
A：Why did the runner look ＿＿＿ on TV this morning?
B：She won the most important race of this season, so she looked at her parents ＿＿＿.

e: 第一格應填入形容詞原級修飾名詞 swimmer；第二格應填入副詞比較級修飾動詞 swim。
q: Ben is a ＿＿＿ swimmer. He swims ＿＿＿ than me.

e: be 動詞後接形容詞；speak 和 sing 同為動詞，其後接副詞修飾。
q: Linda’s voice is ＿＿＿. She always speaks and sings ＿＿＿.

e: 第一格空格應填入副詞修飾 do；第二格應填入副詞來修飾動詞 study。且依據句意，只可 (D)。
q: I didn’t do ＿＿＿ on the math test, so I have to study ＿＿＿.

e: 「as many＋複數可數名詞＋as possible」表「盡可能多……」；try one’s best表「竭盡某人全力」。
q:
A：To win the game, you need to make as ＿＿＿ turns as possible on your toes.
B：OK, I’ll try my ＿＿＿.

e: 由 as... as… 可知空格內應填入原級形容詞修飾主詞（動名詞）；根據語意，故選 interesting（有趣的）而非 funny（好笑的）。
q: Playing the guitar is as ＿＿＿ as playing video games to Sam. He often does these two activities（活動）in his free time.

e: voice 為名詞，故應填入形容詞修飾；talk 為一般動詞，其後應填入副詞修飾。
q:
A：Every time James drinks alcohol（酒）, he talks more loudly.
B：Yes, he talked to me in a ＿＿＿ voice last night.
C：Poor you. I heard（聽到）him talk to you ＿＿＿ the whole（全部的）night from the next table.

e: 第一格空格前有一般動詞 run，且空格後有 than，故應置入副詞比較級 more slowly 或 slower；第二格空格後有名詞 runner，根據前後語意，故應置入形容詞最高級 slowest。
q: Sam runs ＿＿＿ than any other person in his class. He is the ＿＿＿ runner.

e: 連綴動詞的問句為「What＋助動詞＋主詞＋連綴動詞＋like?」或「How＋助動詞＋主詞＋連綴動詞?」，故第一格應置入 How；第二格之前的 look 為連綴動詞，其後須接形容詞 perfect。
q:
A：＿＿＿ do I look in this red dress?
B：You look ＿＿＿. It’s the right one for you to wear to the party.

e: be able to 之後須接原形動詞；由「It＋be 動詞＋adj.＋for＋人＋to V…」句型，可知第二格應置入 it’s。
q:
A：Are you able ＿＿＿ my computer in one hour? I need it to do my report tonight.
B：No, ＿＿＿ not possible for me to do that.

e: 第一格空格前有不定冠詞 a，空格後為名詞 worker，可知空格內應置入形容詞原級 hard（努力的）；第二格空格前有一般動詞 work，且空格後有限定範圍 of all，可知空格內應置入副詞最高級 the hardest（最努力地）。副詞 hardly 表「幾乎不」。
q:
A：Sara is very important to our company（公司）because she is a ＿＿＿ worker.
B：I agree. She works ＿＿＿ of all.

e: 要讓人聽清楚，故用 slowly。hardly 雖是副詞，但表示「幾乎不」。
q: You need to speak ＿＿＿ to the old men, so they can understand（了解）better.

e: 情狀副詞用來修飾動詞，而 happy 的副詞為 happily。
q: The little girl jumped up and down ＿＿＿ when she saw a butterfly（蝴蝶）flying into her room.

e: 第一個空格修飾的是人，可排除副詞的 (A)、(C)；而第二個空格前有 most 可知是最高級，故選擇 (B)。
q: Eric, you have to be ＿＿＿ with the vase（花瓶）. It is the most ＿＿＿ item in the house.

e: 用情態副詞修飾動詞 play，且程度副詞 very 用來修飾情態副詞的原級。
q: Cindy plays the guitar very ＿＿＿. She practiced a lot.

e: 主要子句使用 be 動詞時，附和句也須用 be 動詞。
q: Kelly isn’t able to get home at five, and her sisters ＿＿＿, either.

e: and 為對等連接詞，連結詞性相同的生字和句子。第二句中，didn’t feel like… 為過去式，故 and 後也須接過去式。
q: Rita felt tired（累的）after working for long hours. She didn’t feel like moving and ＿＿＿ on the sofa.

e: 副詞 seriously 用來修飾動詞 got；quick 可當副詞，意同 quickly。
q: Ken got hurt very ＿＿＿. We should take him to the hospital ＿＿＿.

e: 用形容詞修飾名詞 singer，而用情態副詞修飾動詞 sing。
q: Alice is a ＿＿＿ singer. She sings ＿＿＿.

e: James 籃球打得「很好」，但 Durant 打得「更好」。根據語意，第一格空格使用副詞修飾，第二格使用副詞比較級，強調比前者打得更好。
q: James plays basketball ＿＿＿, but Durant plays even ＿＿＿.

e: 由 of all 可知須用副詞最高級 (the) fastest；表示「某人花費多少時間做……」可用「人＋spend＋時間＋V-ing」或「it＋takes＋人＋時間＋to V」。
q: Jack swam ＿＿＿ of all in the swimming race, but it still ＿＿＿ him more than ten minutes to finish it. In the end, he didn’t set a new record（紀錄）.

e: 第一格前有片語動詞 listen to，故應置入副詞；第二格前有連綴動詞 sound，故應置入形容詞。
q: Tim is listening to music ＿＿＿ in his room. Listen! The music sounds very ＿＿＿.

e: laugh at… 表「嘲笑……」。
q: Peter’s classmates ＿＿＿ his outfit（服裝）. He felt sad and angry（生氣的）.

e: feel 表「感覺」，為連綴動詞，後方須接形容詞。well 當形容詞時，表「健康的」。
q: Ben didn’t feel ＿＿＿, so he went to the doctor this afternoon.

e: 空格後一句為「否則你上學會遲到」，故可推知說話者要 John「收拾書包快一點」。
q: John, ＿＿＿, or you will be late for school.

e: 空格後一句為「最後，那一切都值得了。」，可知 Debbie 和她同學們為了電視表演而辛勤演練，為的是完美呈現表演，好贏得比賽。
q: Debbie and her classmates practiced hard for a TV show so many times because ＿＿＿. In the end, it paid off（值得）.
o: their teacher told them not to do that
they could count stars at night
they wanted to make it perfect and win the game
everyone had a different dream job

e: Ryan 是校隊裡籃球打得最好的，那就是說，「沒有人籃球打得比他好」。
q: Ryan plays basketball the best on the school team, that is to say, ＿＿＿.
o: he lost more games than anyone else
everyone plays basketball well, but he doesn’t
no one plays basketball better than him
he doesn’t have the gift for playing basketball

e: 空格前提到因為 Monica 很餓，可知她「吃光她餐盤內的所有東西」。為最符合因果關係之答案。
q: Monica got hungry, so ＿＿＿. Then she even ordered some food on the Internet.
o: she gave away all her food to poor kids
she didn’t waste（浪費）any money on the cake
she didn’t have time to cook
she ate up everything on her plate

e: 從空格後句「因為他們不喜歡咖啡」，可推知爸爸燒開水是「他想要泡熱茶給朋友喝」。
q: My dad is boiling water. ＿＿＿ because they don’t like coffee.
o: He wants to make hot tea for his friends
He will put some sugar in it
He is going to make fried chicken
He plans to do the dishes with it

e: A 說空汙在我們的城市是個嚴重的問題，而 B 也這麼覺得，並建議開始展開行動，可知他認為「我們應該嚴肅看待這個問題」。
q:
A：Air pollution（汙染）is a serious problem in our city.
B：You’re right. ＿＿＿ and start to do something about it.
o: The words are too simple（簡單的）

e: A 想知道為什麼每個人都喜歡 Steve，而 B 回答他對每個人都很和藹，可知「他善待每個人」。
q:
A：Why does everyone like to be with Steve?
B：He is gentle to everyone, and ＿＿＿.

e: 由 B 回答他昨晚沒時間寫家庭作業，所以今天早上必須完成它，可推知 A 詢問「你為什麼今天這麼早起床？」。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：I didn’t have time to do my homework last night, so I had to finish it this morning.
o: Why did you get up so early today?
You slept until 11 a.m. How come?
How was your breakfast this morning?
Did you go to bed late yesterday?

e: 由 B 回答那是因為她每天必須很快地完成許多事，可推知「Kylie 做每件事都很趕。」。
q:
A：＿＿＿
B：That’s because she has to finish many things very quickly in a day.
o: Kylie keeps a diary every night.
Kylie does everything in a hurry.
Kylie lost her job last week.

e: B 到了露營地想先休息，但 A 提醒現在已是傍晚五點，可知他們應該要在天黑前「紮營」。
q:
A：Finally, we arrived at the campsite（露營地）. It took us a lot of time to take the bus here.
B：I’m so tired（疲勞的）. I really want to lie on the ground and take a rest.
A：Wait. It’s now 5 p.m. ＿＿＿ before it gets too dark.
o: Let’s watch the full moon shine brightly

e: 由於 Serena 去年贏了五十場網球賽，且今年又贏了更多場，所以 B 認為她是史上最佳的網球選手之一。A 也這麼覺得，可知他認為「她是網球女王」。
q:
A：Did you watch the tennis match（比賽）yesterday? Serena won another game.
B：She won 50 matches last year, and this year she won even more. She’s one of the best tennis players in history.
A：True. ＿＿＿
o: She doesn’t have the gift for tennis.
She isn’t able to break the world record（紀錄）.
She’s really the queen of tennis.
She didn’t do very well on her history test.

e: A 詢問為何要收集這些綠葉，而 B 回答他們在學校要對它們做實驗，故推知他這麼做是為了上自然課。
q:
A：Why did you collect these green leaves（葉子）?
B：＿＿＿ We’ll do an experiment（實驗）on them at school.
A：That sounds interesting.
o: I left the house late this morning.
My mom told me to take them home.
I did that for my science class.
I didn’t bring them because I left them on the bus.

e: A 詢問 B 為何要每天寫日記，而 B 回答他變老的時候將會讀它，推知「發生過的每件事將會成為甜蜜的回憶」。
q:
A：Why do you keep a diary every day?
B：I’ll read it when I get old ＿＿＿.
A：Wow, I never thought about that.
o: , and I will forget about the bad dreams
because I don’t like to look back
, so I can write everything down slowly
, and everything will become a sweet memory（回憶）

e: 由 B 後來說如果自己繼續嘗試，他終將成為主唱，可知「他在團體中大聲高歌是為了更凸顯自己的歌聲」。
q:
A：Why do you always sing so loudly in the group?
B：＿＿＿
A：But you are not the lead vocalist（主唱）.
B：I will be if（如果）I keep trying.
o: Because I’m not good at singing.
I do that because I want my voice to stand out.
I can sing all my famous singer’s songs.
Because I have a sore throat.

e: 由 A 回應他們一定是你最好的朋友，可推知「告訴他們我的未來夢想」是最親密的朋友才會做的事。
q:
A：What did you talk about with your friends on the Internet?
B：We talked about everything. ＿＿＿
A：They must be your best friends. Only the closest friends do that.
o: I also told them about my dreams for the future.
I don’t like to speak in public（公開的）.
We always keep our voices down in the library.
Practicing speaking is very important when you learn English.

e: A 認為喝生水不安全，可知他說「我們要把水先煮沸」。
q:
A：I got some water from the river around the campsite（露營地）.
B：Good. Please give me a glass of water. I’m thirsty.
A：Wait a minute. It’s not safe to drink it. ＿＿＿
o: Let’s get hot water to take a bath.
Let’s put it in the refrigerator.
We must put some sugar into it.
We should boil it before we drink it.

e: A 詢問為何媽媽不把衣服晾在室內，而要晾在室外，推知 B 會解釋晾在屋外衣服乾得比較快。
q:
A：Where is Mom?
B：She is hanging out the clothes outside.
A：Why doesn’t she do that inside?
B：＿＿＿
o: The moon and stars will shine brightly tomorrow.
The clothes dry more quickly outside actually.
She enjoys lying on the ground and counting stars.
She is going to wash them with the new washing machine.

e: 腳痛的原因是在公園走路時扭傷，其餘選項皆未回應腳痛的原因。
q:
A：Why are you crying?
B：My foot really hurts.
A：What happened?
B：＿＿＿
o: I danced beautifully and won the contest（比賽）.
I warmed up gently before I exercised.
I turned on my toes perfectly.
I tripped when I was walking in the park.

e: A 對於 B 在比賽中輸了感到不解，推知他應該看過 B 的練習狀況。
q:
A：How was your race yesterday?
B：I lost.
A：How come? ＿＿＿
B：Well, I ran fast, but I rode and swam very slowly. We had to finish those three things during the race.
A：Oh, my!
o: Running a business is your dream.
You always come to school early.
You didn’t prepare anything for it.
I saw you practice running very hard each day.

e: 由空格後的「她真是一位舞后。」，可推知「Jean移動和踮起腳趾轉圈是如此地輕柔」。
q: Look at Jean. ＿＿＿ She is a dancing queen.
o: She trips on the stairs（樓梯）easily.
She walks to her computer class quickly.
She lies on the ground and watches the full moon happily.
She moves and turns on her toes so gently.

e:
1. 情態副詞修飾一般動詞，且根據語意及文法，空格內應置入原級的情態副詞。
2. 情態副詞修飾一般動詞。
3. but 連接語意有轉折的句子。由前句「我們有時不聽你的話」，可推知後句為但「你跟我們說話的時候仍然很輕柔」。
p:
Dear Mrs. Chen,
This is Susan from Class 905 in KN Junior High School. Everyone in the class is fine and misses you. How are you doing?
First, we want to thank you for teaching us last year. You were really a nice teacher. You taught English __1.__, so we are not afraid of speaking English now. Second, you always treated us __2.__. We sometimes didn’t listen to you, but __3.__. We’re going to graduate next week, and we would like to invite you to have a nice lunch with us at Johnson’s Restaurant at 11: 30 next Wednesday. We all look forward to your coming. Please tell me your answer. Thanks a lot.
Best,
Susan
graduate 畢業 look forward to 期待

o: you were never nice to us
you still talked to us gently

e:
1. 由 Erica 詢問「你為何熬夜」可知，只有 (D)「我只睡了兩小時。」符合上下語意。
2. 形容開車速度的「快」要用副詞 fast。
3. 空格前後兩句語意相近，故選 (A)。
4. 由 Tim 最後答應 Erica由她來開車，可知他覺得 Erica 所說的情況聽起來「很嚴重」。

p:
One of the best ways to experience nature is camping. It gets you away from all the noise in your busy life and lets you do things more slowly. For example, you can sit quietly outside and see all kinds of animals. Or, you can just take it easy and do nothing at all.
However, if you don’t like setting up camp and sleeping on the cold, hard ground, you can try car camping. It’s better than simple camping because you get to sleep in a safe space—your car. It’s also easier because you don’t have to spend time setting up camp. Everything stays in your car. If you want to leave and hike somewhere, all you have to do is lock it up and go. You can go car camping in any kind of car. Just remember, if you have a bigger car, you will have more room for your things and you will sleep more comfortably. Here are the pros and cons of a basic car, an SUV, and a truck. You can choose one of them that meet your needs when you go car camping.

p:
To some people, this fish looks like a swimming head. What is this strange fish? It’s of course the ocean sunfish, or Mola mola.
Ocean sunfish live in cool to warm waters for as long as 20 years. They’re the largest and heaviest bony fish on Earth. Most of them are around two meters long and weigh 1,000 kilograms. The biggest one in history was more than three meters long and weigh 2,000 kilograms. Because of their size and shape, they swim very slowly. However, they can move fast when they’re eating or getting away from whales and sharks for not being eaten.
In the world of bony animals, ocean sunfish can have more eggs than any of the other fish. In fact, they can have up to 300,000,000 eggs at once. The babies are really small when they’re born, but they grow very quickly. Besides, ocean sunfish aren’t dangerous to people at all. Actually, they are more afraid of us than we are afraid of them. Here are some do’s and don’ts when you want to watch them in the ocean.

p:
Ancient Romans worked hard. They of course became dirty, but they only washed their arms and legs when they got home. With each day, their bodies got dirtier and dirtier. Then, on the ninth day, they would finally wash their bodies well. They cleaned their bodies with cold water, and some of them even did that by swimming in the river.
At the end of the 3rd century BC, the idea of taking a bath in hot baths every day came from Greece. It quickly grew popular with the Romans, and they began making bathrooms in their houses. The first public bathhouses came in the 2nd century BC, and in 33 BC, Rome had 170 small baths. By the early 5th century, there were more than 800 public baths in the city.
These bathhouses weren’t just large bathrooms. Some were as big and as busy as today’s shopping centers. They had restaurants, gyms, reading rooms, and more. Men and women went there to meet friends, enjoy meals, and even have someone cut their hair. Although they had to pay to go into the bathhouses, the bathhouses became a very important part of their daily lives.

p:
Earthquakes are very common in Taiwan, Japan, and many other places in the world. Usually, when an earthquake hits, we can feel the ground shaking suddenly. Sometimes, the earthquakes are really large and powerful, and they knock us and buildings down.
Many of us today can remember two of the most powerful earthquakes in history. The fourth largest happened in 2011. It hit Japan in March 2011 and measured 9.0 on the Richter scale. It caused large waves, and those waves moved very quickly to and over land. Sadly, it took many people’s lives. The same thing happened with the 2004 earthquake in Sumatra（蘇門答臘）. It measured 9.1 and was more powerful than the Japan one.
However, the two largest earthquakes in history happened about 60 years ago. The number two measured 9.2 on the Richter scale. It hit Alaska（阿拉斯加）in 1964. Four years earlier, the most powerful earthquake hit Chile（智利）. It measured 9.5 on the Richter scale. Just like the other large earthquakes, this one took the lives of many people. Who knows? If the world and its climate keep changing, we may see an even bigger and more powerful earthquake in our near future.

p:
Dear Diary,
I went to the zoo with my family today. We saw many interesting animals there. Of all the animals, bats are the most special to me. They are the second largest group of all animals. They have more than 500 kinds. What a big family! Bats’ sizes are very different from each other. The wingspan of the largest bats can grow up to 200 cm. However, the smallest kinds have a wingspan of only 10 cm.
Although there are many different kinds of bats, they still have one thing in common. That is, all the bats hang upside down to sleep. That’s because their back feet are very small and much shorter than their front feet. As a result, bats can’t stand or walk. When they are on the ground, they can only crawl. Even so, bats can still move very fast when they fly in the sky.
For me, bats are really special animals. I will learn more about them when I visit the zoo next time.

p:
Dear Aggie,
My daughter and I used to be close. She would tell me everything about her feelings and her day at school. However, something changed, and she is not herself anymore. She appears to be hiding things from me. Take the other night for example. Something was really wrong because I heard a crying sound coming from her room. I didn’t see her crying myself, but I saw her face when she came out. Her eyes were all red and puffy, and her nose was as big as a tomato. When I asked her about it, she just put on a smile and went into the bathroom. This kind of thing happened very often recently. I can’t sleep well at night because of this. What should I do?
Worried Mom
------------------------------------------------------
Dear Worried Mom,
Things aren’t always that bad. We often make them more serious in our head, but in real life, they are nothing to worry about. Also, your daughter is growing up and needs more space than before. She has to learn to do things and fix problems by herself. It will be hard to watch her doing that, but when she really needs you, she will come to you. You’re doing a great job, so take it easy on yourself.
Aggie

p:
Honeybees are more than just insects because they are one of the most important animals on Earth. People pay them little mind when they watch them flying from flower to flower. Although it doesn’t look like much when they do that, they are in fact doing an important job. It’s even more important than picking up nectar to make honey. They are moving pollen from one plant to another over and over again. This helps the plants to be able to make more plants. They do this for 80% of the world’s flowers and plants, and without them, one third of the world’s food will disappear. In other words, no bees mean no plants, and no plants mean no food for animals like cows, pigs, and chickens. Also, no animals mean no meat, milk, or eggs for people to eat.
Sadly, that may be happening soon because many bees are leaving their homes and disappearing. Scientists call it Colony Collapse Disorder. The UK lost 33.8% of its bee homes, and the USA 45%. If we don’t do something to stop this soon, maybe we will not have a home for very long.

However, what may happen when another ice cream seller comes? Let’s say you stay at Point A (the middle), and the other seller sets up their stand at Point B (closer to one end). Then the other seller will only get 37.5% of the customers (the people near their end). You will get more than 60% of the people (from the middle and the other end).

p:
Joyce：Peter, there will be a big art show next Saturday. Justin and Emily are going, but Sue can’t make it. Do you want to come with us?
Peter：Well, I’ll be pretty busy that day. What’s it about?
Joyce：It’s about surrealism.
Peter：Dali? The surrealist’s art show?
Joyce：That’s right. How did you know?
Peter：I’m a big fan of Salvador Dali. I love his works, although they are strange. I especially like “The Persistence of Memory.” It’s a painting about time. The things in this painting look strange, but they’re really special and interesting.
Joyce：So if you can come with us, let’s meet at Entrance A of the Hall at 2 p.m.
Peter：I need to change my schedule first. If I want to go with you, I have to stay late at work to finish the job by next Friday. I also have a meeting that day.
Joyce：Wow, you’re really as busy as a bee.
Peter：You’re right. Anyway, I’ll tell you my decision tonight. Hey, Joyce. Read a little about Dali before you go. Then you can understand the stories behind his paintings better. Don’t worry—it’s not hard.

2. 第一段最後一句 Marian 提到：「和孩子一起做飯可能會讓人害怕，但也很美好。這段快樂時光是金錢買不到的。」可知 Marian 認為親子共廚是一種金錢買不到的快樂時光。
3. 第二段最後一句提到：「在教他們做飯之前，你們可以一起閱讀烹飪步驟。這可以幫助他們更好地閱讀。」，故此處應選 (B)。
p:
Kids are usually not welcome in the kitchen because they may make it very dirty. So many parents don’t want to ask for trouble. They only want their kids to stay in the living room to watch TV or play. But Marian, a smart mom, teaches her son to be a great little helper. “My son started to watch me cook when he was just three. As he grew older, I let him help cut some vegetables. Cooking with kids can be scary, but it’s also wonderful. You can’t buy the happy time with money,” said Marian.
When you let kids help in the kitchen, they feel proud and happy. Besides, they will be more willing to try new food if they help make it. Before you teach them to cook, you can read the cooking steps together. This can help them read better.
Here are Marian’s tips:
1. Choose the right time: Start cooking lessons when your kids are in a good mood. If they’re hungry or tired, they won’t listen.
2. Choose the right dish: Start with easy ones. They can help kids enjoy cooking.
3. Tell them the rules: Tell them not to play with fire or knives.

Barbie’s Got a New Body
Jan. 2016
Girls and women don’t come in one shape, and now, finally, Barbie won’t, either.
Being one of the most successful toys in history, Barbie debuted at the American Toy Fair in New York City on March 9, 1959. Over the years Barbie has worked hundreds of jobs－from sign language teacher, doctor, farmer, coffee shop worker, to soldier. She even went to the moon in 1965, four years before Neil Armstrong. However, her body shape hasn’t changed much since she was “born” in 1959.
Sales of Barbie dolls have fallen every year since 2012, so Mattel added new Barbies to its line. There are now Barbies with 7 skin tones, 22 eye colors, and 24 hairstyles to choose from. What’s more, it will begin selling Barbies with three new body types. One is taller than the original barbie, another is more petite, and the other is curvier. The dolls with the new bodies will hit stores in America this spring and roll out in the rest of the world after that.

If you’re a fan of chocolate like I am, then you know the treat is not only delicious but also good for you. However, there’s a dark and sad side to chocolate, and few people know about it. What can be dark about something that’s so delicious?
Cocoa is the main thing in chocolate, and most of the cocoa comes from small farms in West Africa. I don’t know if you know this, but children, between 10 to 15 years old or even younger, have worked as slaves on those farms. In fact, the practice has been around for many years, and little has changed.
These days, over two million children are working in the fields of Ghana and the Ivory Coast. Instead of having fun and enjoying school, these children work long hours in dangerous environments. They may have to carry heavy things, spray cocoa trees with pesticides, and burn fields to clear them.
Even worse is the fact that many of the children in the cocoa industry were sold to the farms to fix their families’ money problems. Sometimes they are even stolen from their parents, never to see them again. I know I can do something to help those poor children and still enjoy my chocolate treat. With that in mind, I have decided not to buy chocolate from the companies which use child workers.

e: 空格到 the roller coaster為本句主詞，動詞為sounds，可知空格應填入動名詞；「事物＋sound＋現在分詞＋to＋人」表「某事物對某人聽起來是……的」。

q: The good news was ＿＿＿ to Mr. Wang. He became very ＿＿＿ after he heard about it.

e: 副詞用來修飾動詞shouted；that 引導的名詞子句當主要子句的受詞時，that 可省略，there is / are 表示「有……」。

q:

e: 「某人看起來感到驚訝」的用法為「人＋look＋surprised」；that 用來引導名詞子句，當作 know 的受詞，可省略。
q:

e: 「某事使某人（感到）無聊」的用法為「事＋bores＋人」或「事＋be boring to＋人」。doing the same things every day 為主詞，視為單數，若後面接「be boring to＋人」，be 動詞要用 is 或 was。
q: Sara wants to find a new job because doing the same things every day ＿＿＿ her.

e: that 用來引導名詞子句，當作 heard 的受詞，可予以省略。
q: My parents were very happy when they heard ＿＿＿ my team won the baseball game.

e: 「某人對某事感到厭煩」的用法為「人＋be bored with＋物」。

e: 由子句中的主詞 Amy 與 every day，可知動詞應為第三人稱單數的現在式。
q: Amy says she ＿＿＿ every day, but I don’t think that’s true. She doesn’t even want to take her dog for a walk.

e: 「事物＋be動詞＋現在分詞」表「某事物是……的」。
q: Cleaning the kitchen alone is ＿＿＿. Let’s do it together.

e: 表事物是「有趣的」，用 interesting，且根據語意，那男人是「無趣的；乏味的」，用 boring。
q: Ruby saw an ＿＿＿ movie with a ＿＿＿ guy. She liked the movie, not the man.

q: The music is too loud. Would you mind ＿＿＿ down the radio a little?

q:

B：That’s right, and many of us are also excited ＿＿＿ it.

e: that 用來引導名詞子句，當作 believe 的受詞。
q: Ben believes ＿＿＿ his son will never lie to him.

q: The children are ＿＿＿ about the baseball game tonight.

e: 「人＋be 動詞＋過去分詞＋介系詞＋V-ing」表「某人對做某事感到……」。
q: Kevin is tired of ＿＿＿ sandwiches from the convenience store（便利商店）every day. He plans to make one today.

e: 第一句的 that 用來引導名詞子句，當作 think 的受詞，可省略，第一個空格應為 there（there is…句型）；第二句的 that 用來引導名詞子句，當作 afraid 的受詞，可省可不省，故選 (A)
q: I don’t think ＿＿＿ is any food in the refrigerator. I’m afraid ＿＿＿ you need to use food delivery today.

e: 第一格 scared 後接介系詞 of，表示「對……感到害怕」。第二格某物看起來「令人害怕的」，形容詞為 scary。
q: Don’t be ＿＿＿ of the ＿＿＿ dogs on the road. I’ll protect（保護）you.

e: 子句中的主詞為人（they），且根據句意，當他們看到我們時會「感到驚訝」嗎，故應填過去分詞當形容詞的 surprised。
q: Do you think they will be ＿＿＿ when they see us? We didn’t tell them we would go to the party tonight.

e: 「人＋be 動詞＋interested in＋事物」表「某人對某事物感到有趣」；finish之後必須接V-ing。
q: John was ＿＿＿ in the story. He just finished ＿＿＿ it in a day.

e: to 後面接原形動詞。excite 意為「使興奮」，較符合句意，故選 (C)。若選 (D)，則此句應為 Try not to get the baby excited…。

Blythe Jones is back. The writer of the popular series on witches has written a new book, and it’s going to hit bookstores this spring.
In The Dark Well, Jones continues Penelope’s story. The young witch lives in Salem, Massachusetts in the 21st century. She is tired of all the questions about her powers, so she tries to live a quiet and boring life. One day, she gets a surprise visitor. He is a reporter from Boston and is tracking down a story. He thinks the piece of news is really interesting, and it has led him right to Penelope’s door. However, she thinks he’s strange and isn’t interested in helping him. The reporter doesn’t give up, and after some time, he gets her to agree. When the young man starts digging up information about the scary dark well in her garden, things take a surprising turn.
Although I like Jones’ other books, this new one is quite boring. It takes too long for the reporter to find Penelope and even longer to get her help. Also, it’s not surprising to see them become lovers because that kind of thing has happened many times in the series before. Besides, no one in their right mind would believe that two people would fall in love because of a dark well.

p:
A Successful Mistake - Post-it Notes
How does a mistake become a successful product? Post-it Notes are a good example. In 1968, a 3M researcher, Spencer Silver, was trying to make a very strong glue to be used in building planes. However, he came up with something different instead. He made a very weak glue. At the time, nobody could think of a use for this weak glue, but he believed he would find a use for it one day. Many years later, another 3M researcher, Arthur Fry, had a problem of losing his notes in his church song book. He was tired of that. One day, an idea came into Arthur’s mind. He remembered Spencer’s glue and tried some on his bookmarks. It worked wonderfully! Arthur saw that his bookmarks stayed in place. To his surprise, he could easily take them away from the pages and stick them again. In 1974, the idea of Post-it Note was born, and Arthur then started making the notes with Silver’s glue for 3M. Spencer, Arthur, and their team spent several years working to make sure the glue stayed on the piece of note but not on the page. After a successful product test, Post-it Notes hit the market in 1980. Since then, Post-it Notes have become one of the most popular office products in the world. There are now more than 600 Post-it Note products sold in more than 100 countries. Have you ever used Post-it Notes? What do you think of this successful mistake?

Eric Henry Liddell was born in China in 1902. His Scottish（蘇格蘭的）parents were working there at the time. People wanted to know if he could win a medal because he was not that good in the 400-meter race and all the other runners were stronger than him. Liddell wasn’t worried because he had faith in God and believed that he would bring glory to God by running. He surprised everyone by winning the gold medal and setting a new world record with a time of 47.6 seconds.
In 1981, Liddell’s story was made into a movie called Chariots of Fire. This movie was very successful at that time, and it won four Oscars（奧斯卡獎）, including Best Picture.

People have great ideas for their own shops and companies. However, they don’t always have the funds to get them off the ground, do they? They have several ways of getting the money. Indiegogo helps people get their interesting ideas out there. It also gives them control over their own projects. Basically, people with the ideas make a webpage for their projects, and on it, they tell others what they are doing and what kind of help they need. u.q: Which of the following is correct?
o: Scott’s neighbor was invited to join him.
To Scott, singing is more important than sleeping.
Louis knew that Scott has problems sleeping at night.
The police were called in to stop the fight between Scott and his neighbor.

e:
1. 從文中的敘述可得知第二段和第三段分別是 Scott 的兒子和女兒所說，第四段內容則是出自 Scott 的太太，而最後一段的敘述中 Little Hero 多半是對兒子或孫子所說；I’ve never been prouder 多半也是對兒子或孫子所說，所以選項中「其中一人是 Scott 的爸爸／媽媽」是比較合理的選擇。
2. 從第三段 You will be home from the war soon, won’t you? 可知，Scott 目前人在戰場上。此外，最後一段有說到 You are doing your country a great service，這也代表 Scott 目前正在從軍。
p:
Scott hasn’t been home in nearly half a year. All the people in his family really miss him, so they decided to record a video with messages from each of them. Below is the video.

o: One of them is Scott’s parent.
One of them is Scott’s brother.
One of them is the Big Hero’s sister.
One of them is the father of two of the others.

yourself ＿＿＿. He doesn’t want to be ＿＿＿ like ＿＿＿.

e:
1. 前半句為過去式一般動詞的肯定句，故附加問句用否定助動詞 didn’t。
2. 句中有否定意味的 no one，故附加問句使用肯定助動詞 did；而當主詞為不定代名詞時，附加問句的代名詞須用 they。
3. 前半句使用肯定 be 動詞 is，故附加問句要用否定的 isn’t。
q:
填入正確的附加問句：
1. Iris told you she didn’t want to come to my birthday party, ＿＿＿＿＿＿?
2. Because we went out for dinner, no one answered the door, ＿＿＿＿＿＿?
3. Marla’s vacation is over, so she is sad, ＿＿＿＿＿＿?

e:
1. 問題「被提出」這件事已是過去的事件，故用過去式被動語態 was raised。
2. 由 now 可知，在會議上報告是 Sophie 正在做的事，故用現在進行式主動語態 is presenting。
3. 這間教室每週都須「被清理」，故用被動語態。
q:
填入正確的動詞形式：
1. The question ＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿ (raise) by a brave little girl.
2. Sophie ＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿ (present) a report at the meeting now.
3. The classroom needs to ＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿ (clean) every week.

e:
1. 前半句助動詞是 has，故附加問句助動詞用 hasn’t。
2. 前半句助動詞是 has，但因為有否定意味的 never，故附加問句助動詞用 has。
3. There 開頭的句子，附加問句的主詞用 there。
q:
填入正確的附加問句：
1. Tom has lived in Taiwan for more than twenty years, ＿＿＿＿＿＿?
2. Fred has never cared about others, ＿＿＿＿＿＿?
3. There are several fish in the pond, ＿＿＿＿＿＿?

e:
1. 花是「被澆水」，yesterday 為過去時間，故用過去式被動語態 was watered。
2. want 後接的動詞須以不定詞（to V）呈現，而此句為 Linda 說她想要「被邀請」到那個派對，故用不定詞的被動語態 to be invited。
3. Grace 的媽媽「照顧」嬰兒，next weekend 為未來時間，故用未來式主動語態 will / is going to take。
q:
填入正確的動詞形式：
1. This flower ＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿ (water) by Tina yesterday.
2. Linda said she wanted ＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿ (invite) to the party.
3. Grace’s mother ＿＿＿＿＿＿＿＿ (take) care of the baby next weekend.

e:
1. love to 後接原形動詞。
2. 由句中的 now 可知須用現在進行式。
3. 由句中的 by Jimmy 及時間副詞 just now 可知，用過去式的被動語態。
4. 由前句的 See? 可知 Andy 應該是正在嘗試接球，用現在進行式。
5. 主詞是 the ball，句子最後使用 by Andy，表示球被 Andy 做了什麼事，且比賽已結束，故用過去式被動語態。
q:
填入正確的動詞形式：
Jimmy and Andy are junior high school students. They love to 1. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (do) sports. Look! They 2. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (play) baseball now. A ball 3. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (hit) by Jimmy just now. See? Andy 4. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (try) to catch it. Finally, the team of Andy got one point, and they won the game because the ball 5. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (catch) by Andy.

e:
1. 主詞是禮物，用被動語態。
2. 主詞是貓，動詞是照顧，用被動語態。
3. 主詞是人，動詞是切傷，用主動語態。
q:
填入正確的動詞形式：
1. The presents ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (buy) by Mr. Thompson yesterday.
2. My cat ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (take) care of by my mother when I wasn’t home.
3. Mrs. Wilson ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (cut) her finger when she was cooking last week.

e:
1. 由 later 可知，take 的動作會於未來發生，故須用未來式，在 is going to 或 will 後的被動語態用 be taken。
2. 由 for ten years 可知這個行為已經持續一段時間，故用現在完成式的被動語態 has been used。
3. 由句中的 by 可知是被「嘲笑」，且句中使用時間副詞 every day，故用現在式被動語態 is laughed at。
q:
填入正確的被動語態：
1. The garbage is smelly（臭的）. It ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (take) out later.
2. The bag ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (use) by my mother for ten years. She loves it so much.
3. Linda doesn’t want to go to school anymore because she ＿＿＿＿＿＿ (laugh at) by her classmates every day.

e:
1. 由前句的動詞 is 可知，附加問句動詞用 isn’t。
2. 由 since 可知，此句須使用現在完成式，be 動詞的現在分詞為 been。
3. Not only A… but also B… 後面的動詞須配合 B 做變化，故使用 is。
4. 在樹下的兩位女孩 be 動詞要用 are。
5. 由前句的動詞 look 可知，附加問句的助動詞要用 don’t。
q:
填入正確的動詞形式或附加問句：
Kelly is a lovely girl, 1. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ she? She has 2. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ the most beautiful girl in our school since her first grade. She has a twin sister（雙胞胎姐姐）, Jenny. Not only Kelly but also Jenny 3. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ tall and thin. Look! Those girls under the tree 4. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ Kelly and Jenny. They both look beautiful, 5. ＿＿＿＿＿＿ they?

e:
1.祈使句的附加問句用 shall we。
2. 由助動詞 can 可知，附加問句助動詞用 can’t。
3. 由一般動詞 looks 可知，附加問句助動詞用 doesn’t。
4. 由 be 動詞過去式 were 可知，附加問句動詞用 weren’t。
5. 由 be 動詞 is 可知，附加問句動詞用 isn’t。
q:
完成附加問句：
1. It’s hot today. Let’s go swimming this afternoon, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ we?
2. Everyone can have their own opinions, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ they?
3. Ben looks good in that shirt, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ he?
4. You were chatting with your friends then, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ you?
5. Life is like a box of chocolates, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ it?

e:
1.祈使句的附加問句用 will you。
2. Let’s 開頭的祈使句，其附加問句用 shall we。
3. 主要子句有 seldom，屬於否定句，附加問句為肯定。主要子句動詞為一般動詞，附加問句用助動詞，第三人稱單數用 does。
q:
完成附加問句：

2. Let’s go shopping today, ＿＿＿＿＿＿?

e:
1. 由助動詞 didn’t 可知，附加問句用 did。
2. 由助動詞 can 可知，附加問句用 can’t。
3. 由助動詞 haven’t 可知，附加問句用 have。
q:
完成附加問句：
1. You didn’t take a trip to the USA last summer, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ you?
2. The children can bake cookies by themselves, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ they?
3. The boys haven’t seen the movie, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ they?

e:
1. 主要子句為肯定，附加問句為否定。主要子句為過去式 was，附加問句用 wasn’t。
2. 主要子句為否定，附加問句為肯定。主要子句用複數 be 動詞 are not，附加問句用 are。
3. 主要子句為肯定，附加問句為否定。主要子句用一般動詞 goes，且主詞為第三人稱單數，附加問句用助動詞 doesn’t。
q:
完成附加問句：
1. Jean was studying at that time, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ she?
2. The students are not honest, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ they?
3. Alice goes to the theater every Friday night, ＿＿＿＿＿＿ she?

e:
1. 表某狀況持續一段時間的介系詞用 for。
2. 被動語態搭配的介系詞為 by。
3. be filled with 意思為「充滿」。
q:
填入正確的介系詞：
1. Frank’s dog has been missing ＿＿＿＿＿＿ a month.
2. The girl was saved ＿＿＿＿＿＿ a brave soldier.
3. The movie was filled ＿＿＿＿＿＿ gender stereotypes.

e:
1. 由後句「只有 Lily 沒有智慧型手機」可知，故用 except 表「除了……之外（其他人都有智慧型手機）」。
2. 被動語態搭配的介系詞為 by。
3. put yourself in my shoes 表「設身處地以我的立場想」。
q:
填入正確的介系詞：

2. The great actor will be remembered ＿＿＿＿＿＿ all of us.
3. Put yourself ＿＿＿＿＿＿ my shoes, and then you’ll stop complaining（抱怨）.

e: 這間新百貨公司將「創造」至少五百個工作機會。這座鎮上的人對此都感到很開心。

q:

q: In English, the past tense（時態）of a verb（動詞）, like walked and talked, is usually f＿＿＿med by adding “ed.”

p:
Our planet is having problems and needs help. It is believed we are using up oil in the next fifty years. As its price keeps going up, life has become more difficult for everyone. Luckily, one of the richest people on the planet is trying to change that.
Phil Cates has donated millions of dollars to help make the world a better place. Finding a better source of energy is the first thing on his list. He says it must last a long time and can’t be expensive. However, he’s not sure if something can be found soon.
Next, Cates is working on getting people in poorer countries clean drinking water. It is not easily found, and it often comes at a high price. Also, the water is always collected by women and girls. They spend up to six hours a day collecting water for their families. Cates can’t tell if men and boys know how hard it is for them.
Finally, getting children and adults a good education is very important to Cates. He thinks that education is what everyone should be given to lead a successful life. He believes with happy people comes a happy world.

p:
Picture it. You have just gotten into a car, and in no time at all, it drives you home. The surprising thing is that the steering wheel doesn’t need to be controlled. Also, the pedals don’t have to be pushed to make the car go or stop, and you don’t have to pay any mind to or see what’s happening on the roads. What’s more, no person has been paid to do all that for you. That’s because the car is doing it by itself. You might want to know if you are dreaming, but you are not, because it is in fact a driverless car.
A driverless car is also called a self-driving car, and it works just like the ones people have now. The biggest difference between them is that the driverless car doesn’t need a person to control it. The car can sense what is around it. Also, it is built with so much new technology that it knows where it is and where it is going. A lot of great things are going to come about because of driverless cars, such as fewer problems on the roads. At the moment, self-driving cars are still being tested. However, it won’t be long before driverless cars are actually seen on the roads.

p:
Many people around the world are affected by blindness. A small number of them are almost blind and can’t see a thing, but most of them still have some sight. Some of those people are only able to tell whether there is light, but others can see quite a bit more. This leads people to think about the question: Do blind people dream, and if they do, do they dream like sighted people?
Dreams are made inside the brain, and they happen during REM sleep（快速動眼期）. That means they are not directly connected to people’s eyes or sight. So, it’s no surprise that blind people do dream, and they dream just as much as sighted people do. What they dream about is a little different, though. That’s because they experience smell, sound, and taste more, just as they do when they are up. This is not to say that they don’t see when they dream. Some blind people can and do dream in pictures. However, if someone was born blind or went blind before the age of five, they usually don’t see pictures in their dreams. On the other hand, the later in life people lose their sight, the more likely they can still see pictures in their dreams.

p:
Luna：Have you read The Lucky One? It is a book ＿1.＿ the pleasure of loving others.
Bill：No. Can you tell me more about it?
Luna：It’s about a soldier ＿2.＿ got a picture of a smiling girl and the picture brought him good luck.
Bill：How did the picture do that?
Luna：During combat, ＿3.＿, but he was kept safe and didn’t get hurt.
Bill：What did he do with the picture?
Luna：He couldn’t get the smiling girl out of his head even after he arrived home, ＿4.＿. When he finally did, he found out she was divorced.
Bill：Did they fall in love with each other?
Luna：Yes, they did, but he kept the picture a secret. He didn’t let the woman know he had it. After all, being with someone just for good luck is not right.

e:
1. 表「有」的介系詞須用「with」。
2. 由他們待在鄉村農場好幾天可知他們離開了市「中心」。
3. 由下文 Richie 羨慕那些人的生活，可知他覺得每件事是「令人驚喜的」。
4. 空格前說明 Richie 的所見所聞，可知「他說自己學到許多事情並增長見聞」。
p:
Mr. Buffer was anything but poor. In fact, he was the richest man in the country. He had a young son, and his name was Richie. One day, he decided to show him something to teach him about the world.
Mr. Buffer wanted Richie to know how lucky he was to grow up in such a rich family, so he took him to see how people ＿1.＿ very little money lived. They left the city ＿2.＿ and spent several days visiting farms in the country before going back to the city.
On their way home, Mr. Buffer asked Richie what he saw and learned on the trip. His son thought everything was ＿3.＿. He saw that the people had lots of pets, but he just had one. He also found that the people had dozens of big ponds, but he only had a little one in his garden. He liked how they grew their food instead of having to buy it. He was also surprised that they could make friends with anyone without worrying about the high walls to protect them. ＿4.＿ Then he thanked his dad for showing him how poor they were.
anything but 絕不是 instead of 而非 protect 保護

o: The father was happy to hear that.
He said he learned many things and grew wiser.
He made a mark in his life.
They knew everything about building a pond themselves.

e:
1. 先行詞 person 是人，為第三人稱單數，根據語意，其後的動詞應使用第三人稱單數的現在簡單式動詞。
2. 由下一句「事實上，它們出現已有數千年的時間了」，可知前一句應為「香蕉不是什麼新奇的水果」。
3. 先行詞 countries 是事物，故關係代名詞應為 which 或 that。
4. 由空格後的 too 可知，空格內應說明香蕉的優點。
p:
Bananas are sweet and delicious, and the world is crazy about them. More than 100 billion of bananas are eaten every year. Every person that ＿1.＿ in the USA eats about 27 pounds each year, while each person in Uganda eats around 500 pounds each year. What’s more, bananas are so popular that more songs have been written about them than any other fruit on the planet.
＿2.＿ In fact, they have been around for thousands of years. They were first grown in the countries ＿3.＿ make up Southeast Asia. Now, they are grown in many parts of the world, but most of them that make bananas to supermarkets everywhere come from India. Bananas grow on plants that are up to 25 feet high. Also, those plants have leaves that can grow to be nine feet long and two feet wide. The banana that is most commonly found weighs about 125 grams and is made up of 75% water. They feel and taste great in our mouths and ＿4.＿, too. Helping fight diseases is one of the good things about eating bananas.
billion 十億 pound 磅 Southeast Asia 東南亞 plant 植物 weigh 重達 gram 公克 disease 疾病 wide 寬的

e:

p:
To：Ingrid@deutchland.net
From：Sharonhuang@formosa.com.tw
Date：December 15, 2024
Subject：Berlin Visit
------------------------------------------------------
Dear Ingrid,
How have you been? Is everything in your hometown the same as before? Have you enjoyed your life back home since you left here in July? Have you done anything interesting? I know I asked for a lot of ＿1.＿, but I just miss talking to you. It’s not the same without you in the ＿2.＿, but I try not to think about it too much or let it get me down.
You shouldn’t worry about me, though, because my life outside of work is going well. I actually have something ＿3.＿ to share with you. I’m taking a German class. In fact, it’s my third class because I want to be able to understand the meanings of road signs or store signs when I visit Berlin next February during the Chinese New Year holidays.
I haven’t found a place to stay yet. I am wondering ＿4.＿. I’m not looking for anything fancy. I just want somewhere safe and close to your place and maybe with a little kitchen. That way, I could save some money by cooking my own meals. If you can think of any places that are right for me, please let me know.
Can’t wait to see you,
Sharon

o: whether there are any tall buildings which cost one million dollars

e:
1. 先行詞 hair 為事物，關係代名詞須用 which 或 that，且關代為主格時不可以省略。
2. 本句已有動詞 smiled，故僅能填入介系詞 with 表「有」，形成後位修飾，用來形容本句的主詞 a boy。
3. 第一段最後一句講述作者接下來的時間都忘不了心儀的男孩對著她微笑的這件事，她心情很愉悅，但是第二段的的內容是作者的寵物狗過世，故這裡會是轉折句，表示事情有變化。
4. 由後句作者的母親擤鼻子、眼睛紅紅的，可知她一看到母親的樣子便知道出事了。
p:
Date: Tuesday, May 11
Dear Diary,
My day began better than the other days this week. This morning, I spent less time on my hair ＿1.＿ usually gives me a lot of trouble. When I was going to leave, my old dog, Boomer, saw me off at the door, but he had a strange, sad look on his face. I had to catch my bus for school, so I went ahead and left. At school, nothing too exciting happened. Then a boy ＿2.＿ beautiful blue eyes smiled at me at lunch, and I couldn’t get it out of my mind the rest of the afternoon.
＿3.＿ Boomer wasn’t at the door to meet me as usual, so I went around the house and looked for him. I couldn’t find him, so I went to the kitchen and asked Mom about it. ＿4.＿ She was blowing her nose, and her eyes were all red. Before she even said a word, I knew that Boomer was gone. It was too bad that I didn’t hug him this morning when I had the chance. Where are you, Boomer?

hug 抱

Bill：Is there anything written about the ticket price?
Ted：The price of a single-ride ticket is NT$80, and it doesn’t matter where you get on and off.
Bill：That price isn’t ＿5.＿. Is there anything else bikers need to pay attention to?
Ted：Yes, no dirty bikes are allowed on the metro, and you can only get on the first and last cars with your bike.

p:
(Five people are sharing their New Year’s resolutions.)
Vivian：I love taking pictures ＿1.＿ show the world in its natural beauty. From January 1st, I’m going to take the camera with me at all times and take ＿2.＿ one picture each day.

Palm reading can give you some ideas about yourself. Before you do that, you need to know what the most important lines are and where they are on the palm.
First is the big line that begins at the side of the palm between the thumb and index finger and usually goes down to the wrist. It is called the life line, and it gives you an idea about your health and how long you might live.
Next is the line that starts at the same place as the life line and runs across the palm. It is called the head line, and its length tells how smart a person is. So, the longer it is, the smarter you are. Above that is the heart line. It runs across the palm to below the little finger at the edge of the hand. It shows how strong your heart is and how you feel about love.
After that is the line that runs from the bottom of the palm up to the bottom of the middle finger. It shows when and how you will become successful and is called the fate line.

e: 先行詞 the man 為人，關係代名詞須用 that 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。又關係子句應用被動，表達「那男人被車撞」。(B) 要改成 who / that has been hit 才對。
q: The man ＿＿＿ by the car is a famous actor.

e: 先行詞 the soldier 為人，關係代名詞須用 that 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。又名詞子句「how to V」用來問「怎麼做」。
q: Jackie is talking to the soldier ＿＿＿ asked him ＿＿＿ to get to the nearest metro station.

e: 關係子句為 the guy you met，故可知本句缺動詞，故選 (B)。
q:
A：＿＿＿ he the guy you met at the party?
B：Yes, that’s him!

e: 先行詞 the music 為事物，關係代名詞須用 that 或 which，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格，故關代亦可省略。
q: Not being able to listen to the music ＿＿＿ makes me feel down.

e: 先行詞 the dress 為事物，關係代名詞須用 that 或 which，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格，故關代亦可省略。
q:
A：Do you want to see the dress ＿＿＿ yesterday?
B：Sure, I do.

e: 先行詞 the packages 為事物，關係代名詞須用 that 或 which，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。又關係子句應用被動，表達「包裹被打開」。
q: Are the packages ＿＿＿ by Mom yours?

e: 先行詞 the best gift 為事物，關係代名詞須用 that 或 which，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格，故關代亦可省略。又關係子句可用過去式或現在完成式表經驗。
q: What’s the best gift ＿＿＿ for your birthday?

e: 先行詞 the girl 為人，關係代名詞須用 that 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。由從上下文可知動作已發生，故關係子句動詞用過去式。
q: Jim told me the girl ＿＿＿ to him this morning is his sister.

e: 先行詞 the kind of woman 是人，關係代名詞須用 that 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格，故關代亦可省略。又 go out with 表「和……外出」。
q: Jane is nice and friendly. She is the kind of woman ＿＿＿ many people want to ＿＿＿.

e: 空格前無先行詞，故選 what。
q: Ken is a perfect husband. He’s honest and supportive（支持的）. This is ＿＿＿ Jane wants in a marriage（婚姻）.

e: 先行詞 the class 為事物，關係代名詞須用 which 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。又關係子句應用被動，表達「課程被選修」。
q: Have you ever taken the class ＿＿＿ by Mr. Smith?

e: 先行詞 the first thing 為事物，關係代名詞須用 that 或 which，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格，故關代亦可省略。
q:
A：When you get your salary（薪水）, what is the first thing ＿＿＿ you will buy?
B：A smartphone.

e: 第一格用 who 引導 wh- 名詞子句當動詞 know 的受詞；第二格前面的 the one 為先行詞，指人，關係代名詞須用 that 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格，故關代亦可省略。
q: I don’t know ＿＿＿ your sister is. Is she the one ＿＿＿ you talked to a few minutes ago?

e: 關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格時，關代亦可省略。(A) 要改成 who / that were invited to the party；(C) 要改成 who / that came from the UK；(D) 要改成 who are playing basketball。
q: All the men ＿＿＿ are tall and young.

e: 主要子句已有動詞 have，故問句用助動詞詢問。又 whose 是關係代名詞的所有格，結構為「先行詞＋whose＋名詞」。
q: ＿＿＿ you have a friend ＿＿＿ father is a soldier?

e: 關係子句的先行詞 women 為人，關係代名詞用 who 或 that。另外，women 為複數名詞，故現在完成式用「have＋過去分詞」。
q: The women ＿＿＿ John had a fight with ＿＿＿ his neighbors（鄰居）for over ten years.

q: The pens that Charles has ＿＿＿ made in Japan.

e: 當先行詞為物，且前有最高級時，關係代名詞常用 that。
q: This is the greatest movie ＿＿＿ I have ever seen.

e: 介系詞在前時，關係代名詞受格不可省略。當先行詞為事物或動物時，關係代名詞只可用 which，不可用 that。
q: Taipei is the city in ＿＿＿ Sandra was born.

e: 介系詞在前時，關係代名詞受格不可省略。當先行詞為人時，關係代名詞只可用 whom，不可用 who 或 that。
q: The man with ＿＿＿ Mary is talking looks friendly.

e: 句首使用疑問詞 who，關係代名詞通常使用 that。
q:
A：Who is the cute boy ＿＿＿ we met yesterday?

q: Lucas is interested in any news ＿＿＿ about his favorite singer.

e: 先行詞 the plate 為事物，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格，故關代亦可省略。盤子被打破這個動作已發生，故動詞 break 須用過去式或用 is broken 表達現在的狀態。
q: Mom, please don’t be mad. The plate ＿＿＿ you bought for me ＿＿＿.

e: 第一格後為名詞，故用 whose 代替所有格；第二格的先行詞 the woman 為人，關係代名詞須用 that 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。
q:

B：Do you mean the woman ＿＿＿ teaches math in our school?

q:
A：Who is the man ＿＿＿?
B：Actually, I don’t know who he is. He was just a stranger to me.

e: 第一個空格後為名詞，故用 whose 代替所有格。第二個空格前無先行詞，故應為where 引導 wh- 名詞子句當動詞 know 的受詞。
q:
A：Excuse me, I’m looking for a book ＿＿＿ cover（封面）has a pink lollipop on it. Do you know ＿＿＿ I can find it?
B：Try the third floor.

e: 先行詞 a stingy person 為人，關係代名詞須用 that 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。
q: Ann is a stingy（小氣的）person ＿＿＿ never buys drinks for us when we go out.

e: 第一句的先行詞 the comic books 為事物，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當受格，故關代亦可省略。第二句的先行詞 idea 為事物，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。
q: The comic books ＿＿＿ Zack bought yesterday were missing. Do you have any idea ＿＿＿ took them?

e: 空格後為名詞，故用 whose 代替所有格。
q:
A：Students, why are you all looking outside?
B：Ms. Lin, did you see the bird ＿＿＿ color is red? It’s so beautiful!

e: 先行詞 the boy 是人，故不可選 (A)、(D)，又 (B) 要改成 that is holding a black bag。

q: Carol talked about the people and the things ＿＿＿ fascinated（吸引）her during her trip to the USA, and ＿＿＿ she shared with us was truly amazing.

e: 第一個空格前無先行詞，故空格為 what。第二句的先行詞 the girl 為人，關係代名詞須用 that 或 who，又關係代名詞在關係子句中當主格，故不可省略。
q: Jim just stood there and didn’t know ＿＿＿ to say to the girl ＿＿＿ was crying.

e:
1. 先行詞為物時，關係代名詞用 which 或 that。
2. 由於第二段提到這名學生遇到他最喜歡的作家，所以最符合文意的選項應為「而且我是她的粉絲之一」。
3. 由第三段下文可知，這名學生是問她「有沒有時間」，他想問她問題。
4. 本句的受詞是名詞子句，空格應用 that 引導。
p:
Dear Diary,
I’m sorry I’ve been too busy to talk to you in the past few days. I spent a lot of time preparing for my final exam, so I haven’t had a chance to tell you what’s going on in my life.
Well, it was finally over, and something really interesting and exciting happened to me today. I met my favorite writer at the bookstore ＿1.＿ I usually visit. Her name is Lucinda Granger. In the past six years, she has published many books that readers can’t get enough of. Many teenagers love them, ＿2.＿.
I went to her and asked her ＿3.＿. She smiled and said yes. I asked her how to become a writer. She told me to start by keeping a diary about my life because writers need to be good at writing down their thoughts. She also said ＿4.＿ it’s good for writers to share the thoughts with their readers, so I could also share my writing by posting it on the Internet.
After hearing that, I started writing to you on my computer soon after I got home. I hope I can be a great writer like her one day.
final exam 期末考 publish 出版 thought 想法 post 發文

Sue：It was cheap, too. The dish ＿2.＿ I miss the most is their fried beef. It was so tender, and the vegetables were yummy. That reminds me. My mom’s birthday is coming up, so maybe we can take her there to celebrate. ＿3.＿

＿2.＿ It’s our first stop in Taiwan. I’d like to know whether you have time to join us and be our guide next Saturday. If you don’t, that’s OK. Besides, could you tell us what the local foods ＿3.＿ you recommend the most are? ＿4.＿ I can’t wait to hear from you.

Knowing how to ask for help is important.

In 2002, Teun van de Keuken, a Dutch reporter, found out that all the chocolate companies that signed Harkin–Engel Protocol didn’t follow the rules of producing slave-free chocolate. So, he decided to take action himself. Instead of writing news about the case, he recorded himself eating illegally-made chocolate and sent the video to the court. Though this case made more people care about how the chocolate ＿1.＿ they bought was made, most big chocolate companies still showed little interest in producing chocolate differently. In November 2005, he made milk chocolate that used 100% slave-free cocoa under his own company, Tony’s Chocolonely. The name of the company comes from the fact that he created the business all by himself without any help from the chocolate industry. The chocolate ＿2.＿ package was in bright red color caught everyone’s eye successfully. Since then, the company has produced and sold chocolate closely following the rules of fair trade. They pay farmers 25% more than the market price for their cocoa, so they can keep their profits as big as possible. It’s clear that a lot of work still needs to be done. ＿3.＿, Tony’s Chocolonely created “Tony’s in Africa” project in 2009 to try even harder to change the cocoa industry. They’ve given 1% of their profits to the project every year and hope that the dream of 100% slave-free chocolate around the world ＿4.＿.
